articles.title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
articles.content: Diffusion video models produce striking clips, but they cannot reliably render an exact formula, a correct chart, a ruleconsistent game or narration synchronized to on-screen events. A different route is emerging: multimodal agents that write code to render every frame and synthesize every sound. We introduce VibeVideoBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on code-driven video generation. Its 239 self-contained tasks in English and Chinese span 12 categories, from data stories and music-driven pieces to classroom lessons and paper explainers; each asks an agent, running in its native harness inside a sandbox, to deliver a finished MP4 with sound within one hour. Evaluation is hierarchical and evidence-based: program checks of the delivery spec, about 13k task-specific rubric checks traced to the requirements they enforce, and five quality dimensions anchored per task, judged by three VLM judge panels and validated with blind human preferences. Across nine frontier agent systems and 2,151 scored rollouts, the benchmark is far from solved: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead clearly, yet even the best system fails a core requirement on about a quarter of tasks. Whether a video arrives at all matters as much as its quality, and three quarters of the lost videos are final renders started too late, run too slowly or never started. The judges agree with each other and with human preferences on system rankings, but only moderately on individual videos.

articles.title_zh: VibeVideo Bench:评价编码驱动视频生成的多式代理
articles.content_zh: 传播视频模型产生出惊人的片段,但它们无法可靠地使精确的公式,正确的图表,规则相符合的游戏或叙述同步到屏幕上的事件. 一个不同的路线正在出现: 写出代码的多模式代理来渲染出每个帧并合成每个声音. 我们引入了VibeVideo Bench, 用于评估代理 代码驱动的视频生成。 它的239个自成一体的英语和汉语任务分为12个类别,从数据故事和由音乐驱动的片段到课堂课和纸上解说;每个类别都要求一个在沙盒内以自生自灭的绳子运行的特工在一小时内交付一个有声音的完成的MP4. 评价是分级的和以证据为基础的:交付种类的程序检查,追踪到它们所执行的要求的约13k项特定任务的标题检查,以及每个任务定位的五个质量维度,由三个VLM法官小组进行判断,并以盲目的人类偏好加以验证. 在9个前沿代理系统和2,151个得分的推出中,基准远远没有解决:GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5明显领先,然而即使是最好的系统也未能满足约四分之一任务的核心要求. 影片的到来是否与质量一样重要, 评委们在系统排名上互相认同,并赞同人类的偏好,但在个人视频上却只是适度的.

articles.title: Do vision models know that three is three?
articles.content: Do vision models encode the transition $2{\to}3$ the same way whether it appears in handwritten digits or in hand gestures, and do they "understand" that clean${\to}$dirty is the same transformation regardless of whether it is applied to a kitchen or a carpet? The linear representation hypothesis (LRH) answers this for language models: concept changes correspond to directions in (language) embedding space. In vision, the same concept can manifest in visually unrelated "regimes" that rarely co-occur: images of digits and hands do not share much in common in pixel space. To understand whether vision models still encode the underlying abstract concepts, we study 46 vision encoders across architectures, training objectives, and scales, on 10 concept families including numerosity, age, object identity, and MIT-States attributes. Within each regime, we find statistically significant concept directions near-universally across our tested models. However, two distinct regimes do not always share the same concept direction. Several models learn multiple linear structures for the same concept transition, split across regimes. We call this phenomenon "fragmented linearity": strong local linearity coexisting with near-absent global linearity. Fragmentation is, however, not fixed: models with stronger local linearity progressively escape it (local-global linearity correlated with $τ\in [0.38, 0.89]$ across all concepts), and where global linearity does emerge, concept directions can transfer as linear probes across regimes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视觉模型知道三是三吗?
articles.content_zh: 视线模型是否以同样的方式编码转换2美元到3美元, 无论是在手写数字还是手动手势中出现, 他们是否"理解"干净的$$to}$dirty是相同的转换, 不管它是适用于厨房还是地毯? 线性表示假说(LRH)为语言模型解答了这一点:概念变化对应(语言)嵌入空间的方向. 在视觉中,同样的概念可以表现在视觉上无关的"regimes"中,这些"regimes"很少被同化:数字和手的图像在像素空间中并没有什么共同点. 为了了解视觉模型是否仍然将基本的抽象概念编码,我们研究了46个视觉编码器,它们跨越建筑、培训目标和尺度,涉及10个概念家庭,包括数字、年龄、对象身份和麻省理工学院国家属性。 在每一个制度内,我们发现,在我们所测试的模型中,统计上重要的概念方向几乎是普遍的。 然而,两个不同的制度并不总是具有相同的概念方向。 一些模型为同一个概念过渡学习多条线性结构,在制度之间分化. 我们称这一现象为"分界线":强烈的地方分界线与近乎相去甚远的全球分界线共存. 然而,不成体系并不是固定的:地方线性较强的模型逐渐脱离(地方-全球线性在所有概念上与美元相关联[0.38,0.89]),在全球线性出现的地方,概念方向可以作为跨制度的线性探针来转移。

articles.title: FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis
articles.content: 4D novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to render dynamic scenes across viewpoints and timestamps, which requires jointly inferring 3D structure and temporal dynamics. Existing monocular feed-forward methods often rely on explicit 4D Gaussian representations, which are prone to temporal inconsistency and severe rendering artifacts. We present FL4N, the first feed-forward latent 4D NVS model. Instead of relying on explicit 4D primitives, FL4N encodes a 4D scene prior into a unified latent representation across space and time. Our core insight is that learning temporal dynamics as residuals on top of a pretrained static latent prior enables effective 4D modeling with limited dynamic training data. To this end, we introduce a lightweight dynamic encoder that leverages static scene features to disentangle object motion from camera-induced parallax. Trained solely with an image synthesis objective, FL4N achieves state-of-the-art 4D NVS quality while rendering in real time. Its learned latent representation generalizes to real-world videos and disentangles viewpoint from time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FL4N: Feed-forward Lententy Model 用于4D 小说视图合成
articles.content_zh: 4D小说取景合成(NVS)旨在使动态场景跨越观点和时间戳,这需要共同推断出3D结构和时间动态. 现有的单向饲料前行法往往依赖于明确的4D高斯表示法,这些表示法容易出现时间不一致和严重渲染出文物. 我们提出FL4N, 第一个向前进的潜在4DNVS模型。 FL4N没有依赖明确的4D原始,而是将一个4D场景在之前编码成一个跨越空间和时间的统一潜伏的表示. 我们的核心见解是,在经过预先训练的静态潜伏之前,学习时间动态作为残余物,能够以有限的动态培训数据进行有效的4D模型。 为此,我们引入了一种轻量级动态编码器,利用静态场景特征将物体运动从相机所引发的抛物管中分离出来. FL4N完全以图像合成目标来训练,实现了最先进的4D NVS质量,同时实时渲染. 它所学的潜质表现概括到现实世界的视频,并且从时间上分散观点.

articles.title: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
articles.content: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, for autonomous driving and embodied control. We argue that it is the absence of structured action priors in random noise initialization that forces direct-policy WAMs to recover coherent action sequences through iterative denoising. Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations. We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation. As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step. Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps. It obtains approximately $3\times$ speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. The project page is available at https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OSWAM: " 一体行动 " 的有效世界行动模式
articles.content_zh: 直接政策世界行动模式(WAM)表明,将行动生成与明确的未来视觉预测脱钩的好处在于能够有效推断自主驾驶和体现控制。 但是,它们仍然需要数十个取消提名的步骤,才能达到竞争行动的质量,从而产生很大的延迟并阻碍实时部署。 仅仅减少去名步骤的数量,就会使非线性多步骤去名轨迹崩溃而变成粗糙的更新,严重地降低行动质量。 为了减少虚名步骤,同时促成实时行动生成,我们提出了一个有效的世界行动模式,其中一步步行动生成,即OSWAM,用于自主驱动和体现控制。 我们认为,正是在随机噪声初始化中缺乏结构化行动前兆,才迫使WAM通过迭代去诺来直接恢复连贯的行动序列. 因此,我们构筑了想象符号来初始化传播过程,提供物理前科和有行动条件的表述. 我们进一步引入带有未来条件的特权信息分解,以增进未来意识的行动生成。 因此,OSWAM能够在仅仅一个传播步骤中高效而有效地产生出高质量的行动. 我们的实验表明,与直接政策WAM和联合WAM相比,OSWAM在自主驱动和体现控制方面都取得了相当甚至更好的结果,这需要数十个步骤。 它在直接政策WAM基线上获得约3\times美元的速度,并支持在NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU上低至40ms的实时编译推论. 项目网页见https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/。

articles.title: MedVTok: A General-Purpose Medical Visual Tokenizer
articles.content: Multimodal medical AI requires a common visual interface for encoding heterogeneous imaging evidence for patient condition modeling. However, existing medical visual tokenizers are often tied to a specific dimension and imaging modality, forcing multimodal systems to rely on fragmented and poorly reusable representations. We introduce MedVTok, a general-purpose visual tokenizer that maps 2D images and 3D volumes from diverse imaging modalities into a unified token space. Building such a tokenizer poses two key challenges: preserving anatomical structure across dimensions and capturing clinical semantics across modalities. To this end, MedVTok introduces (i) slice differential regularization, which explicitly models inter-slice anatomical coherence missing in previous per-pixel/per-voxel supervision, and (ii) multi-expert representation alignment, which integrates knowledge from multiple medical expert encoders while retaining modality-specific complementary knowledge. Trained on 28M images and 70K volumes across 9 imaging modalities, MedVTok supports classification, retrieval, segmentation, synthesis, visual question answering, and medical report generation through a single tokenizer. Across 24 benchmarks, MedVTok achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating a scalable token interface that unifies medical image dimension, modality, and task usage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MedVTok: 通用医学视觉感应器
articles.content_zh: 多式联运医学AI需要一种常见的视觉接口来编码患者状况模型的多相成像证据. 然而,现有的医疗视觉表示器往往与特定的维度和成像模式相联,迫使多式系统依赖零碎和难以再使用的表示。 我们引入了MedVTok,一种通用的视觉示意器,将2D图像和3D卷从不同的成像模式映射到一个统一的示意空间. 建立这样一个示意器提出了两个关键的挑战:在维度上保持解剖结构,在模式上捕捉临床语义。 为此,MedVTok引入了(一)切分分法规范化,它明确模拟了以往每像素/每伏克赛尔监督中缺失的切片间解剖一致性,并(二)多专家代表协调,将来自多位医学专家编码器的知识相融合,同时保留特定模式的补充知识. MeDVTok对28M图像和70K卷进行了9个成像模式的培训,支持分类、检索、分解、合成、视觉问题回答,并通过单一的示意剂生成医疗报告。 在24个基准中,MedVTok实现了最先进的性能,展示了一个可伸缩的符号界面,统一了医疗图像的维度、模式和任务使用。

articles.title: Seeing Through Distractions: Context-Stable Attribution via the Least Core
articles.content: Shapley-value-based explanations are widely used for feature attribution in machine learning. However, in computer vision, a feature may reduce the target-class score when added to the complete genuine image, even when the predicted label remains unchanged. We formalize such features as contextual distractors and investigate their attributions under semivalues and the least core. Under a weak average marginal monotonicity assumption, we derive quantitative semivalue--least-core gap bounds and sufficient conditions based on the probability of sampling smaller contexts. We further show that shifting semivalue weights toward larger contexts decreases the signed gap. Finally, controlled image-classification experiments and evaluations on Salient ImageNet provide strong empirical support for our theoretical findings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: " 通过分拨:通过最低核心提供稳定的上下文 "
articles.content_zh: 以毛细值为基础的解释被广泛用于机器学习中的特征归属. 然而,在计算机视觉中,一个特性在被添加到完整的真实图像中时可能会降低目标类分数,即使预测的标签保持不变. 我们正式确定这种特征,如背景分散作用者,并调查其根据半价值和最低核心的归属。 在微弱的平均边际单相假设下,我们根据较小环境的取样概率,得出了定量的半价值-最下核差距界限和充分的条件。 我们进一步表明,将半价值权重转移到大环境可以缩小签字差距。 最后,在Salient ImageNet上控制的图像分类实验和评价为我们理论结论提供了强大的经验支持.

articles.title: Back to Basics: A Skill-Centric Approach to Generalist Web Agents
articles.content: Browser agents do not just need more practice. They need to practice the right things. We introduce MiniWeb, a realistic miniature of the web comprising 65 interconnected websites across 15 domains, where agents navigate, search, and transact as people do. Its 369 human-annotated tasks cover everyday workflows and label 37 reusable interaction primitives grouped into 7 skill families, allowing us to diagnose which skills fail rather than only whether a task succeeds. Benchmarking ten open-weight agents, we find that drag & gesture is consistently the weakest family, with no agent solving more than 24% of its instances. To address this gap, we introduce MiniWebGen, a framework that autonomously generates verified, skill-centric training data from MiniWeb. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 3.1K verified trajectories improves single-primitive success by 24.9pp across 13 unseen websites, with gains across every skill family. However, these trajectories teach short-horizon interactions, which do not directly translate to full-task success. We build on this result with MiniWebAgent, which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes full tasks into the skill-level steps it learned to perform. This approach improves task success by 19.4pp points on unseen MiniWeb sites and transfers to external benchmarks, with gains of 9.3pp on WebArena-Lite, 16.1pp on Online-Mind2Web, and 20.0pp on WebVoyager, without training on their trajectories. We provide a simple recipe for compact browser agents: practice reusable skills directly, then compose them to solve unfamiliar tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 回想基本知识:一般网络代理人的技巧-儿科方法
articles.content_zh: 浏览器代理不只是需要更多的练习 。 他们需要练习正确的东西。 我们推出MiniWeb, 由65个互联网站组成, 它的369个人工附加任务涵盖日常工作流程,并标出37个可重复使用的互动原始数据,分为7个技能家庭,使我们能够判断哪些技能失败,而不仅仅是一项任务是否成功。 以10个开放重量级的代理商为基准,我们发现拖放和手势始终是最弱的家族,没有代理商解决超过24%的个案。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了MiniWebGen,这个框架可以自主地从MiniWeb生成经过核实的以技能为中心的培训数据. 精细调整 Quen3.5-4B 仅 3.1K 经核实的轨迹 通过24.9pp 通过13个不见踪影的网站 提高单项成功率 然而,这些轨迹传授了短视的相互作用,并不直接转化为全任务的成功. 我们利用这个结果与MiniWebAgent合作,后者将训练有素的执行者与一个将全部任务分解为它所学会的技能级步骤的规划者配对。 这种方法提高了任务成功率,在不见踪影的MiniWeb网址上达到了19.4pp点,并转至外部基准,在WebArena-Lite上取得了9.3pp分,在Online-Mind2Web上取得了16.1pp分,在WebVoyager上取得了20.0pp分,但没有对其轨迹进行培训。 我们为紧凑浏览器代理提供简单的食谱:直接练习可再用技能,再作曲解决不熟悉的任务.

articles.title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
articles.content: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don't appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Pretrainings Knows what, Simulation teachs how: Sim-Trained Robot Agent中的组成概论 预训知道什么,模拟教导如何:在Sim-Trained Robot Agent中构成概论
articles.content_zh: 一个机器人政策需要了解一个场景中的任务要求是什么,以及如何移动机器人来完成这个任务. 为了实现这两种技能,我们引入了"零现实"(Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP)),这个配方教给一个小的现成的视觉语言模型,通过简单的工具吊带来控制机器人. 我们使用一个预先训练的27B参数模型来引导世界的理解和推理,然后在简单的模拟任务上进行有监督的微调和GPRO,教它如何移动机器人. ZAP在训练期间没有任何真实世界的机器人数据,在真实世界的任务上达到了96.7%的成功率,匹配了GPT-6 Astra在我们的操纵上,并且比"Molmo Act2 VLA"(33.3%)的成绩要好,同时运行速度快于GPT-6 Astra的3x和17x更便宜. 我们证明,ZAP也通过在架子上放入一个测试管(并在被催促时在架子上选择另一个孔口),在臂部中空之间发出测试管,在ttic-tac-toe板上画出一个X来概括到全新的物体,目标,策略和语言,并下棋. 我们的训练数据中没有这些目标和操控类型。 此外,ZAP还转移到一个看不见的化身。 在单臂Franka上,ZAP在RoboLab-120上达到55.9%,比VLA/WAM的领先基线提前了4.9个百分点.

articles.title: Multimodal Concert Video Editing: System Design and Exploratory Evaluation
articles.content: Editing multi-camera concerts requires coordinated decisions about musical relevance, visual quality and cut timing. We present a modular framework that combines instrument activity from multitrack audio, visible instruments and image sharpness with beat-based timing and probabilistic camera selection. An interpretable scoring model links these components to the choice of views over complete shot intervals. Component tests and an exploratory expert study on a four-camera concert yield mixed assessments across the editing variants. The findings motivate extending local audiovisual relevance with contextual and sequence-level criteria. The architecture provides a basis for testing these extensions and studying how component behaviour affects the quality of complete edits.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多模式音乐会视频编辑:系统设计和探索评价
articles.content_zh: 编辑多相机演唱会需要对音乐的相关性,视觉质量和剪接时间做出协调的决定. 我们提出了一个模块框架,将多轨道音频、可见仪器和图像锐度的仪器活动与基于节拍的计时和概率相机选择结合起来。 一个可解释的评分模型将这些组件与在完全相距上选择视图联系起来. 关于四相机音乐会的组成部分测试和探索性专家研究在编辑变体中得出了混合评估。 这些调查结果促使人们根据背景和顺序标准,扩大地方视听的相关性。 该架构为测试这些扩展并研究组件行为如何影响完整编辑的质量提供了基础.

articles.title: Does VGGT Know What It Does Not Know?
articles.content: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT regress cameras and geometry in a single forward pass, but they report no uncertainty for the camera poses they predict: an incorrect relative pose looks no different from a correct one. We ask whether the frozen model nonetheless knows when its pose is wrong. On HardMatch, a benchmark of 1,000 deliberately difficult image pairs on which VGGT fails on 35% of pairs, a linear probe on VGGT's frozen features predicts pose failure on held-out categories with ROC-AUC 93.5%, compared with 79.7% for VGGT's own point-map confidence and 77.7% for a classifier trained on all of VGGT's outputs. The probe catches failures VGGT is confident about, lets a downstream system abstain on the pairs it distrusts, and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500, beyond what co-visibility explains. This knowledge is absent from the per-image encoder: it is computed partway through the layers that fuse the two views, and the same holds for a second model, $π^3$. In essence, we find that VGGT knows more about its own failures than it reports.

articles.title_zh: VGGT 会吗? 知道它不知道什么吗?
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward 3D重建模型,如VGGT倒置相机和几何相机在一个单向前传中,但他们报告相机没有不确定性,他们提出预测:不正确的相对相机外观与正确的相机外观没有区别. 我们问被冻结的模型是否知道何时其姿势是错误的。 在HardMatch上,一个1000个故意困难的图像对的基准,VGGT在35%的对子上失败了,一个对VGGT被冻结特性的线性探测器预测,用ROC-AUC93.5%的被搁置类别会构成失败,而VGGT自己的点映射置信度为79.7%,一个接受过VGGT所有输出培训的分类器为77.7%. 探测器捕捉到故障 VGGT 有信心, 让下游系统放弃它不信任的对子, 每一图像编码器都缺少这种知识:它是通过连接两种观点的分层来计算出来的,第二种模型也一样,即3美元。 从本质上来说,我们发现VGGT比它报道的更了解自己的失败.

articles.title: Improving Signals, Declining Encoder: A Known-Answer Test of Label-Free Monitoring in Self-Supervised Learning
articles.content: Self-supervised training is monitored without labels, through the loss and statistics of the learned features. We report a case where we know the encoders lost part of what they had learned, so we can check whether these signals noticed. We trained LeJEPA encoders on synthetic images with known generating factors. In nine of ten seeds, the readability of those factors fell abruptly and stayed down, nearly always along the same direction in factor space. Meanwhile the loss kept falling, and most of the eleven label-free signals we tracked kept improving and rated the declining runs better than runs that did not decline. Standard change-point detection rarely flagged the decline near its onset, and selecting checkpoints by these signals mostly chose ones after it.

articles.title_zh: 改进信号,减少编码器:已知的回答 在自我监督学习中进行无标签监测测试
articles.content_zh: 自我监督的培训通过学习特征的损失和统计,在没有标签的情况下进行监测。 我们报告一个案件 我们知道编码器 失去了他们学到的部分, 所以我们可以检查这些信号是否注意到。 我们用已知的生成因素对LeJEPA编码器进行了合成图像的培训。 在10个种子中的9个种子中,这些因素的可读性突然下降并一直下降,几乎总是沿着因素空间的相同方向走。 与此同时,损失持续下降,我们追踪到的11个无标签信号大多不断改进,并评分下降的跑数优于没有下降的跑数。 标准变点探测很少显示下降接近开始,这些信号选择的检查站大多是其后的检查站。

articles.title: VidEdit3D: Flexible 3D Gaussian Editing with Video Diffusion
articles.content: Recent advancements in text-guided 3D editing, particularly with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), have shown promise but still lag behind the flexibility of 2D editing tools. Existing methods face a critical trade-off between preserving multi-view consistency and allowing structural modifications. Image-based editors can also struggle to apply the intended edit to objects viewed from unusual angles. To address these limitations, we introduce VidEdit3D, a framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task. By drawing a parallel between camera movement in static 3D scenes and temporal dynamics in video, we leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to encourage semantic and structural coherence across views. Specifically, we propose Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) to select informative keyframes and construct smooth video clips aligned with VDM input requirements. To propagate edits from an anchor view to these clips, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free framework incorporating an Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG) mechanism. ECG contrasts source and edited image conditions at a shared latent state, using scheduled source-image amplification to strengthen adherence to the edited reference while maintaining original scene context. Finally, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS) to strictly confine geometric and appearance updates to target primitives, reducing background attribute leakage. Experiments demonstrate stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than the baselines.

articles.title_zh: VidEdit3D:用视频传播的灵活3D高斯文编辑
articles.content_zh: 近期在以文字为指南的3D编辑方面的进步,特别是3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS),显示出了希望,但仍落后于2D编辑工具的灵活性. 现有方法在保持多视图一致性和允许结构修改之间面临关键的取舍。 基于图像的编辑器也可能在将预定的编辑应用到从不同寻常的角度所查看的对象上上上挣扎. 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了VidEdit3D,这个框架将3D场景编辑重新设定为基于轨迹的视频编辑任务. 通过在静态3D场景中的相机运动和视频中的时间动力学之间画出一个平行,我们利用预先训练的视频传播模型(VDMs)的强势的spatiotimal前传,鼓励各种观点的语义和结构一致性. 具体地说,我们提议采用 " Tropjectory-Guided Redowering " (TGR)来选择信息化的键框,并构建符合VDM输入要求的平滑视频剪辑. 为了将编辑从主播视图传播到这些剪辑,我们开发了Flow-Accessed Video Edition(FAVE),这是一个包含编辑一致性指导(ECG)机制的无培训框架. ECG在共享潜伏状态下对比出源和被编辑的图像条件,使用计划源图像放大来强化对被编辑的参考的遵守,同时保持原景上下文. 最后,我们引入了Region-Selective 3DGS Finalment(RS-GS),严格将几何和外观更新限制在目标原始人,减少背景属性泄漏. 实验显示,比起基线,指令更加一致,多视图一致性更好.

articles.title: A Category-Selective Encryption Framework for Privacy Protection of UAV Images
articles.content: Imagery captured by unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems increasingly raises privacy concerns, as UAV aerial surveillance routinely captures sensitive objects such as pedestrians and vehicles alongside ordinary scene content. Existing privacy-preserving approaches typically employ class-agnostic saliency detection to indiscriminately obfuscate all visually salient regions, leading to unnecessary information loss and hindering downstream scene analysis. This paper proposes a category-selective encryption framework for privacy-preserving UAV surveillance. The core advance over prior class-agnostic approaches is semantic-level selectivity: the system first recognizes what is present in the scene via an 80-class detector, then encrypts only user-specified sensitive categories while leaving non-sensitive objects and background intact for downstream analytics. The framework supports two complementary encryption schemes: Thumbnail-Preserving Encryption (TPE), which applies adaptive pixelation with a learnable blend parameter and recovers content through a jointly trained Enhanced U-Net, and XOR stream cipher encryption, which offers parameter-free, mathematically exact reversibility. The architectural design, composite loss formulation, and joint training methodology are presented in detail, establishing a foundation for practical privacy-preserving UAV surveillance that balances protection strength and scene utility.

articles.title_zh: 保护无人驾驶飞行器图像隐私的类别选择加密框架
articles.content_zh: 无人驾驶飞行器(无人驾驶飞行器)系统所捕获的图像越来越引起隐私问题,因为无人驾驶飞行器空中监视经常会将行人和车辆等敏感物体同普通场景内容一并捕获。 现有的隐私保护办法通常采用阶级不可知的显著性检测方法来不分青红皂白地混淆所有视觉突出区域,导致不必要的信息丢失并妨碍下游场景分析。 本文为保密无人驾驶航空器监控提出了分类选择性加密框架. 之前的类不可知方法的核心进步是语义层面的选择性:系统首先通过80级探测器识别出场景中存在的东西,然后加密的只是用户指定的敏感类别,同时将非敏感对象和背景完好无损地留给下游分析. 该框架支持两个互补的加密方案:Thambnail-Preading Encryption(TPE),它应用可学习的混合参数的适应像素,并通过联合训练的增强U-Net恢复内容;和XOR流密码,它提供了参数无参数,数学精确可逆性. 详细介绍了建筑设计、综合损失配方和联合培训方法,为实际保护隐私的无人驾驶航空器监视打下基础,兼顾保护强度和场景效用。

articles.title: MatAnyone-E: Sparse Memory Propagation for Efficient High-Resolution Video Matting
articles.content: High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames. Memory-based methods achieve strong matting quality by matching current-frame features with information stored from earlier frames, but this process becomes increasingly costly as resolution grows. We present MatAnyone-E, an efficient extension of MatAnyone 2 that focuses computation where it is most needed. Our approach first performs low-resolution propagation to identify uncertain regions that require closer inspection and the memory candidates most relevant to them. It then performs high-resolution matching only for these regions using the selected memory, while reusing low-resolution matching results elsewhere. This strategy reduces both the number of locations requiring detailed matching and the amount of memory searched, while preserving the information needed to produce a complete matte. We further reduce the cost of generating high-resolution mattes with a lightweight decoder designed around measured runtime bottlenecks and trained to reproduce the original decoder's representations. Experiments show that MatAnyone-E maintains matting quality comparable to MatAnyone 2 while achieving an estimated 7.4x inference speedup and reducing peak GPU memory usage to 7.6% of the usage of MatAnyone 2 at 4K. With compilation-enabled inference on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, it reaches 73.07 FPS at 1080p and 28.62 FPS at 4K.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MatAnyone-E:高效高分辨率视频编审的 sparse 内存宣传
articles.content_zh: 高分辨的视频交配需要保存细细的细节,如发线和软透明,同时保持跨帧的一致性. 基于内存的方法通过将当前帧特征与从更早的帧所储存的信息相匹配来达到强烈的搭配质量,但随着分辨率的增加,这一过程变得日益昂贵. 我们介绍MatAnyone-E,这是MatAnyone 2的有效扩展,它把计算重点放在最需要的地方。 我们的方法首先进行低分辨率的传播,以查明需要更密切检查的不确定区域以及与其最相关的记忆候选人。 然后它只使用所选的内存对这些区域进行高分辨率匹配,同时在其他地方使用低分辨率匹配结果. 这一策略既会减少需要详细匹配的地点数量,也会减少所搜索的内存数量,同时会保存生成完整mate所需的信息. 我们进一步降低产生高分辨率的垫子的成本,并用一个轻量级的解码器来设计围绕所测量的运行时间瓶颈,并经过训练来复制原始解码器的表示. 实验显示,MatAnyone-E保持了与MatAnyone 2相仿的交配质量,同时实现了估计的7.4x推论速度并将顶峰GPU内存使用率降低到4K时MatAnyone 2的7.6%. 通过对单NVIDIA H200 GPU的编译推论,在1080p时达到73.07FPS,在4K时达到28.62FPS.

articles.title: Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3-3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 线程: 跳过、 Skim 或 精细的视频传播变形器中的注意牌
articles.content_zh: 超过数以万计的视觉符号引起注意,在视频传播变压器(DiTs)的推论中占主导地位. 现有方法通过相接性,低精度,或两者兼而有之来来降低这一成本,但对所有所保存的瓷砖使用单一精度. 我们观察到,由近似法引入的输出出错在不同的瓦片中差异很大. 许多瓦片可以略出小错误来跳出,其他的则必须计算,但获得的却很少超出低精度,少数甚至保留了低精度的重大错误. 我们提出Triage,一种免训练的注意方法,它分配出三个相近分层中的每个瓦片:通过用它的块来取而代之来跳过它,在NVFP4中去掉它,或者用NVFP4剩余校正来取精. 轻量级路由器从块统计中预测出每块下每块出错,只有在预测出错的减少证明额外计算合理时,才将一砖移动到更准确的地级,而以单一价格来决定这种取舍. 一个被熔化的内核在单传中执行所有三层,在RTX Blackwell GPU的FP4收音机核心上执行. 穿越Wan2.2,HunyuanVideo,和LTX-2.5,Triage在密集闪存上加速了最高2.32x的端到端生成,在5个环境中,每个环境运行速度都快于每个基线,同时达到比最高的PSNR基线高0.3-3.0分贝.

articles.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
articles.content: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OmniShowcase: 由多维图像生成的Omnidiction主题相容视频
articles.content_zh: 当相机显示输入中看不到的表面时,从几个参考图像中生成特定主题的视频仍然具有挑战性. 早期的主题到视频(S2V)方法以单一的参考图像为条件,因此必须推断主体的不见外观和几何学随着视角的变化而变化. 为了解决这一局限性,最近的方法将S2V扩展至多处参考观点,从不同的角度提供更多有关这一主题的信息. 然而,它们并没有明确规定连接这些观测结果的3D结构. 此外,现有培训数据不能保证观点变化保留同一基本3D主题。 我们介绍基于两个组成部分的OmniSshowcase:(一) 一个完全自动化的数据合成管道,它沿着不同的相机轨迹制作培训录像,视线变化由基本主题几何驱动,甚至跨越了完整的360度轨道;(二) 一个几何调节方法,为视频模型提供一个从参考视图中重建的地表常态地图的转盘,而不需要与生成的相框同步的时间。 我们构建了Showcase-4K, 一组基于3D的视频, 涵盖八十八个轨迹配置的十二个相机运动, 以及重建产生的地表常态, 实验显示最先进的主题身份和3D一致性,同时保持有竞争力的视频质量和运动. 项目页面: justin4ai.github.io/OmniSshowcase

articles.title: Printed and Scanned: Exposing the Fragility of Single-Image Morphing Attack Detectors under Print-Scan Degradation
articles.content: Face morphing attacks, in which the biometric traits of two or more identities are blended into a single face image, pose a severe threat to identity document issuance and automated border control. Consequently, a large body of work has proposed Single-image Morphing Attack Detection (S-MAD) algorithms and benchmarked them on datasets such as SYN-MAD22. However, the majority of these benchmarks operate exclusively in the digital domain, which contrasts with the real-world passport issuance pipeline in some countries, which still requires an applicant-supplied photograph to be printed and subsequently re-scanned before it is embedded in the identity document or fed into an automated verification system. This print-scan step introduces halftoning, resampling, color-space, and sensor noise that are absent from digital pipelines, and may mask the high-frequency artifacts that S-MAD models rely on. In this work, we introduce a print-scan version of the SYN-MAD22 dataset, obtained by printing and re-scanning all bona fide and morphed images at 300 and 600 DPI, and we use it to evaluate eight state-of-the-art S-MAD models trained exclusively on digital data. We additionally repeat the acquisition with a second scanner to assess cross-device robustness. Our results show that detectors that achieve near state-of-the-art performance in the digital domain suffer a more than threefold increase in average equal error rate, with the same qualitative degradation observed across both scanning devices, exposing a critical, previously under-reported gap between digital-benchmark performance and robustness to print-scan degradation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 印刷和扫描:在印刷-扫描降解下展示单图像成像攻击探测器的脆弱性
articles.content_zh: 脸部变形攻击将两个或两个以上身份的生物特征混入一个面相图像,对身份证件的签发和自动边境管制构成严重威胁。 因此,一大批工作都提出了单相模攻击检测(S-MAD)算法,并以SYN-MAD22等数据集作为基准。 然而,这些基准大多完全在数字领域运作,这与一些国家的现实世界护照发放管道形成对比,后者仍要求申请人提供的照片被打印并随后被重新扫描后才能被嵌入身份证件或输入自动核查系统. 这个平面扫描步骤引入了数字管所没有的半调子,再生,色相空间和传感器噪声,可能掩盖了S-MAD模型所依赖的高频文物. 在这项工作中,我们引入了SYN-MAD22数据集的打印扫描版,通过印刷和重新扫描300和600 DPI的所有善意和外形图像而获得,我们利用它来评价专门接受数字数据培训的8个最先进的S-MAD模型。 我们还用第二台扫描仪重复采购,以评估交叉设备的坚固性。 我们的结果显示,在数字领域实现近乎最先进性能的探测器平均等效出错率增加了三倍多,在两个扫描设备中都观察到同样的质量退化,暴露出数字基准性能与印刷扫描退化的强度之间的重要差距。

articles.title: CounterFlow: Target-Conditioned Flow Matching for Visual Counterfactuals
articles.content: In eXplainable AI, counterfactual explanations have gained significant traction by offering users direct, intuitive, and actionable insights into model decisions. We introduce CounterFlow, a novel framework based on Conditional Flow Matching that generates visual counterfactual explanations by directly steering a source image toward a user-specified target class. By leveraging target-conditioned vector fields, CounterFlow identifies highly realistic semantic modifications while requiring substantially lower computational overhead than traditional GAN- or diffusion-based architectures. Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CounterFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both visual realism and target class switching. By working directly in the raw pixel space, CounterFlow offers a more practical solution for real-world deployment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 逆向:目标符合条件 图像反事实的流量匹配
articles.content_zh: 在可解释的AI中,反事实解释通过向用户提供直接、直觉和可操作的对示范决定的洞察力而获得了很大的吸引力。 我们引入了"逆流"(Contitional Flow),一个基于"条件相匹配"(Contitional Flow Matching)的新框架,通过直接将源图像引导到用户指定的目标类来生成视觉反事实解释. 通过利用目标有条件的矢量字段,ContableFlow识别出高度现实的语义修改,同时需要比传统的GAN或传播架构低得多的计算间接费用. 对标准基准的实证评价表明,CounterFlow在视觉现实主义和目标类切换中都实现了最先进的性能. 通过直接在原始像素空间工作,ContableFlow为现实世界的部署提供了更实用的解决方案.

articles.title: VPR-Space: A Benchmark for Visual Place Recognition in Space Analog Domains
articles.content: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is an important means for loop closure detection in visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While state-of-the-art VPR and SLAM approaches excel in urban and feature-rich natural environments, the vast and feature-poor environments of extraterrestrial surfaces like on the Moon or Mars pose severe challenges for existing approaches. This paper presents a novel benchmark, VPR-Space, to evaluate VPR capabilities on extraterrestrial surfaces. There are three contributions: (1) We collected sixteen VPR database-query datasets based on existing data from Space Analog Domains (SAD), terrestrial environments that resemble properties of the Moon or Mars. The collection includes a range of challenges regarding environment, viewpoint change, and illumination conditions. (2) To address the ill-posed nature of VPR, we propose a novel approach to generate the ground-truth information in VPR benchmarks. Instead of defining that a query and datbase image show the same place if and only if their camera poses are within fixed position and viewing direction thresholds, we propose to make the decision dependent on whether the match would be valuable in the downstream SLAM task. To avoid the overhead and restrictions of evaluating VPR in-the-loop within SLAM systems, we provide VPR ground-truth (GT) matrices based on the performance of an ensemble of state-of-the-art Relative Pose Estimators (RPE). Under this GT we require a VPR method to identify exactly those image pairs for which a subsequently applied RPE is expected to provide a valuable pose estimate in a SLAM context. (3) We evaluated nine state-of-the-art VPR approaches. The results show considerable room for improvement and indicate directions for future research. We provide a pre-release version of the dataset on github: $\texttt{https://github.com/rfechner/VPR-Space}$

articles.title_zh: VPR-Space:空间领域视觉位置识别基准
articles.content_zh: Visual Place识别(VPR)是视觉同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)中环闭检测的重要手段. 虽然最先进的VPR和SAMM方法在城市和地物丰富的自然环境中表现优异,但月球或火星等地外地表的广阔和地物贫瘠的环境对现有方法构成严重挑战。 本文提出了一个新的基准"VPR-Space",用于评价地外地表的VPR能力. 有三项贡献: (1) 我们根据空间模拟域(SAD)的现有数据收集了16个VPR数据库 -- -- query数据集,地面环境类似于月球或火星的特性。 该汇编包括环境、观点变化和照明条件方面的一系列挑战。 (2) 为解决自愿评估报告的不合理性质,我们建议采用新的方法,在自愿评估报告基准中提供地面真实信息。 与其定义查询和 Datbase 图像显示相同位置, 且只有在相机的相机姿势处于固定位置和查看方向阈值时, 我们提议根据匹配在下游 SAM 任务中是否有价值来决定。 为了避免在SLAM系统内评价自愿评估报告时出现间接费用和限制,我们提供基于最先进的相对Pose估算仪(RPE)的性能的自愿评估报告地面实况矩阵。 在这个GT下,我们要求一种VPR方法来准确识别那些随后应用的RPE将在SLAM背景下提供有价值的外观估计的图像对. (3)我们评价了9个最新版本的自愿评估报告方法。 结果显示了相当大的改进余地并指明了未来研究的方向。 我们提供了在github上的数据集的预发版本:$\textt{https://github.com/rfechner/VPR-Space}$

articles.title: SeeRF: Learning to See Beyond Fields of View via Generative Image Registration and Fusion
articles.content: Due to the inherent discrepancies in imaging viewpoints and field-of-view mismatches among multi-modal sensors, existing fusion methods have long struggled to achieve complete scene-level information integration beyond the limitation in sensor fields of view. Consequently, the generated fusion results often contain modality-specific regions and fusion artifacts, limiting the comprehensive representation of scene structures and semantic information. To address this challenge, we propose a generative registration-fusion framework, termed SeeRF. Specifically, it first introduces a deformation generation strategy based on the diffeomorphic stationary velocity field, combined with visual foundation model-guided feature extraction and a coarse-to-fine progressive multi-modal image registration module, to achieve accurate cross-modal flow estimation and generate valid field-of-view masks. Subsequently, the registration module is tightly coupled with the generative diffusion module for multi-modal completion and fusion, where the cross-modal control encoding module and the control residual feature encoder-decoder mechanism provide effective guidance. By leveraging the powerful prior modeling capability of generative diffusion models, the proposed framework overcomes the limitations imposed by shared fields of view and enables effective completion and natural fusion of non-overlapping field-of-view regions. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets and real-world scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance, validating its effectiveness, superiority, and robustness. The code will be available at https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF.

articles.title_zh: SeeRF:通过 Generative 图像注册和融合来学习查看视野以外的领域
articles.content_zh: 由于多模式传感器在成像观点和视场不匹配方面存在内在差异,现有的聚变方法长期以来一直在努力实现完全的场景级信息集成,超出了传感器视场的限制. 因此,产生的聚变结果往往含有特定模式的区域和聚变文物,限制了场景结构和语义信息的全面体现. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出了一个基因登记-储存框架,称为SeeRF。 具体地说,它首先引入了以二相平面平面平面速度场为基础的变形生成策略,结合了视觉地基模型-制导地物提取和粗糙到精细的渐进式多模式图像注册模块,以实现准确的跨模式流估计并生成有效的视野场口罩. 随后,注册模块与多模式完成和聚变的基因扩散模块紧密结合,其中跨模式控制编码模块和控制剩余特征编码器-解码器机制提供了有效的指导. 通过利用基因传播模型的强大前置模型能力,拟议框架克服了共享视野所施加的限制,并使得非重叠视野区域能够有效完成和自然地融合。 对多种公共数据集和现实世界情景的广泛实验表明,拟议方法取得了优异的性能,验证其有效性,优越性和稳健性. 该代码可在https://github.com/XunpengYi/SeeRF上查阅。

articles.title: Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark: A mechanically annotated dataset for evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction
articles.content: Evaluating deformable 3D reconstruction requires ground truth linking camera motion, surface deformation, material correspondence and image appearance. We introduce the Synthetic Deformable Tubular Benchmark, generated with LumenMorph, an open-source toolkit for creating, annotating and evaluating tubular scenes. The release contains 5,580 RGB images. Its baseline crosses three surface-motion conditions with moving and stationary cameras in six scene families; matched appearance variants cover only moving-camera finite-element actions in four families. Documented public and evaluation interfaces expose camera poses, geometry, depth, deformation fields, persistent material correspondences and discrete finite-element records. Persistent triangle identities and material weights let users track the same surface location across frames and query its three-dimensional trajectory. Separately implemented geometric and mechanical checks assess annotation consistency with the generating models. Structure-from-motion, optical-flow and supplied-geometry displacement-interpolation studies demonstrate how the resource distinguishes registration coverage from geometric accuracy, exposes camera- and surface-motion effects, and tests the benefits and mismatch of mechanical priors. Public readers, evaluation contracts and the configurable generator support reuse and extension. Data integrity, fixed-environment repeatability and retained-prediction score replay have distinct verification scopes. The benchmark provides a controlled synthetic reference without claiming anatomical or clinical realism.

articles.title_zh: 合成可变形管基准: 用于评价可变形 三维重建的机械附加说明数据集
articles.content_zh: 评价可变形的3D重建需要地面真能连接相机运动,地表变形,材料对应和图像外观. 我们引入了由LumenMorph生成的合成可变色管基准,这是一个用于创建、注释和评估管状场景的开源工具包。 该版包含5,580个RGB图像. 其基线跨越了6个场景家庭的3个地表移动条件和固定相机;相匹配的外观变体仅涵盖4个家庭的移动相机有限要素行动。 有记录的公众和评价界面暴露出相机外观、几何、深度、变形场、持续的材料通信以及离散的有限要素记录。 持续的三角形特征和物质重量使用户能够跟踪同一地表位置跨帧并查询其三维轨迹. 单独实施的几何和机械检查评估与生成模型的注释一致性. 结构 -- -- 从运动、光学 -- -- 流和供应 -- -- 几何相位移 -- -- 插入研究显示,资源如何将登记覆盖面与几何精确度区分开来,暴露出相机和地表 -- -- 运动效应,并检验机械前科的好处和不匹配。 公共阅读器,评价合同和可配置发电机支持再利用和扩展. 数据完整性、固定环境可重复性和保留预测分数重放具有不同的核查范围。 该基准提供了一个不受控制的合成参考,而不主张解剖学或临床现实论.

articles.title: RoboDoctor: Training-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Robot Policies
articles.content: Generalist robot policies and language-model agents provide complementary capabilities, but completing a task also requires adapting their use to the consequences of physical interaction. We study execution as a locus of adaptation: feedback guides the current action and supplies evidence for revising subsequent decisions under fixed model weights. We introduce RoboDoctor, a training-free framework that connects diagnosis, grounded action, and persistent experience across three revision targets. The harness allocates control between policy and agent; intervention determines when to assist while preserving useful policy behavior; and operation refines physical methods through observed effects. Linked experience records retain the reason for a decision, the attempted method, its outcome, and conditions for reuse. On a curated archive of 54 RoboDojo-Sim task entries, RoboDoctor achieves a five-dimension mean score of 57.10, with a native success rate of 49.44%. Recorded interactions illustrate strategy changes, selective correction, and grasp revision. These findings characterize execution-time adaptation in the evaluated system; controlled trials remain necessary to isolate the contribution of cross-episode experience.

articles.title_zh: 机器人医生:机器人政策培训自由自我改进
articles.content_zh: 通用机器人政策和语言模型代理提供互补能力,但完成一项任务还需要调整其用途以适应物理相互作用的后果. 我们研究将执行作为适应的一个中心:反馈指导当前的行动,并提供证据,以便根据固定的模型权重修订随后的决定。 我们引入了Robo Doctor,这是一个无培训框架,它将诊断、有根据的行动和持续的经验联系起来,贯穿三个修订目标。 控制手段在政策和代理人之间分配控制;干预决定何时协助,同时保留有用的政策行为;操作通过所观察到的效果来完善物理方法. 相关经验记录保留了作出决定的理由、尝试方法、结果和再利用的条件。 在54个"RoboDojo-Sim"任务条目的整理档案上,"RoboDoctor"实现了"5分"的平均得分57.10分,本土成功率为49.44%. 记录下来的相互作用说明战略的改变、选择性的更正和把握修正。 这些结论是评价系统中执行时间调整的特点;控制下的审判仍然是孤立跨周期经验贡献的必要条件。

articles.title: Beyond Distribution Matching: Self-Supervised Representation Forcing for Few-Step Video Generation
articles.content: Few-step distillation is essential for deploying modern video diffusion models. Among existing approaches, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a highly promising paradigm by achieving strong output-space fidelity without adversarial training, while remaining flexible across various student architectures. We observe, however, that DMD fundamentally relies on an output-space objective, lacking explicit regularization on the model's internal representations. As the distillation step count aggressively shrinks, this output-only supervision becomes insufficient, causing the distilled student to degrade in both fine-grained spatial structures and coherent temporal dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Self Flow Forcing (SF$^2$), which incorporates a predictive representation loss into the DMD framework without altering its output objective. By providing the student and an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) teacher with heterogeneous noise levels, we establish an information asymmetry. This formulation forces the student to predict the teacher's internal representations from a more corrupted input, effectively integrating self-supervised representation alignment into distribution matching. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SF$^2$ effectively mitigates temporal flickering and consistently improves both spatial fidelity and motion quality. Furthermore, the proposed mechanism is architecture-agnostic - seamlessly supporting both bidirectional and causal models - and requires no external feature extractors, introducing minimal computational overhead.

articles.title_zh: 分布范围以外 匹配: 为少部分视频生成进行自我监督代理
articles.content_zh: 少步分馏对于部署现代视频传播模型至关重要。 在现有的办法中,分配匹配消化(DMD)已成为一个很有希望的范例,在没有对抗性培训的情况下实现强大的产出-空间忠诚,同时在各学生结构中保持灵活性。 然而,我们注意到,多哈部长宣言从根本上依赖于产出-空间目标,对该模式的内部表述缺乏明确的正规化。 随着蒸馏步骤的急剧收缩,这种只输出的监管变得不足,使被蒸馏的学生在精细的空间结构和连贯的时间动态中退化. 为解决这一限制,我们引入了自流强制(SF ^2美元),在不改变产出目标的情况下,将预测性代表损失纳入DMD框架。 通过向学生和一位指示移动平均(EMA)教师提供不同噪音水平,我们建立了信息不对称。 这种提法迫使学生从更腐败的输入中预测出老师的内部代表,有效地将自我监督的代表配对整合到分配配对中. 广泛的实验表明,SF2美元有效缓解了时间闪烁,并持续地提高空间忠诚度和运动质量。 此外,拟议的机制具有结构不可知性,无缝地支持双向模型和因果模型,不需要外部特征提取器,采用最低限度的计算间接费用。

articles.title: Hyperspectral Unmixing using a Structured Linear Mixing Model with Additive Spectral Variability
articles.content: Linear hyperspectral unmixing aims at retrieving pure material spectra present in an observed scene and their associated abundance fractions in each pixel. In most practical situations, hyperspectral images are affected by spectral variability (SV) also known as intra-class variability, which is caused by different physical phenomena including atmospheric effects, intrinsic variability of the pure materials and illumination or topographic changes. Nevertheless, the standard hyperspectral unmixing methods that rely on the Linear Mixing Model (LMM) do not consider these phenomena. Thus, neglecting them will spread errors throughout the linear hyperspectral unmixing process. To avoid this problem, this paper proposes two hyperspectral unmixing algorithms dedicated to a parametric model called Structured Additive Variability LMM (SAV-LMM). This mixing model handles SV in an additive manner by incorporating two terms into the standard LMM. Moreover, the designed algorithms are based on Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and optimize a cost function which integrates additional penalization accounting for SV. Furthermore, a novel improved initialization scheme, which takes SV into account, is proposed. Experiments conducted on both synthetic and real datasets show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for linearly unmixing hyperspectral images with SV compared to the tested state-of-the-art methods.

articles.title_zh: 超光谱 使用结构化线性混合模型和可增生光谱变化性
articles.content_zh: 线性超光谱解相旨在取回所观测到的场景中存在的纯物质光谱及其在每个像素中的相关丰度分数. 在大多数实际情况下,超光谱图像会受光谱可变性(SV)所影响,这种可变性也被称为类内可变性,由不同的物理现象所引起,包括大气效应,纯材料的内在可变性和照明或地貌变化等. 尽管如此,依赖线性混音模型(LMM)的标准超光谱解相方法并没有考虑这些现象. 因此,忽略它们会在整个线性超光谱解相过程中散布出错误. 为了避免这个问题,本文提出两个超光谱解相算法,专门用于一个叫"结构添加性变相LMM"(SAV-LMM)的参数模型. 这种混合模型通过将两个术语纳入标准的LMM,以添加剂的方式处理SV. 此外,所设计的算法以非负矩阵因子化(NMF)为基础,并优化了成本函数,将SV的额外惩罚核算整合在一起. 此外,还提议采用新的改进的初始化计划,其中考虑到特别志愿人员。 在合成数据集和真实数据集上进行的实验显示,与所测试的先进方法相比,拟议算法在线性无相混合高光谱图像与SV之间的有效性.

articles.title: Copying As Defense: Protecting Images from Editing By Eliciting Model Copying
articles.content: Image editors built on diffusion transformers (DiTs), such as Flux Kontext, make it possible to turn a single photograph into a convincing manipulated image, including harmful and non-consensual edits. Proactive defenses aim to prevent such manipulations by adding an imperceptible perturbation before an image is shared. Existing defenses for DiT-based in-context editors make the output attend less to the protected reference image. But this leaves the model free to follow the edit instruction using the text and its own generated tokens, often producing a new, weakly grounded image rather than preventing the edit. We find that the opposite strategy is more effective: instead of leading the model to ignore the reference, we encourage it to copy it. Through controlled attention interventions, we show that concentrating target-token attention on the reference image in only a few early blocks is sufficient to collapse the editing behavior, causing the model to reproduce its input, often as a lossy copy, rather than execute the requested transformation. Based on this insight, we introduce Copying-as-Defense (CaD), which maximizes per-token target-to-reference attention mass in early transformer blocks. Since attention rows are normalized, increasing reference attention suppresses the attention allocated to the text and generated canvas. Restricting the objective to early blocks also lets us truncate the backpropagation path, keeping optimization cheap. Across editors and benchmarks, CaD reduces average edit success from 81.4% on unprotected images to 24.0%, a 70.6% relative reduction, and by a further 44.3% relative to DeContext, the strongest baseline (43.0%). CaD is also roughly 1.8-2.0x faster per optimization step than comparable methods.

articles.title_zh: 复制为防卫:保护图像不受编辑 Elilening Model Copying
articles.content_zh: 在扩散变压器(DiTs)上所建的图像编辑器,如Flux Kontext,使得将一幅相片变成令人信服地被操纵的相片成为可能,包括有害和未经同意的编辑. 主动防御的目的在于防止这种操纵,在分享一幅图像之前增加一种难以察觉的扰动. 基于 DiT 的内文编辑器的现有防御使得输出较少关注被保护的参考图像. 但是这让模型可以自由地使用文本和它自己生成的符号来遵循编辑指令,经常产生一个新的,被弱地固定的图像,而不是阻止编辑. 我们认为,相反的战略是更有效的:我们不但没有引导模型忽略参考,反而鼓励它复制。 通过受控的注意力干预,我们显示,仅仅在几个早期的块中集中目标对参考图像的注意力,就足以使编辑行为崩溃,导致模型复制其输入,往往是作为失落的复制,而不是执行所请求的转换. 基于这种洞察力,我们引入了Copy-as-Defense (CaD),它使早期变压器块中每个托克目标到参考的注意力质量最大化. 由于关注行的常态化,越来越多的引用关注会抑制对文本和生成的画布的注意. 将目标限制在早期的区块上,也让我们缩短了后向传播路径,保持最便宜的优化. 在编辑和基准方面,CaD将平均编辑成功率从无保护图像的81.4%降至24.0%,相对减少70.6%,与最强基线DeContext相比,减少44.3%(43.0%)。 CaD的每个优化步骤大约也快于可比方法.

articles.title: Metric Scale for Insta360 Structure-from-Motion from the Camera's Embedded IMU
articles.content: Structure-from-motion (SfM) from the dual-fisheye video of a consumer 360-degree camera recovers geometry only up to a similarity transform; in the pipeline considered here, metric scale is obtained from smartphone ARKit or ARCore poses captured alongside the camera. This paper evaluates a self-contained alternative: the IMU embedded in the Insta360 X5 and X6, recorded at 1 kHz. The sensor is characterised (noise density, camera-IMU synchronisation, accelerometer scale factor, bias stability), the camera-IMU rotation and frame timing are estimated from the data, and the scale is recovered by a linear visual-inertial alignment over the SfM poses of a whole survey. The standard formulation, with gravity and accelerometer bias shared across the survey, overestimates the scale by 3.4% on average; estimating each contiguous segment independently and averaging removes the bias. On nine surveys with a co-mounted LiDAR scanner the inertial scale deviates from the LiDAR by 0.74% in mean absolute error, against 1.94% for the smartphone scale; on printed fiducial markers both agree within the 1% uncertainty of the target. On the reference trajectories of thirty sequences of a public benchmark, brought to scales of 1/40, 1 and 40, the estimator recovers the metric scale with a mean error of -0.07% and a standard deviation of 1.28%. On fifty production surveys where the smartphone is the only reference, the two scales agree to a standard deviation of 2.6%, the inertial scale being 0.9% lower on average; the difference does not depend on window construction, grows with the extent of the smartphone anchor, and cannot be attributed to either reference. An ablation over window construction and a comparison with monocular metric-depth networks complete the study.

articles.title_zh: 相机嵌入式 IMU 结构自动量表
articles.content_zh: 从消费360度相机的双鱼眼相机中取出的结构-自动(SfM)只恢复几何学,直至类似变相;在此考虑的管线中,从智能手机ARKit或ARCore与相机相接并被捕获的相机上取出可计量尺度. 本文评价自成一体的替代品:被嵌入Insta360 X5和X6的IMU被记录为1 kHz. 传感器具有特征(噪声密度,相机-IMU同步,加速计尺度因子,偏差稳定性),相机-IMU自转和相框定时由数据估算出,并用线性视觉-惯性相比于整个调查的SfM外观来回放. 标准配方与整个调查所共有的重力和加速计偏差,平均高估了比分3.4%;独立估计和平均估计每个相接部分可以消除偏差。 在使用同载LiDAR扫描仪的9个勘测中,惯性分级在平均绝对误差中偏离了LiDAR0.74%,而智能手机分级为1.94%;在印刷活性分级标记上,两者在目标1%的不确定性范围内都一致. 在公用基准的30个序列的参考轨迹上,计算器以1/40、1和40等比例计算,以-0.07%的平均误差和1.28%的标准偏差来恢复公用尺度。 在以智能手机为唯一参考的50个生产调查中,两个尺度都同意标准偏差为2.6%,惯性尺度平均低0.9%;差异不取决于窗口构造,随着智能手机锚地的大小而增长,不能归结于两个参考. 完成这项研究时,将窗外建筑和单体测量深度网络进行比较。

articles.title: EARS: Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and Motion for Budgeted Video Reasoning
articles.content: Uniform frame sampling can miss brief evidence in sparse-event videos when the VLM sees only K frames. We propose EARS (Evidence-Aware Retrieval via Sound and motion), a training-free, query-free front-end that ranks frames using optical-flow motion and audio energy, then applies temporal non-maximum suppression for diversity. The evidence score alone has frame-level AP 0.39; used only to select frames for the VLM, EARS with temporal diversity reaches localization AP 0.94, compared with 0.88 under Uniform sampling. In the updated matched study, at K = 1 EARS reaches XD-subset F1 0.660 versus 0.614 for centered Uniform (the paired interval includes zero); earlier backbone studies use separate protocols. On mostly-silent UCF-Crime, however, EARS slightly trails Uniform. A single configuration is used across both benchmarks; the new controls do not repeat the original held-out search. EARS therefore targets low-budget videos whose salient evidence aligns with motion or audio; on dense narratives or stealthy events, uniform or semantic selection remains preferable, and cheap modality statistics cannot reliably route between them. Code: https://github.com/mikeslin-ir/EARS

articles.title_zh: EARS: 通过声音和动议获取已编入预算的视频理由的证据-软件检索
articles.content_zh: 当VLM只看到K帧时,统一帧采样可能会在稀有事件视频中错过简短的证据. 我们提议采用EARS(通过声音和运动获取证据-软件),这是一种无培训、无查询的前端,它利用光学流动和音频能量排列帧,然后对多样性适用时间上非最大压制。 仅凭证据分数就有帧级AP 0.39;仅用于选择VLM的帧,有时间多样性的EARS达到本地化AP 0.94,而统一采样下则为0.88. 在更新的匹配研究中,在K = 1 EARS中达到XD-subset F1 0.660对0.614对中心制服(对接间隔包括0);更早的骨干研究使用单独的协议. 然而,在大多数沉默的UCF-Crime上,EARS略微跟随了United. 两种基准都使用单一的配置;新的控制不重复原先被搁置的搜索。 因此,EARS针对的是那些显著证据与动作或音频一致的低预算视频;对于密集的叙述或隐形事件,统一或语义选择仍然更可取,廉价模式统计无法可靠地在它们之间传递路径. 代码:https://github.com/mikeslin-ir/EARS

articles.title: WorldPager: Zero-Stall Tiered Memory for Long-Horizon World Models on a Single Consumer GPU
articles.content: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.

articles.title_zh: WorldPager:关于单消费者GPU的世界模式的零分层记忆
articles.content_zh: 互动世界模型将过去块的 KV 保留为检索内存,以便重新审视的地方保持一致。 在单个消费机上(1个RTX 4090,32个主机内存的GiB,1个NVMe SSD),带有这种内存的长会打出两面墙. 第一个是容量:Matrix-Game 2.0的KV在bf16的45秒视频后和int4的2.8分钟后会排出主机内存. 二是该型号的定位地平线为4.3分. 我们显示这个内存是容量约束而不是带宽约束,它的访问集在计算前是已知的,因为相机姿势是一种输入. 基于这些观测结果的分析模型预测溢出指向一块之内,在被搁置的配置上正确划分出零与非零的摊位. 在它的指导下,WorldPager将 int4 KV存储在了GPU/DRAM/NVMe的分级中,而不是重构它,预先从外推的外推姿势中检查出每个块的内存,永远不等待出错,并在后台写作;据我们所知,它是第一个将互动世界模型的KV内存放入了NVMe分级上并有"零上架"预取. 通过无训练位置处理,它以零档和恒定主机内存持续生成37.5分钟的视频,每秒约9.5帧. 在被封存的测试集上,int4存储显示没有可测量的质量损失;在长庚重访时,它将图像质量降低约一个MUSIQ点.

articles.title: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
articles.content: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. A compact 3D-native UV-volume tokenization keeps the joint sequence small as views are added, and a pose-aware stage refines geometry and texture by sampling per-voxel image features at the recovered camera poses. On Toys4k and GSO, for $4$ uncalibrated views, GenSfM improves novel-view PSNR by $3.2$-$4.5$ dB and reduces median Chamfer distance by $2.8$-$3.8\times$ over a strong native-3D generation baseline, while recovering input-view poses over $96\%$ Acc@$5^\circ$ without any external pose-estimation backbone, post-hoc optimization, or known intrinsics. Project page: https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

articles.title_zh: 由原生 3D 扩散运动产生的基因结构
articles.content_zh: 从少数未校正的视角中恢复物体的3D结构和相机运动是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题. 经典结构从运动方法中恢复与输入图像相符合的三维几何,但无法在看不见的区域恢复;本土生成方法产生了与输入图像相关但不一定忠实的可信三维对象. 简单调和再生和生成的方法允许错误跨出两个阶段,而不是产生一个与分布和输入一致的3D对象。 我们提出GENSfM,将基于图像的3D重建与本土的3D传播模型相融合. 特别是,我们使用多模式扩散变压器,在共同的自觉性下,共同将外观潜伏的形状和外观形成潜伏的形状;在观测到的视角中将生成的几何特征固定在地上,同时利用物体水平的前兆推断出未观测到的区域。 紧凑的3D-内生紫外体-体积符号化使联合序列随着视图的加入而保持小,而姿势-感知相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 在Toys4k和GSO上,为了4美元未校正的视图,GenSfM将小说-视图PSNR改进了3.2-4.5美元 dB,并将Chamfer中位距离比强的本土-3D生成基线减少2.8-3.8\tims$,而恢复输入-视图则超过96美元. Acc@5$^\circ$ 没有任何外部的姿势估计主干,后热优化,或已知的内在. 项目网页:https://dotb1ue.github.io/GenSfm/.

articles.title: Learning High-Quality Pseudo-Labels for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
articles.content: Point-supervised temporal action localization (PTAL) aims to recognize and localize action instances in untrimmed videos using only point-level annotations. Existing pseudo-label-based methods have made substantial progress in PTAL. However, confidence-based initialization can overlook well-localized proposals. Meanwhile, existing methods either keep pseudo-labels fixed during detector training or update them without fully exploiting alternative boundary evidence from the original proposal pool. These limitations constrain supervision quality, thereby hindering detection performance. To learn high-quality pseudo-labels, we propose a framework that integrates prior-guided initialization with consensus-guided refinement during detector training. Our framework comprises two modules: Prior-Guided Initialization (PGI) and Consensus-Guided Refinement (CGR). PGI combines proposal confidence with point-derived priors to establish instance-specific reliability for initial pseudo-label selection and candidate retention. CGR continually uses the retained original candidates to construct boundary targets, combining their consensus with evolving detector predictions to refine pseudo-labels throughout training. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive detection performance compared with existing methods. In particular, our method achieves 68.5\% average mAP over tIoU thresholds 0.1--0.7 on THUMOS14, surpassing PseR by 3.7 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyingfang/LHQP

articles.title_zh: 学习高质量Pseudo-Labels 用于精准的瞬间行动
articles.content_zh: 由点监督的时间动作本地化(PTAL)旨在仅用点级说明来识别和本地化无线视频中的动作实例. 现有的以假标签为基础的方法在PTAL中已取得重大进展. 然而,基于信任的初始化可以忽略地方化的建议。 与此同时,现有方法要么在探测器训练期间固定假标签,要么在不充分利用原提案库的替代边界证据的情况下加以更新。 这些限制限制了监督质量,从而阻碍了检测工作。 为了学习高质量的伪标签,我们提出了一个框架,在探测器培训中将事先指导的初始化与协商一致指导的完善结合起来。 我们的框架包括两个单元:先入为主的初始化(PGI)和 " 共识指导 " 完善(CGR)。 PGI将提案置信度与出点前缀相结合,以确定初始伪标签选择和候选人保留的具体实例可靠性. CGR继续使用所保留的原始候选人构建边界目标,将其共识同不断演变的探测器预测结合起来,在整个培训中完善伪标签。 对四项基准的实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的方法实现了竞争性检测。 特别是,在THUMOS14上,我们的方法在tIoU阈值上实现了68.5-%的平均mAP,超过了0.1-0.7,超过了PseR3.7个百分点. 代码见https://github.com/zhenyingfang/LHQP

articles.title: HiFiPix: Bringing High-Fidelity Real-World Super-Resolution Back to Pixel Space
articles.content: Diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution suffers from limited reconstruction fidelity due to information loss in VAE-based latent representations. Recently, pixel-space diffusion models offer a promising high-faithfulness alternative by avoiding latent compression, but adapting them to Real-ISR remains challenging due to inherent patch boundary artifacts and degraded generative capability. To address the issues and maximize the potential of pretrained pixel-space diffusion models, we propose HiFiPix, a pixel-space Real-ISR framework capable of ultra high-fidelity reconstruction and fine-grained visual generation effects. To suppress patch boundary artifacts, we penalize unrealistic high-frequency periodic components with a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CWSD) for image-level supervision, and Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) for intermediate representation regularization. Furthermore, we uncover a heterogeneous generation-fidelity trade-off across low-rank adapters (LoRA) and propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) to adaptively prune LoRA layers, enhancing generative capability with minimal deterioration of reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiFiPix consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art latent space methods in terms of both restoration accuracy and perceptual quality by a large margin. Code and models will be released.

articles.title_zh: HiFiPix: 带来高纯度 真实世界超级解析回像素空间
articles.content_zh: 基于扩散的现实世界图像超解因基于VAE的潜在表达方式的信息丢失而使重建忠心度有限。 最近,像素-空间传播模型通过避免潜在的压缩,提供了一个有希望的高信仰替代方案,但由于固有的补丁边界文物和退化的基因能力,使其适应Real-ISR仍然具有挑战性。 为了解决这些问题并最大限度地发挥预受训练的像素-空间传播模型的潜力,我们提出HiFiPix,一个像素-空间 Real-ISR框架,能够进行超高纯度重建并有精细的视觉生成效果. 为了压制补丁边界文物,我们惩罚不切实际的高频周期组件,其中带有跨比例的波浪分辨器(CWSD)用于图像层面的监督,而Mixup Contrastic Self-Distillation(MixCSD)用于中间代表正规化。 此外,我们发现在低等适配器(LORA)之间出现了不同世代的忠诚取舍,并提议采用选择性的LORA Pruning(LORA-SP)来适应性地放出LORA地层,增强基因能力,尽量减少重建忠心的恶化。 广泛的实验表明,HiFiPix在修复精度和感知质量方面一贯比现有最先进的潜在空间方法表现得更好。 代码和模型将发布。

articles.title: Learning Scene Coordinate Reconstruction from Unposed Images via Pose Graph Optimization
articles.content: Learning-based structure-from-motion methods such as ACE-Zero have demonstrated strong performance in estimating cameraposes and scene coordinates from unordered image collections without requiring ground truth supervision. However, the lack of global and multi-view consistency constraints in ACE-Zero can lead to pose drift and misalignment, particularly in complex or ambiguous scenes. In this work, we propose a hybrid framework that integrates pose graph optimization (PGO) into ACE-Zero to refine camera poses and suppress incorrect refinements. We construct pose graphs directly from ACE-Zero outputs by extracting relative pose constraints from predicted scene coordinates. Furthermore, we introduce an uncertainty-aware optimization strategy by estimating confidence scores using geometric priors, including epipolar and optical flow consistencies across views. Our approach improves the robustness and accuracy of pose estimation, demonstrating that global geometric reasoning can effectively complement learning-based inference in structure-from-motion.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过 Pose 图形优化从未放置图像中学习场景坐标重建
articles.content_zh: ACE-Zero等基于学习的结构起动方法在从无序图像集中估计相机和场景坐标方面表现出了很强的性能,不需要地面的真相监督. 然而,ACE-Zero缺乏全球和多观点的一致性限制,可能导致漂移和错位,特别是在复杂或模棱两可的场景中. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个混合框架,将平面图优化(PGO)整合到ACE-Zero中来来精炼相机外观并抑制不正确的精度. 我们从ACE-Zero的输出中直接提取出相对的场景坐标限制,从而构建出图形。 此外,我们通过使用几何前兆估计信心分数,包括各种观点的极地和光学流动成分,引入了一种认识到不确定性的优化战略。 我们的方法提高了姿势估计的稳健性和准确性,表明全球几何推理能够有效地补充结构自动中基于学习的推论.

articles.title: S$^2$-RL: Sample-Set Dual Reinforcement Learning for Generative Semantic Segmentation Dataset Distillation
articles.content: While dataset distillation has witnessed significant advances in image classification, its extension to dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation is plagued by two core bottlenecks: bi-level optimization-based approaches suffer from prohibitive computational costs stemming from pixel-wise gradient unrolling, whereas proxy-based generative methods merely infuse visual textures into fixed semantic masks derived from real data, thus failing to condense rich semantic knowledge into a compact set of informative, novel scene generations. To address both bottlenecks simultaneously, we propose a novel Sample-Set Reinforcement Learning (S$^2$-RL) framework for generative semantic segmentation dataset distillation (SSDD). Specifically, S$^2$-RL formulates SSDD as a diffusion model based text-to-image generation paradigm, enabling flexible generation of images with informative, novel semantic distributions via a concise text prompt. Furthermore, we fine-tune a diffusion policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), leveraging a sample-set dual reward paradigm: for individual samples, it enforces semantic alignment with input text prompts and intra-class feature diversity; for sample sets, it maximizes inter-sample semantic distribution diversity by solving a contextual multi-armed bandit problem. These design choices enable S$^2$-RL to distill large-scale semantic segmentation datasets into a compact set of generated samples that encapsulate diverse, informative semantic knowledge without the need of pixel-wise gradient unrolling. Extensive experiments on the ADE20K and COCO datasets demonstrate that S$^2$-RL achieves substantial and consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, establishing a new benchmark for SSDD.

articles.title_zh: S$^2$-RL: 基因语义分解数据集分解的抽样双强化学习
articles.content_zh: 虽然数据集蒸馏法在图像分类方面取得了显著进展,但其延伸至语义分解等密集的预测任务却被两个核心瓶颈所困扰:双层优化方法因像素梯度不滚动而承受了令人望而生畏的计算成本;而代用基因方法仅仅将视觉纹理注入从真实数据中衍生出来的固定语义口罩中,从而未能将丰富的语义知识收缩成一套精密的,内容丰富的新颖的场景代. 为了同时解决这两个瓶颈问题,我们提出了一个关于基因语义分解数据集分馏(SSDD)的新的 " 样本-成套强化学习 " (S$^2$-RL)框架。 具体而言,S$^2$-RL将SSDD制定为一种基于文本到图像生成范式的传播模式,通过简洁的文本提示,能够灵活地生成具有信息化和新语义的图像。 此外,我们通过 " 集团相对政策优化 " (GRPO)对传播政策进行微调,利用样本组合的双重奖励模式:对于单个样本,它执行语义上与输入文本提示和类内特征多样性的一致;对于样本组合,它通过解决背景多武装强盗问题,最大限度地实现样本间语义分布多样性。 这些设计选择使S$^2$-RL能够将大规模语义分解数据集分解成一组紧凑而成的样本,这些样本囊括了多样的,信息化的语义知识而无需像素梯度解滚. 对ADE20K和COCO数据集的广泛实验表明,S$^2$-RL比最先进的基线取得了实质性和一致的改进,为SSDD建立了一个新的基准。

articles.title: TP-JSCC: Efficient Token Pruning and Joint Source-Channel Coding for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration
articles.content: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.

articles.title_zh: TP-JSCC:在云端协作中为基于LVLM的3D-VQA提供高效的Token Pruning和联合源-频道编码
articles.content_zh: 在资源受限的内含物剂上部署大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs),用于3D视觉问题的回答,需要开展多云的合作。 然而,通过带宽有限和吵闹的通道将大量视觉数据卸载到云中,造成了严重的延迟和传输扭曲. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出TP-JSCC,一种高效的代号回推和以LVLMs为基础的Cloud-Edge Complex中的3D-VQA的源-通道联合编码方法. 首先,我们开发一个基于本地和全球语义学的Hybrid Token Pruning(LGS-HTP)模块,以显著地减少视觉符号计数. LGS-HTP通过脱钩前地-后地符号并联合选择本地和全球语义来有效减少冗余,同时保留推理-关键符号. 其次,我们引入了轻量级Token 联合源码-通道编码模块(T-JSCC)来进一步压缩被刷音符,并确保它们在容易出错的频道上进行强大的传输. 通过使用轻量级相接线性地层和信号-噪声比(SNR)-适应机制,本模块适应了波动的通道条件,同时保持了最小的计算间接费用. 对ScanQA和SQA3D数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法具有特殊的效率和稳健性。 具体地说,在ScanQA验证集中,LGS-HTP模块可以实现90%的穿行率,同时产生不到1%的CIDEr损失. 在此基础上,T-JSCC进一步将信使压缩了18倍,导致数据量总体减少180倍以进行强力传输,同时为LVLM部署节省了90%的计算复杂性. 我们的代码见https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC。

articles.title: Beyond Words Alone: Disentangling Distributed Evidence for Visually Grounded Cultural Translation
articles.content: Social media enables cross-lingual communication, yet the meaning of user-generated content (UGC) is often distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge, making translation challenging. Existing evaluations typically treat images as optional and assume textual information is sufficient, obscuring whether errors stem from missing visual evidence or inadequate cultural adaptation. We introduce \textbf{Culture-MMT}, a diagnostic benchmark for \textbf{distributed-evidence pragmatic reconstruction} in social-media translation. It contains 498 curated, de-identified UGC instances across 20 domains, categorized into Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid by their required evidence. We also develop a human-aligned domain-specific judge, Judger, and a controlled evaluation framework that systematically varies the evidence available to translators. Across 17 model configurations, real images improve performance by +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hybrid, but only +0.050 on Symbol, while random images provide no comparable gains. Human-authored descriptions further show that jointly dependent cases remain more challenging even when visual facts are explicit. These results characterize culturally effective social-media translation as {meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence}, highlighting visual grounding and cultural-pragmatic adaptation as distinct model bottlenecks.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Words Oneone: 为可视化基于文化翻译而散布的分散证据
articles.content_zh: 社交媒体能够进行跨语言的交流,然而用户生成的内容(UGC)的含义往往在文本、图像和文化知识之间传播,使翻译工作具有挑战性。 现有的评价通常将图像视为可选的,并假定文字信息足够充分,从而模糊了错误是否出自缺少视觉证据或文化适应不足。 我们在社交媒体翻译中引入\textbf{Culture-MMT}\textbf{分发证据的实用重建}的诊断基准。 它包含498个经整理、解析的UGC案例,涉及20个领域,按所需证据分为符号、视觉和混合。 我们还发展了与人相通的具体领域法官Judger,以及系统改变翻译可用证据的控制评价框架。 在整个17个模型配置中,真实的图像在Visual上能通过+0.280来提高性能,在Hybrid上能通过+0.197来提高性能,但在符号上只能通过+0.050来提高性能,而随机的图像则不能提供可比较的收益. 人类授权的描述进一步表明,即使视觉事实明确,共同依赖的案件仍然更具挑战性。 这些成果将文化上有效的社会-媒体翻译定性为{指从已分发的证据中重建},强调视觉地基和文化适应是独特的示范瓶颈。

articles.title: OBB-PBD: Extending Parallel Box Decoding to Oriented Bounding Boxes for Referring Expression Grounding in Aerial Imagery
articles.content: Referring expression grounding in overhead imagery requires oriented bounding boxes rather than horizontal ones, since aerial objects appear at arbitrary orientations. Most grounding models emit box coordinates sequentially; Parallel Box Decoding (PBD) instead predicts all geometry slots in one forward pass, but only for four-coordinate horizontal boxes. We extend this block-aligned interface to a six-slot oriented representation using a double-angle parameterization. Rather than assuming correctness from a decreasing loss curve, we verify the extension with image/prompt-shuffle controls and visibility/leakage probes, which show that the corrected model depends on both the image and the prompt rather than on prompt statistics alone. On the aerial vehicle visual grounding (AVVG) benchmark, whose targets are genuinely oriented, the extended model improves rotated intersection over union (rotIoU) from 0.1253 for the zero-shot baseline to 0.303 +/- 0.012 (mean +/- standard deviation over three training seeds) across the complete 6139-record test split spanning all 120 images. Learning oriented boxes rather than their axis-aligned envelopes adds 0.055 +/- 0.008 rotIoU beyond a matched control (per-seed 95% confidence intervals all excluding zero), whereas block expansion alone yields no rotIoU gain distinguishable from zero.

articles.title_zh: OBB-PBD: 将平行框解码扩展至用于在空中图像中进行表达定位的定向框
articles.content_zh: 由于空中物体出现任意取向,在俯仰图象上架起的提法需要取向的边框,而不是横向边框。 大多数地基模型相继出出出箱坐标;相平行出箱解码(PBD)取而代之的是预测所有几何槽在一个前传中,但只用于四相坐标水平箱. 我们利用双角参数化,将这个块相接的接口扩展为六相位取向的表示. 我们不是假设损失曲线下降的正确性,而是用图像/即时shuffle控制和能见度/漏取探测器来验证扩展性,这表明被修正的模型既取决于图像,也取决于即时数据,而不仅仅是即时统计数据。 在飞行器可视地定位基准(AVVG)上,扩展型在覆盖所有120个图像的完整6139-记录试验分出时,将0.1253为零射入基线的旋转相交点(rotIoU)改进为0.303+/-0.012(在三种训练种子上的平均+/-标准偏差)。 以学习为方向的盒子,而不是其轴相通的信封增加了0.055 +/- 0.008 rotIoU,超出了匹配的控制范围(每种子95%的置信间隔都排除为零),而仅块扩展则不能产生可与零相区别的rotIoU增益.

articles.title: Model-Aware Generation of Safety-Critical Scenes for Robust End-to-End Driving via Distilled Planner Surrogates
articles.content: End-to-end driving models perform well on standard benchmarks but collide frequently in safety-critical scenarios. We present a failure-mode analysis on NeuroNCAP which shows that 95.9% of DiffusionDrive's collisions are planning failures despite reliable detection, pinpointing the bottleneck in planning rather than perception. We attribute this to a fundamental data imbalance, as safety-critical interactions are rare in real driving logs, so planners are hardly ever trained on them. We close this gap with a novel model-aware framework that generates safety-critical training scenes against a specific planner. Each planner is attacked at the bird's-eye-view (BEV) level through a differentiable surrogate distilled from its own planning head. This keeps the expensive video renderer out of the attack loop. We extract 50 scenes per planner, each pairing an attack with a safe escape trajectory that serves as the fine-tuning label. A fully automated quality-diversity search generates both the attacks and the escapes, so that their variety is not specified by hand. Only these scenes are rendered to fine-tune the planner, which reduces the computational cost significantly. Fine-tuning on these scenes roughly halves the closed-loop collision rate of two planners on NeuroNCAP (SparseDrive 28.0% to 12.2%, DiffusionDrive 37.5% to 19.2%) while largely preserving normal driving. A cross-planner transfer experiment shows that the gain comes from targeting the specific planner. Each planner improves most on the scenes generated against itself, and DiffusionDrive fine-tuned on SparseDrive's scenes retains only 6.7 of its 18.3-point collision-rate reduction.

articles.title_zh: 通过Distilled Planers代理驾驶的强力端到端安全-关键景况模型
articles.content_zh: 端到端驱动模型在标准基准方面表现良好,但在安全关键情况下经常相撞。 我们提出了NeuroNCAP的故障模式分析, 显示95.9%的Drive相撞是计划失败, 尽管可靠的检测, 我们将此归因于一个基本的数据不平衡,因为安全-关键相互作用在真正的驱动日志中是罕见的,因此规划者几乎没有受过这方面的培训. 我们用一个新颖的模型认识框架来弥补这一差距,这个框架产生针对具体规划者的安全关键训练场景。 每个计划者在鸟眼-视野(BEV)级别上通过自规划头部分出不同的代位被攻击. 这使得昂贵的视频渲染器无法进入攻击循环. 我们每个计划员抽取50个场景,每个场景将攻击与安全逃生轨迹配对,作为微调标签. 完全自动化的质量多样性搜索既能产生攻击,又能产生出出出逃,这样它们的种类就不会由手来指定. 只有这些场景才被制成来微调规划师,这大大降低了计算成本. 这些场景的精细调整大致将神经NCAP上两位规划者的闭路相撞率减半(SparseDrive 28.0%至12.2%,Drive 37.5%至19.2%),同时基本保持了正常驾驶. 一个跨计划员转移实验显示,收益来自针对特定计划员. 每个规划师在所生成的自相矛盾的场景上改进得最多,在斯帕塞德里夫的场景上被DifmusionDrive微调后仅保留了其18.3分相撞率降低的6.7.

articles.title: Omni-InteractScope: Benchmarking Proactive and Agentic Interaction in Continuous Omnimodal Streams
articles.content: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) are increasingly expected to assist users while observing continuous audiovisual streams. However, existing evaluations provide limited insight into how reliably these models connect stream evidence and user needs to timely, sustained interventions. We introduce \textbf{Omni-InteractScope}, a benchmark of 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions with 1,790 temporal targets across eight task groups. It links input modalities, event triggers, intervention types, and user needs, covering event-timed tool invocation and query-free assistance alongside notifications, warnings, state tracking, and continuous responses. Our experimental results on the proposed benchmark reveal three critical limitations of current Omni-LLMs: (1) \textbf{Timely tool invocation remains unreliable}: all 12 evaluated models produce an on-time first response for at most 40\% of tool-invocation targets, and joint timing-and-tool accuracy reaches at most 32.0\%. (2) \textbf{Query-free reminders remain poorly covered}: all evaluated models achieve lower timely reference-target recall on query-free reminders than on explicit questions, measured on their respective target sets. Reminder recall never exceeds 23.0\%. (3) \textbf{End-to-end guidance coverage remains limited}: nine models cover none of the 26 guidance sequences in full, and the remaining three cover only one to three sequences each. Targeted controls further show that tool-invocation scores alone do not establish event grounding and that reminder coverage depends on response history and frequency. These findings motivate developing and evaluating streaming assistants for timely action, initiative under general user needs, and coverage of entire response sequences.
