articles.title_zh: Omni-InteractScope:在连续的Omnimodule流中确定主动和代理相互作用的基准
articles.content_zh: Omnimodule大型语言模型(Omni-LLMS)在观测连续的视听流的同时,越来越有望为用户提供帮助. 然而,现有的评价对这些模式如何可靠地将流证据和用户需要与及时、持续的干预措施联系起来,提供了有限的见解。 我们引入\textbf{Omni-InteractScope},这个基准为1,479个人类附加说明的、经过交叉审查的相互作用,8个工作组共有1,790个时间目标。 它将输入模式、事件触发器、干预类型和用户需求联系起来,包括事件定时工具引用和无查询协助,以及通知、警告、状态跟踪和连续答复。 我们关于拟议基准的实验结果揭示了当前Omni-LLMs的三个关键局限:(1)\textbf{及时工具引用仍然不可靠}:所有12个被评价的模型对最多40个工具调用目标作出实时第一次响应,联合计时和工具的准确度达到最多32.0分。 (2)\textbf-weery-free reminers仍然覆盖不足}:所有被评价的模型在免问提醒中实现的及时参考-目标召回比在各自目标集中衡量的明确问题要低。 提醒提醒永远不会超过23.0分 (3)\textbf{端到端的制导覆盖范围仍然有限}:9个型号没有完全覆盖26个制导序列,其余3个型号只覆盖每个导导序列一到三个. 定向控制进一步表明,仅靠工具调用得分并不能确定事件底线,提醒覆盖取决于响应历史和频率. 这些结果促使开发和评价流动助理,以便及时采取行动,根据一般用户需要采取主动行动,并涵盖整个反应序列。

articles.title: Unveil the Mask: Jointly-Optimized Diffusion Masked Pretraining for Appearance-Agnostic Operator Verification
articles.content: Photorealistic avatar videos decouple the appearance of a rendered face from the person who operates it, which makes conventional face recognition unsuitable for identifying the operator. Verifying the operator therefore requires representations of how a face moves that are insensitive to what the avatar looks like. We propose a verification framework built without any external pretrained model. It uses two complementary modalities provided for each sample: facial landmark sequences and video frames. From the landmark modality, it learns motion representations by diffusion masked pretraining over grouped landmarks, guided by lightweight auxiliary tasks that predict behavioral cues such as motion intensity and eye openness, and turns them into operator embeddings with a contrastive linear probe. To generalize to unseen avatar generators, the pretraining input is randomly transformed to simulate how a generator may alter the operator's motion. From the video modality, it captures fine facial motion through differences between consecutive frames. The embeddings of the two modalities are combined into one. Our approach reaches an overall AUC of 0.769 on the WBA2026 benchmark. Linear probing shows that the video embedding retains little information about the avatar's identity, whereas the landmark embedding retains some, and fusing the two modalities improves verification in particular across speaking and listening modes.

articles.title_zh: 解开面具:为外观-不可知操作者验证而联合进行的放大口罩预训
articles.content_zh: 照片真实化的相机视频将变相相相机的外观与操作者脱钩,这使得常规相机识别不适合识别操作者. 因此,验证操作员需要说明一张面部的动作如何对外观不敏感。 我们建议建立一个没有外部预先训练的模式的核查框架。 它使用为每个样本提供的两种互补模式:面部地标序列和视频帧. 从地标模式中,它通过扩散蒙面预训来从分组地标上学习运动表现,以轻量级辅助任务为指导,预测动作强度和眼睛开阔等行为提示,并把它们变成操作员用对比线性探测器嵌入. 要概括到隐形相机,预训输入会被随机地转换来模拟出一个发电机如何改变操作员的运动. 从视频模式中,它通过相接相框之间的差异来捕捉精细的面部运动. 两种方式的嵌入被合并为一. 我们的方法在WBA2026基准上达到总的0.769澳元. 线性探测显示,嵌入的视频保留了很少关于阿凡达身份的信息,而地标嵌入则保留了部分信息,而连接两种模式则特别改进了跨语音和收听模式的验证.

articles.title: NeSySpec: Neuro-Symbolic Technical Intelligence for Auditing Engineering Specifications with an Application to Aircraft
articles.content: Engineers who audit a declared specification of an engineered system need to know which physical constraints it respects, which it violates, which field was altered and how to correct it. NeSySpec is an integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework, built on Logic Tensor Networks, that answers these questions in one pipeline. Its axioms encode the physical relations of the domain as differentiable graded predicates whose tolerances are learned from a fleet of real records; from the same degrees, it diagnoses the violated constraint, identifies the altered field by abduction, proposes a minimum-change correction and ties image evidence to the parts it describes, abstaining exactly where evidence is missing, and returns all of it in one verification report. We validate NeSySpec on 107 aircraft types, with 16 test aircraft of 9 families held out of training, on specification records paired with ground photographs and satellite imagery and on synthetic errors: generated corruptions, edits labeled from the edit alone and deliberate falsifications. NeSySpec combines all the assessed audit outputs in one pipeline, which no learned, rule-based, solver-based, neuro-symbolic or language-model comparator does; on the test aircraft none is ahead of it in the macro-F1 of its constraint verdicts, in naming the violated constraint and the altered field or in the repair error, and it is competitive in record and image-pair detection. Its diagnosis names the violated constraint in 94.2% of corrupted test records, against 79.5% for classical Fellegi-Holt diagnosis, and on edits labeled from the edit alone, without retraining, abduction finds the altered field in 59.3% of records, against 30.6% for minimum-cardinality localization with random tie- breaking. Only the knowledge base, the visual predicates, the corruption generator and the data are specific to the domain.

articles.title_zh: NeSySpec: 神经系统 适用于飞机的审计工程规格技术情报
articles.content_zh: 审计已申报的工程系统规格的工程师需要知道它尊重哪些物理限制、它违反了哪些限制、哪些领域被改变以及如何纠正限制。 NeSySpec是一个综合而可解释的神经-连锁审计框架,以Logic Tensor Networks为基础,在一个管道中解答这些问题. 它的轴线将域的物理关系编码为不同分级的上游,其耐受性从一大批真实记录中汲取;从同样程度,它诊断出被违反的制约,识别被劫持而改变的域,提出最小变化的校正,将图像证据与它描述的部分联系起来,放弃确切的证据缺失之处,并在一份核查报告中将其全部还原. 我们验证了107种飞机的NeSySpec,对9个家庭的16架试验飞机进行了培训,并验证了与地面照片和卫星图像配对的规格记录以及合成错误:产生了腐败,编辑后只加了标签,并故意作假。 NeSySpec将所有评估的审计产出合并在一个管道中,没有学习的,基于规则的,基于解析器的,基于神经同位素的或语言模型的参照物的;在测试飞机上,在其约束判决的宏观-F1中,在指定被违反的制约和被改变的场或修复出错时,没有一个比它更领先,在记录和图像辅助检测上是竞争性的. 它的诊断将94.2%的腐败测试记录中的违规约束命名为"被违反约束",而古典的Fellegi-Holt诊断为79.5%,在仅从编辑中标注的编辑上,不进行再培训,绑架在59.3%的记录中发现了被改变的领域,而以随机打结方式进行最小心律局部化的为30.6%. 只有知识库,视觉上游,腐败发生器和数据是域所特有的.

articles.title: Toward Clinical Translation of Deep Learning-Based Intracranial Super-Resolution 4D Flow MRI Using Multi-Cohort Transfer Learning
articles.content: We evaluated synthetic pretraining and multi-cohort transfer learning for deep learning-based super-resolution of intracranial 4D Flow MRI across heterogeneous neurologic cohorts. This mixed prospective-retrospective study analyzed 18 participants (12 healthy participants, 3 with moyamoya disease, and 3 with multiple sclerosis) with paired 1.2-mm and 0.6-mm 4D Flow MRI scans. A convolutional neural network pretrained on synthetic cerebrovascular data was fine-tuned using cohort-specific or pooled multi-cohort in vivo data. High-resolution-derived inputs enabled voxel-wise evaluation; native standard-resolution scans were used for angiographic and hemodynamic analyses. Synthetic pretraining reduced mean artery-wise velocity-normalized root mean square error (vNRMSE) versus interpolation (0.147 vs 0.166). Pooled transfer learning yielded the lowest mean vNRMSE (0.119 vs 0.127 for cohort-specific models and 0.147 for synthetic pretraining), with narrower 95% limits-of-agreement widths than synthetic pretraining across all test cases (0.109-0.222 vs 0.154-0.278 m/s). Super-resolved phase-contrast angiography achieved higher precision-recall area under the curve than native standard-resolution imaging in all cohorts (0.848-0.896 vs 0.486-0.805). These results indicate that pooled transfer learning improves cross-cohort reconstruction agreement and that super-resolution can improve vessel depiction, supporting further multi-center validation for cerebrovascular imaging.

articles.title_zh: 采用多轴转录学习法进行深层学习的临床翻译
articles.content_zh: 我们评价了合成预训和多节能转移学习,以深入学习为基础,对不同神经组群的四维流体内核磁共振进行超解。 这一混合的远景回顾研究分析了18名参与者(12名健康参与者,3名患有摩亚莫亚病,3名患有多发性硬化症),并配对了1.2-毫米和0.6-毫米4D流体核磁共振扫描. 在合成脑血管数据上预先训练的进化神经网络在活体数据中利用组群特异性或集合多曲线进行了微调. 高分辨出的投入使得能进行阴道光学评价;原生的标准分辨扫描被用于血管学和血动力学分析。 合成前训练减少了平均动脉 -- -- 顺理成正态 -- -- 根平均平方误差(vNRMSE)与内插误差(0.147对0.166)。 集合转移学习得出了最低平均值vNRMSE(组群特定型号为0.119对0.127,合成预训为0.147),在所有测试案例中,协议宽度比合成预训更窄95%(0.109-0.222对0.154-0.278米/秒)。 超解相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这些结果表明,集合转移学习可以改善跨曲线重建协议,而超分辨率可以改善容器的描绘,支持进一步多中心验证脑血管成像.

articles.title: ACSAN: All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network Integrating Convolutional Operations with Vision Transformer
articles.content: In the past few years, Vision Transformer (ViT) has achieved excellent performance in the field of computer vision. However, there still some problems remain. For instance, ViTs heavily rely on large-scale training data since they simply contain a large number of trainable parameters, which slows down their learning efficiency and limits their applicability in resource-constrained scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning model, namely All-Convolutional Self-Attention Network (ACSAN), which applies convolution operations to replace fully-connected matrices multiplications in the ViT framework. To implement ACSAN, we firstly design Dynamic Convolutional Self-Attention (DCSA) as the basic module, which employs multi-scale dilated convolutions to generate Query, Key, and Value. We defined spatial self-attention and channel self-attention to generate attention features respectively. The two attention features are finally merged as the output of the DCSA module. Based on DCSA, we then construct the basic ACSAN block. Comparing with ViT, we use DCSA to replace the regular self-attention operations, and use convolution layers to replace MLPs. To evaluate the performance of the proposed method, we train ACSAN on three widely-used image classification databases, i.e. CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k, from scratch. Experimental results show that ACSAN achieves excellent classification accuracy comparing with standard ViT with comparable or fewer parameters, as well as other state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies verify that each component contributes positively to the final performance.

articles.title_zh: ACSAN:全革命自觉网络 将"革命"业务与"愿景变形"相结合
articles.content_zh: 在过去几年中,Visual Transformer(ViT)在计算机视觉领域取得了出色的成绩. 然而,仍然存在一些问题。 例如,ViTs大量依赖大规模培训数据,因为这些数据只是包含大量可训练参数,降低了其学习效率并限制了其在资源受限的情况下的适用性。 在本文中,我们提出一种新的深层学习模式,即"全革命自学网"(ACSAN),它应用了"进取"操作来取代"维特"框架中全相通的矩阵乘法. 为了实施ACSAN,我们首先设计了动态革命自觉(DCSA)作为基本模块,该模块采用多尺度的分化进化来生成"查询"(Query, Key, and Value). 我们界定了空间自觉和通道自觉,以分别产生注意力特征. 这两种关注特征最终被合并为DCSA模块的输出. 以自评中心为基础,我们再建造自评中心的基本区块。 与ViT相比,我们使用DCSA来取代常规自留心操作,并使用演化层来取代MLP. 为了评价拟议方法的性能,我们从头开始对ACSAN进行三个被广泛使用的图像分类数据库的培训,即CIFAR-10,CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k. 实验结果显示,ACSAN与具有可比较性或更小参数的标准VIT相比,以及其他最先进的方法,取得了卓越的分类精度. 校正研究证实,每个组成部分对最后业绩都有积极的贡献。

articles.title: GIFT: Representation Geometry Matters for Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection
articles.content: Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (S-DGOD) aims to generalize from a single source domain to unseen domains under distribution shifts. Existing efforts mainly focus on simulating unseen domains or suppressing domain-specific factors. However, they largely overlook the intrinsic generalization capability embedded in Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). In this work, we show that unconstrained fine-tuning disrupts the geometric structure of pre-trained representations, which encodes domain-invariant semantics. Motivated by this, we propose Geometric-Invariance Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a geometric-aware fine-tuning method for VFMs. Specifically, we introduce a series of learnable Householder reflections to the pre-trained weights to encourage geometry-consistent adaptation under domain shift. In addition, we propose a lightweight channel-wise scaling to facilitate effective task-specific adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GIFT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches on two S-DGOD benchmarks. Notably, by introducing fewer than 1% additional trainable parameters into the frozen backbone, the proposed method achieves improvements of +7.9% and +2.9% in mPC over the previous SOTA on the Cityscapes-C and Diverse Weather Dataset, respectively. This finding highlights that preserving representation geometry is crucial for robust cross-domain generalization, establishing GIFT as a principled and efficient solution to domain shift.

articles.content_zh: 单域通用对象检测(S-DGOD)旨在从一个单一源域到分布相变时所未见域的通用. 现有努力主要侧重于模拟看不见的领域或压制特定领域的因素。 然而,它们在很大程度上忽略了Vision Foundation Models(VFMs)中固有的通俗化能力. 在这部作品中,我们显示不受约束的微调会打乱了被事先训练的表示的几何结构,它编码了域-变量语义. 以此为动机,我们提议了几何-内变精通法(GIFT),即VFM的几何-知微调法. 具体地说,我们引入了一系列可学习的住户反思,对预先训练的权重进行反思,以鼓励在域移下进行几何-相容的适应. 此外,我们建议采用轻量级的频道,以便利针对具体任务的有效适应。 广泛的实验表明,打击人口贩运全球举措在两个S-DGOD基准方面一直比最先进的方法要好。 值得注意的是,通过在被冻结的主干线中引入不到1%的额外可训练参数,拟议的方法使mPC的改进率分别达到+7.9%和+2.9%,而之前的Cityscapes-C和diversity Weather Datas集的SOTA则有所改进。 这一结论突出表明,保持代表性几何对强有力的跨域通论至关重要,它把全球打击人口贩运举措确立为有原则和有效的域转移解决方案。

articles.title: Shared-Factor-Conditioned Diffusion for Low-Rank Tensor Recovery
articles.content: Tensor recovery spans heterogeneous data structures and observation processes, calling for a representation that can adapt across modalities and tasks. We propose DiffTR, an unsupervised framework that unifies tensor completion, denoising, and hyperspectral super-resolution through coordinate-conditioned diffusion. Shared factors indexed by tensor coordinates condition a compact score network, and score matching jointly learns the factors and an implicit tensor representation from the available observations. Scalar and vector-valued outputs accommodate individual entries and entire tubes, enabling a common formulation for tabular tensors, images, and videos. The framework separates representation learning from task-specific observation modeling: reverse diffusion recovers missing values; estimation via Tweedie's formula, soft thresholding, and optional spatial consistency support mixed-noise denoising; and measurement-guided sampling transfers a prior learned from low-resolution hyperspectral observations to high-resolution reconstruction, followed by post-sampling refinement with data consistency and spectral subspace regularization. This separation makes the representation compatible with different corruption models and permits task-specific constraints to be incorporated within the same recovery framework. Experiments across multiple tensor modalities and recovery tasks demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and the flexibility of a unified conditional generative representation. The code is available at https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR

articles.title: SG-Splat: Stable Geometry Learning under Pose Uncertainty for Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a promising representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. For practical deployment, recent studies have explored pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, which reconstructs Gaussian representations directly from unposed input images. However, these methods remain sensitive to residual pose errors, which perturb canonical-space Gaussian transformation, introducing noisy supervision for geometry and attribute learning. To address this problem, we present SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that improves robustness to pose uncertainty and stabilizes the learning of Gaussian primitives. SG-Splat decouples geometry estimation and Gaussian attribute prediction into two dedicated branches, reducing error coupling between pose-sensitive geometry and Gaussian attributes. We further introduce a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline, consisting of Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC), to improve geometric alignment before Gaussian attribute reconstruction. Specifically, FGPR refines camera poses with flow-based correlation features and differentiable bundle adjustment. RGC then corrects initial point maps using depth residuals derived from FGPR, producing more reliable Gaussian centers. To stabilize training, we introduce a dual-path strategy that mixes ground-truth and predicted poses for canonical transformation. It provides clean supervision for Gaussian attributes while improving geometry robustness to residual pose errors. Extensive experiments on DL3DV and RealEstate10K show that SG-Splat achieves state-of-the-art performance in both novel view synthesis and pose estimation.

articles.title: CVTSplat: Multi-view Reconstruction Using an Adaptive Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation
articles.content: Voronoi tessellations have recently emerged as an adaptive, space-partitioning discretization for shape and appearance reconstruction from multi-view images. However, the irregular cells they produce make the repeated reconstruction of the tessellation during optimization costly. We therefore explore adaptive centroidal Voronoi tessellations (CVTs), which extend standard CVTs with non-uniform cell sizes while preserving the regular, well-shaped cells that make them efficient to compute. In CVTSplat, cell size is modulated by the evolving signed distance field, concentrating sites near the zero level set while keeping cells nearly centroidal. This regularity lets us specialize the whole pipeline, with GPU algorithms for nearest-neighbor queries and approximate Voronoi construction, and a rasterizer tailored to small, nearly isotropic cells. Our Voronoi construction is 5 to 10 times faster than general-purpose alternatives in this regime. On DTU and BlendedMVS, CVTSplat reaches geometric accuracy competitive with the best Gaussian-splatting surface methods while training in about 2.5 minutes on a single GPU.

articles.title: Targeted Deep Regression - Initial Applications in Whole-Body Water-Fat MRI in UK Biobank
articles.content: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact while retaining high-resolution, for example by providing multiple slices of kidney tissue for a kidney volume regression network. This approach also enables group-wise saliency analysis that highlight image and anatomical regions used by the network for the pre- dictions. The method was applied for the regression endpoints of kidney volume, heart volume, and age. Predictive performance was found between R2 = 0.731-0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions. We con- clude that the method can be used to standardize and restrict the information presented to a deep regression analysis pipeline, increasing information density and opening up a wide range of future medical inference studies.

articles.title: OVM-Occ: Open-Vocabulary Monocular Occupancy Prediction via Geometry-Aware Vision-Language Distillation
articles.content: Monocular occupancy prediction in indoor scenes aims to recover a scene's 3D geometry and semantics from a single RGB image. Existing methods are restricted to a closed set of predefined categories, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen categories. This limitation is particularly critical in indoor scenes, where objects exhibit highly diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. We study open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes and present OVM-Occ, a Gaussian-based occupancy framework with an instance-aware vision-language teacher. Specifically, we adopt Language-Embedded Gaussians as the intermediate scene representation, propose a geometry-aware deformable attention module to refine Gaussian semantic features, and construct instance-level vision-language embeddings to provide reliable semantic supervision. We further introduce geometry-aware decoupled semantic distillation to mitigate the interference between geometry learning and semantic learning. To evaluate open-vocabulary occupancy prediction performance, we introduce OpenOcc-ScanNet and OpenOcc-Replica, two extended benchmarks with more diverse and fine-grained semantic categories. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary monocular occupancy prediction for indoor scenes, outperforming the previous state-of-the-art approach by 12.2 mIoU and 0.6 IoU on the Occ-ScanNet dataset, with consistent gains under new open-vocabulary evaluation protocols.

articles.title: Low-rank MERA Decomposition of 3D OCT Image Volume for Compression, Denoising, Feature Extraction and Diagnosis of Retinal Diseases
articles.content: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive imaging modality used for visualization of retinal tissue. However, OCT volumes are affected by speckle noise, which degrades image contrast and obscures fine structural details. Furthermore, modern clinical practice requires large field-of-view, high-resolution OCT volumes, whose storage and transmission are demanding for archiving and teleophthalmology applications. To address aforementioned challenges, we propose a low-rank multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (MERA) tensor network approximation of 3D OCT image volume, where the image volume is represented as contractions of a top core factor encoding global features and multiple interacting low-rank orthogonal or semi-orthogonal factors modeling inter- and intra-B scan correlations. This representation jointly enables compression, denoising, and feature extraction. Unlike deep learning approaches, the proposed approach is training-free and processes each OCT volume independently. We evaluate the proposed framework on OCT image volumes acquired by two different scanners and demonstrate improved visual quality and reduced retinal layer segmentation errors in comparison with several competing methods. We also extract MERA features from two clinical OCT volume datasets. They are subsequently classified using a Grassmann-manifold nearest-subspace classifier. With the subspace dimension as its only hyperparameter, the classifier is theoretically shown to be robust in small-sample clinical scenario. We demonstrate competitive accuracy of classification of retinal diseases in these small-sample settings, where deep learning methods are often limited by the scarcity of labeled data. The proposed structure-aware model-driven representation learning for high-dimensional data under limited supervision provides good generalization performance while maintaining high interpretability.

articles.title: Beyond Vision-Language Models: Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs for Emotion Recognition in Artworks
articles.content: Emotion recognition in artworks remains challenging because affective meaning is often subjective, implicit, and shaped by relationships between visual form and semantic associations. While vision-language models provide strong multimodal representations, direct image-to-emotion prediction may overlook explicit relations among formal, semantic, and affective cues that support emotional interpretation. This paper proposes Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG), a graph-based framework that represents artworks through interpretable feature nodes, including color, brushstroke, composition, light-shadow, line quality, and extracted visual entities. The graph learns feature-emotion associations for dominant emotion prediction, with valence-arousal structure modeled through an optional hierarchical auxiliary affect module. We evaluate VSAG and VSAG-TopK against direct VLM inference using Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 on EmoArt-5k. Results show that direct VLMs provide useful but modest baselines, while graph-based models improve dominant emotion prediction. In particular, the hierarchical valence-arousal variant of VSAG achieves the best overall performance, improving accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted-F1 over both direct VLM inference and the emotion-only VSAG baseline. Per-class results indicate that graph-based models and VLMs capture partly complementary signals, while valence-arousal structure is most useful when integrated as a coarse-to-fine affect hierarchy rather than as a simple post-hoc correction. These findings suggest that explicit visual-semantic structure can support both prediction and interpretation in artwork emotion recognition.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Vision-Language Models: 视觉-语义相接图 艺术作品中的情感识别
articles.content_zh: 艺术作品中的情感识别仍然具有挑战性,因为情感意义往往是主观的,隐含的,由视觉形式和语义联系之间的关系所塑造. 虽然视觉语言模型提供了强有力的多模式表述,但直接的图像到情感预测可能会忽略支持情感解释的正式、语义和情感提示之间的明确关系。 本文提出了Visual-Semantic Afffect Graphs(VSAG),这是一个以图表为基础的框架,通过可解释的特征节点代表了艺术品,包括颜色,刷子,组成,光影,行质量,被取取取的视觉实体. 该图为主性情感预测学习了特征-情感关联,通过可选的分级辅助影响模块来模拟活性-激发结构. 我们对VSAG和VSAG-TopK进行评估,对照使用Qune3-VL和InternVL3.5在EmoArt-5k上的直接VLM推论. 结果显示,直接的VLM提供了有用而适度的基线,而以图表为基础的模型则改善了占主导地位的情感预测. 特别是,VSAG的分级活性-振荡变体实现了最佳的整体性能,提高了精度,宏观-F1和加权-F1都超过了直接VLM推论和仅以情感为主的VSAG基线. 每个类的结果表明以图为基础的模型和VLM部分地捕捉到互补的信号,而活性-振荡结构在作为粗细到细细的集成物而影响层次而不是简单的后热校正时最为有用. 这些研究结果表明,清晰的视觉语义结构可以支持在艺术情感识别中的预测和解释.

articles.title: Reading Beyond OCR Noise: Robust Cross-Lingual RAG for Legislative Archives
articles.content: India's historical public archives present severe computer vision and document image analysis challenges: decades of parliamentary records survive only as degraded, multi-column scanned pages featuring mixed scripts, complex layouts, and dense visual noise where OCR failure is the primary obstacle to information retrieval. We present an end-to-end framework that couples vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. Our approach specifically addresses how visual degradation and layout fragmentation propagate into text extraction errors, using an iterative agentic loop to navigate around OCR noise and layout ambiguities before generating answers. Evaluated on the 200,000-page Punjab Vidhan Sabha archive, our system demonstrates robust handling of historical document degradation, outperforming standard text-only baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 阅读超越OCR噪声:为立法档案提供有力的跨语言RAG
articles.content_zh: 印度历史公共档案提出了严重的计算机视觉和文件图像分析挑战:数十年的议会记录仅能作为退化、多栏扫描的网页而活下来,这些网页以混合的文字、复杂的布局和密集的视觉噪音为主,而OCR故障是信息检索的主要障碍。 我们提出一个端到端框架,即夫妇基于视觉的布局分化和多写式OCR,并配有代理取回-增强生成(RAG)管道。 我们的方法专门涉及视觉退化和布局破碎如何传播到文本提取错误中,使用迭代代理环绕OCR噪声和布局模糊而后再生成答案. 根据20万页的旁遮普Vidhan Sabha档案, 我们的系统显示,

articles.title: Thermal-Headroom Routing for Efficient Robot Perception in Extreme Heat
articles.content: Adaptive robot perception systems must balance detector accuracy, inference latency, and energy consumption, particularly when high ambient temperatures cause processors to thermally throttle. We propose Thermal-Headroom Routing (THR), a lightweight model-selection policy that forecasts processor temperature using a closed-form RC thermal model and excludes detector configurations predicted to cross a throttling threshold. We evaluate THR with four YOLO11 configurations across seven real-world perception traces, eight ambient temperatures, and 20 randomized seeds, comparing it with latency-aware routing, fixed-threshold thermostats, duty caps, and a matched-compute-budget control. At ambient temperatures of 45-55 degrees C and a tight inference deadline, THR eliminates throttling in simulation, reduces deadline misses by 3.9-7.5 percentage points, and reduces energy per on-time frame by approximately 12-13% relative to a latency-belief router. A separate experiment using deadline-paced, nonoverlapping frame execution yields miss-rate reductions of 6.2-9.5 percentage points. A tuned thermostat or duty cap can match THR at a fixed operating point; predictive routing is most useful when ambient conditions or calibrated thermal parameters differ from those used to tune static policies. Measurements on an Apple M5 support the single-node heating approximation but do not validate hardware throttling. The results characterize the conditions under which thermal forecasting improves the efficiency and timeliness of resource-constrained robot perception.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在极端热量中高效机器人感知热-室长轮跑
articles.content_zh: 适应性机器人感知系统必须平衡探测器的准确性,推论延迟性和能耗,特别是当高环境温度导致处理器受热节流时. 我们建议采用热-头室跑道(THR),这是一种轻量级模型选择政策,利用封闭式RC热能模型预测处理器温度,并排除预计会突破节能阈值的探测器配置。 我们用四个YOLO11的配置来评估THR, 覆盖7个真实世界的感知痕迹,8个环境温度,20个随机化的种子, 将其与耐久感知的路由,固定阈值的恒温器,值班上限, 以及匹配的计算预算控制进行比较。 在环境温度为45-55摄氏度且推论期限很紧的情况下,THR在模拟中消除了节奏,将最后期限误差降低3.9-7.5个百分点,相对于一个纬度-信仰路由器,每个时段的能耗减少约12-13%. 使用最后期限节奏、非重叠框架执行的单独试验得出6.2-9.5个百分点的误差率。 调温器或值电上限可以在固定操作点与THR相匹配;当环境条件或调温参数不同于调静政策时,预测路径最有用。 苹果M5上的测量支持单节点加热近似,但不验证硬件节流. 研究结果说明了热能预报在何种条件下能提高资源受限机器人感知的效率和及时性。

articles.title: Joint Latent Reasoning and Observation for Agentic Video Understanding
articles.content: Effective video agents must learn not only how to answer, but also where to look next. Transferring this capability to smaller models is challenging because each observation serves two purposes: supporting an answer and guiding the search for further evidence. Textual descriptions may capture what is currently visible while omitting cues needed for subsequent acquisition. We introduce Latent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis (LARVA), a framework that distills multi-round video agents through jointly learned latent reasoning and visual observations. Rather than communicating through captions, an observer passes compact continuous representations to a reasoner that selects the next acquisition action or produces the final answer. Crucially, action and answer supervision propagate through this interface, training the observer to communicate information useful for downstream decisions. Observation reconstruction and reasoning-distribution alignment provide auxiliary supervision from textual teacher trajectories. Across five video-understanding benchmarks, LARVA achieves strong performance with 4B and 7B backbones. On VideoHolmes, Video-MME, and LVBench, the 7B model outperforms a textual CoT student trained on the same teacher trajectories by 5.1, 2.5, and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. These results highlight the value of jointly learning how agents represent evidence and act on it when distilling video-understanding capabilities.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理视频理解联合推理和观察
articles.content_zh: 有效的视频代理不仅必须学会如何回答,而且还必须学会下一步看哪里。 将这种能力转移到较小的模型具有挑战性,因为每一项观察都有两个目的:支持一个答案并指导寻找进一步的证据。 文字描述可以捕捉目前可见的东西,同时省去后续获取所需的提示. 我们引入了Lententent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis(LARVA),这个框架通过共同学习的潜在推理和视觉观察来分泌多轮视频代理. 观察员不通过标题进行沟通,而是将紧凑的连续表示传递给选择下一个获取动作或产生最终答案的理性者. 至关重要的是,通过这一接口传播行动和回答监督,培训观察员交流有助于下游决策的信息。 观察重建与推理-分流相配合,从文字教师轨迹提供辅助监督. 通过视频理解的五个基准,LARVA以4B和7B骨干实现了强效. 在VideoHolmes,Video-MME,和LV Bench上,7B模型的成绩分别以5.1分,2.5分和3.7分的成绩超过了一个接受过相同教师轨迹培训的文字COT学生. 这些结果凸显出共同学习物剂如何代表证据并在分解视频理解能力时采取行动的价值.

articles.title: GaussianSpline: Adaptive Bézier Splines for Highly Dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: We present GaussianSpline, a dynamic 4D Gaussian Splatting method that models per-Gaussian motion using adaptive, non-uniform piecewise cubic Bézier splines. Unlike approaches based on global deformations, fixed-order polynomials, or uniformly parameterized splines, GaussianSpline jointly learns the Bézier control points and the temporal partition of each Gaussian's trajectory. This adaptive representation allocates greater temporal capacity to highly dynamic regions while maintaining compact trajectories for near-static regions, enabling high-fidelity reconstruction of complex and rapidly changing motion. To jointly achieve globally smooth motion and local adaptivity, we enforce $G^1$ continuity between consecutive Bézier segments using a reflection-based constraint on their control points. This produces smooth, fully differentiable trajectories while preserving the flexibility of non-uniform temporal parameterization. Experiments on the Neural 3D Video benchmark, the Google Immersive dataset, as well as on synthetic scenes demonstrate that GaussianSpline substantially improves reconstruction quality in scenes with highly non-uniform and challenging dynamics, while maintaining competitive performance on general dynamic scenes compared with state-of-the-art 4D Gaussian Splatting methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GaussianSpline:用于高能4D高斯平板的可适应贝塞尔斯平板
articles.content_zh: 我们提出高斯斯平线,是一种动态的4D高斯平板化方法,利用适应性的,非统一分件的贝塞尔立方体平面来模拟每个高斯平面运动. 与基于全球变形,固定顺序多诺分数,或统一参数化的分光线的方法不同,高斯斯普林联合学习了贝塞尔控制点和每个高斯轨迹的时间分光. 这种适应性代表将更大的时间能力分配给高度活跃的区域,同时保持了接近静态的区域的紧凑轨迹,使复杂和迅速变化的运动得以高可靠性地重建。 为了共同实现全球平滑运动和当地适配性,我们在连续的贝塞尔区段之间实施1美元G^1的连续性,在控制点上采用反射约束。 这产生平滑,完全相异的轨迹,同时保持了非统一时间参数化的灵活性. 在神经3D视频基准,Google Immersive数据集以及合成场景上的实验显示,高斯斯斯普琳在具有高度非统一性并具有挑战性的动态的场景中大幅提升了重建质量,同时与最先进的4D高斯平板化方法相比,在一般动态场景上保持了竞争性能.

articles.title: O2D-MedNet: An Optimization-Aware Dual-Domain Framework for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
articles.content: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: O2D-MedNet:强健医学影像分解的优化-智能双域框架
articles.content_zh: 医疗图像分解(MIS)仍然具有挑战性,因为综合退化和多尺度几何变异共同损害损害背景分解性、结构一致性和优化稳定性。 现有的单一流程框架将不同的提示缠入单一的表述途径中,而混合流程方法往往依赖于通用或静态聚变,限制了各领域之间的有效协调,未能明确解决优化不稳定问题。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议为管理信息系统(O2D-MedNet)建立一个新的优化-认识双重领域框架。 首先,一个具有降解意识的双域相互作用模块融合了Fourier - and Wavelet - domain 特性,以抑制对降解敏感的反应,同时保留结构和细节信息。 其次,一个跨后骨轮廓制导聚变(CGF)模块能够使基于CNN的本地细节建模和基于视觉状态-空间的全球结构建模进行选择性互动,提高边界准确度和表示一致性. 第三,梯度-背景优化(GCO)战略通过根据损失趋势和梯度统计对学习动态进行适应性调整来稳定培训,减轻由班级失衡和不同抽样困难造成的不稳定。 对6个基准的广泛试验表明,在多种成像模式中,与最先进的管理信息系统方法相比,不断改进。 进一步的分析证实提高了敏感性、结构一致性并优化了稳定性,验证了拟议的O2D-MedNet在各种条件下对强有力的管理信息系统的有效性。

articles.title: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
articles.content: Existing multi-agent collaboration (MAC) methods have primarily explored a group thinking collaboration topology, where agents independently generate solutions and aggregate their outputs. In this work, we investigate an alternative relay thinking topology, where reasoning ownership is dynamically transferred across agents, allowing subsequent agents to inherit and refine an evolving reasoning trajectory. We introduce Multi-Agent Confidence-guided Relay (MACR), a framework that enables dynamical relay collaboration among agents. The key challenge is determining when reasoning should be relayed and which agent should continue the process. method addresses this challenge through confidence-guided relay triggering and a bidding mechanism that selects the next agent based on its confidence. Experiments on four benchmarks show that method outperforms the strongest single-model strategies in accuracy, e.g., +3.3% on MathVista and +3.9% on MMStar, and remains on par with multi-agent strategies while consuming 6.0x less token overhead on HallusionBench and MMStar.Further analysis demonstrates that relay collaboration enables heterogeneous agents to progressively integrate complementary insights, combining heterogeneous capabilities across reasoning stages. Our source code is available at https://github.com/67L1/MACR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多代理中继器 思考
articles.content_zh: 现有的多代理协作(MAC)方法主要探索了一个思考协作地理学的团体,其中代理独立生成解决方案并汇总其产出. 在这部作品中,我们调查了另一种中继思维的地貌学,其中推理所有权被动态地跨出代理,让后继代理继承并完善了不断发展的推理轨迹. 我们引入了多代理信任制导中继器(MACR),这个框架使各代理之间能够进行动态中继协作. 关键的挑战在于确定何时应进行推理,以及哪些代理人应继续这一进程。 方法通过信心引导接力触发和基于其信心选择下一个代理人的投标机制来应对这一挑战。 关于四项基准的实验表明,方法在准确性方面超过了最强的单一模式战略,例如,在MathVista和MMStar上分别是+3.3%和+3.9%,而且与多代理战略相同,同时在Hallusion Bench和MMStar上消耗6.0x更低的象征性间接费用。 进一步的分析表明,接力协作能够使各种因素逐渐融合互补的见解,将各种能力结合到各种推理阶段。 我们的源代码可查阅https://github.com/67L1/MCR.

articles.title: OrthoRF: Exploring Orthogonality in Object-Centric Representations
articles.content: Neural synchrony is hypothesized to help the brain organize visual scenes into structured multi-object representations. In machine learning, synchrony-based models analogously learn object-centric representations by storing binding in the phase of complex-valued features. Rotating Features (RF) instantiate this idea with vector-valued activations, encoding object presence in magnitudes and affiliation in orientations. We propose Orthogonal Rotating Features (OrthoRF), which enforces orthogonality in RF's orientation space via an inner-product loss and architectural modifications. This yields sharper phase alignment and more reliable grouping. In evaluations of unsupervised object discovery, including settings with overlapping objects, noise, and out-of-distribution tests, OrthoRF matches or outperforms current models while producing more interpretable representations, and it eliminates the post-hoc clustering required by many synchrony-based approaches. Unlike current models, OrthoRF also recovers occluded object parts, indicating stronger grouping under occlusion. Overall, orthogonality emerges as a simple, effective inductive bias for synchrony-based object-centric learning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OrthoRF:探索物体-子表征中的矫形性
articles.content_zh: 神经同步被假设为帮助大脑将视觉场景组织成结构化的多对象表现. 在机器学习中,基于同步的模型类似地通过在复杂价值特性的相相中存储绑定来学习以对象为中心的表示. 旋转地物 (RF) 即时将这个想法与矢量值活化,编码对象在量子上的存在和从属性在取向上存在. 我们提出正交旋转地物(正交地物),通过内出产损失和建筑改造在RF的取向空间中执行正交地物. 这会产生更尖锐相接和更可靠的分组。 在对无监督对象发现的评价中,包括有重叠对象的设置,噪声,以及分流外测试,OrthorF匹配或优于当前模型,同时产生更可解释的表示,它消除了许多以同步为基础的方法所需要后分集. 与目前的模型不同,OrthorF还回收了被吞噬的物体部分,表明被吞噬下更强的分组. 总的来说,正交现象是作为一个简单,有效的诱导偏差而出现的,用于以同步为基础的以对象为中心的学习.

articles.title: Center-of-Mass Interpretation of Evolution Strategies
articles.content: Evolution strategies (ES) update a model by sampling a population of perturbed copies, scoring each one, and moving in the reward-weighted direction of the perturbations. This update is usually presented as an estimate of a smoothed gradient. We present a geometrical interpretation of this update instead. Treat each perturbed model as a particle and its reward as the particle's mass. Before scoring, every particle has the same mass and the population balances at its centroid. Once rewards are assigned, it balances at its reward-weighted center of mass instead. We show that the mean-subtracted ES update is exactly this displacement, scaled by a scalar factor that depends on the mean reward, for any finite population. The physical reading needs nonnegative rewards, which can always be arranged by adding a constant to every reward without changing the update. In the limit of a large population or under antithetic sampling, the centroid sits on the model itself, so ES has an even simpler geometric interpretation: from its current location, the model moves towards the reward-weighted center of mass of its own population. The same picture explains what subtracting the mean reward does: it changes the point from which the displacement is measured, from the model to the sampled centroid. Our contribution is an intuitive, geometric way to visualize an ES update, exact for any finite population.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 进化战略中心
articles.content_zh: 演化策略(ES)通过对被扰动的拷贝群进行抽样,对每个被扰动的被扰动者进行打分,并朝着被扰动者的受赏加权方向移动来更新模型. 此更新通常作为平滑梯度的估算. 我们对这一更新作了几何解释。 将每一个被扰动的模型当作粒子,并将它作为粒子质量的回报. 在得分前,每个粒子的质量都是一样的,人口在它的中间行星上保持平衡. 一旦分配了奖励,它就会在奖励加权的质量中心取得平衡。 我们显示,平均低于ES的更新正是这种迁移,以一个取决于任何有限人口的平均报酬的平分系数来衡量。 体能阅读需要非负面的奖励,这种奖励总是可以通过在每次奖励中添加一个常数而不改变更新来安排. 在人口多或被反神采样下的极限中,百分位机器人坐落在模型本身上,因此ES有更简单的几何解释: 从目前的位置,模型向自身人口质量的奖励加权中心移动. 同一图解解何以减取平均的奖励:它改变了衡量迁移的分点,从模型到被抽样的中间体. 我们的贡献是一种直观的,几何化的方法,可以直观地看到ES的更新,精确地说对于任何有限的人口来说都是如此.

articles.title: Preserve to Expand: Source-Aware Adaptation and Model Merging for Multilingual LLM-Based ASR
articles.content: Expanding multilingual ASR systems to new languages is challenging when adaptation must preserve previously supported languages without replaying source-language training data. We study this problem in connector-based Speech LLMs, where a trainable connector maps speech representations into a frozen large language model. We evaluate target-update construction and merging strategies for adapting the connector while preserving source-language performance. In single-target expansion, target-only fine-tuning and standard TIES merging learn new languages but cause severe source-language forgetting, while SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the best source-preserving trade-off. In multi-target expansion, update merging provides stable source retention, whereas recursive expansion can improve target adaptation under favorable orders but is highly order-sensitive. These results show that multilingual ASR expansion requires balancing target acquisition, source retention, and interactions among target-language updates.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 扩展保护:基于多种语言的LLM ASR的 source-Aware 适应和模型合并
articles.content_zh: 将多语种ASR系统扩大到新语言具有挑战性,因为适应必须保留先前支持的语言,而不重放源语言培训数据。 我们在基于连接器的Speech LLMs中研究了这个问题,其中可训练的连接器将语音表达图映射为被冻结的大语言模型. 我们评价目标更新的构建和合并战略,以调整连接器,同时保持源语言性能。 在单目标扩展中,仅针对对象的微调和标准TIES合并学习了新语言,但导致严重源语言遗忘,而SSU-Wanda+TIES给出了最好的源保存取舍. 在多目标扩展中,更新合并提供稳定的源保留,而递归扩展可以在有利的订单下改进目标适应,但对于订单高度敏感. 这些结果表明,多语种ASR扩展需要平衡目标获取,源保留,以及目标语言更新之间的互动.

articles.title: Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?
articles.content: Selection bias in large language models (LLMs) can persist despite instructions to ignore presentation order or prompts that elicit reasoning. Recent efforts to reproduce Jev-style System One behavior have produced a growing family of models that predict probabilities directly over supplied candidates. Yet systematic comparisons of selection bias across Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs remain limited in multi-option tasks. This leaves a central question: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias? We address this question with a simple test that shuffles options while keeping question and candidate content fixed. Across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs, we trace individual answers through eight presentations and compare them with fixed-order repetition. On our primary collection of 1,700 questions from two benchmarks, Jev's accuracy varies by less than two percentage points, yet its cumulative failure set expands by 27--29\% relative to the original order, with first failures continuing into the final presentation. This loss of initial successes is substantially larger than under fixed-order repetition, even for highly repeatable Jev reproductions. Nor does Jev show a general advantage over the LLM baselines in preserving correct choices. Aggregation offers limited protection: voting yields modest gains for Jev, while even unanimous answers are frequently wrong. These results expose a gap between repeatable decisions and decisions that remain correct across equivalent presentations, showing why stable accuracy alone cannot establish resistance to selection bias.

articles.title_zh: 了解Jev-Style系统一号模型: 结构是否减少选择偏差 ?
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)中的选择偏差尽管指示忽略演示顺序或提示引出推理,但仍能持续. 最近为复制Jev风格系统而作的努力 一种行为产生了越来越多的模型,可以直接预测所提供候选人的概率。 然而,在多选项任务中,对Jev版本、Jev复制版和遗传性LLMs的选择偏好进行的系统比较仍然有限。 这留下了一个中心问题:Jev式的决策结构是否减少了选择偏差? 我们用一个简单的测试来处理这个问题,这种测试在排除各种选择的同时,使问题和候选人的内容保持不变。 通过两个Jev版本,十二个Jev复制, 以及六个遗传性LLM, 我们通过八个演示来追踪单个答案, 并将其与固定顺序的重复进行比较。 在我们从两个基准中初步收集出1700个问题时,Jev的准确度相差不到2个百分点,然而其累积失败设定比起最初的顺序扩大了27-29分,最初的失败持续到最后的表述. 最初的成功损失大大超过固定顺序的重复损失,即使是极可重复的Jev复制。 Jev在保留正确的选择方面也没有表现出比LLM基线的一般优势. 汇总提供了有限的保护:投票给Jev带来的收益不大,而即使是一致的答复也常常是错误的. 这些结果暴露出可重复的决定与同等列报中仍然正确的决定之间的差距,表明为什么仅靠稳定的准确性无法对选择偏差产生阻力。

articles.title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

articles.title_zh: 学习何时提交: 快速扩散语言模型的排程抖动
articles.content_zh: 分化出大型语言模型(dLLMs)可以并行生成多个符号,但往往需要许多解码回合来完成一个响应. 高效的生成不仅取决于哪些符号易于预测,还取决于如何对之作出承诺来帮助预测所剩位置。 一个非常可预测的标志可能无法提供有用的背景,而揭示一个不太可预测的标志可以帮助其他几个立场更早地变得可预测。 我们提出 dSpark, 一个新的基于分解时间表的框架, 学习何时为更快的传播语言生成承诺符号。 为了实现这一点,我们构建了揭开伪装的时间表,这些时间表将显示的标志列为优先事项,从而使其他位置更容易预测,从而减少早些时候在解码方面的不确定性。 然后我们把这些时间表分馏到模型中,以便能够更快地进行平行取样,使用KL-潜水常态器来帮助保存生成质量. 我们在数学推理和代码生成任务中广泛评价我们的方法。 在GSM8K上,我们的方法在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上分别实现显著的10.12美元和5.12美元的速度,同时保持了优异的任务性能. 我们的代码可查阅https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark。

articles.title: Quantifying Claim Smoothing by LLM Research Agents
articles.content: Deep research, or any use of large language models (LLMs) to read a large document collection and produce insights, requires synthesizing information from different sources. In this work, we find that LLMs produce long-form research reports that read as confident syntheses but which fail to accurately reflect the underlying documents. We call this failure smoothing. In collapsing diverse and potentially conflicting sources into a single narrative, the model discards the evidential "jaggedness" of its corpus and asserts conclusions more decisive than the citations can support. We introduce a claim level scoring pipeline, SmoothScore, to quantify this effect. Our pipeline extracts key conclusive claims from model generated reports, then finds evidence relevant to each claim and clusters that evidence along high level aspects. Finally, each claim is scored with respect to the evidence to quantify the degree of smoothing done by the agent. Across 7 systems and 4 datasets, we find that agents consistently produce stronger claims than warranted.

articles.title_zh: LLM研究代理公司对索赔进行量化平滑
articles.content_zh: 深入研究,或任何使用大型语言模型(LLMs)来读取大型文件集并产生见解,都需要从不同来源合成信息. 在这项工作中,我们发现LLMS产生长式的调查报告,读作自信的综述,但未能准确反映基本文件. 我们称之为故障平滑。 模型将各种可能相互冲突的来源合并成单一的叙述,从而抛弃了其主体证据的"标记",并断言结论比引用证据更具有决定性。 我们采用了一个索赔等级评分的管道,平滑分数,以量化这种影响。 我们的管道从模型生成的报告中取出关键的结论性索赔,然后找到与每项索赔有关的证据,并找出与高级别方面有关的证据。 最后,每项索赔的得分与确定代理人平滑程度的证据有关。 在整个7个系统和4个数据集中,我们发现,代理人不断提出比正当要求更强烈的要求。

articles.title: Atomic Security Concerns: Towards a Foundational Language for Security Knowledge Representation
articles.content: Cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance, and security architecture rely on numerous concepts, including security properties, domains, controls, risks, implementation measures, capabilities, and compliance requirements. Although these concepts are widely used, they are often represented through heterogeneous abstractions and vocabularies, making relationships among them difficult to express consistently and leaving much of the associated reasoning dependent on expert knowledge. This paper introduces the concepts of Security Concerns and Atomic Security Concerns (ASCs) and explores the hypothesis that cybersecurity knowledge may be represented through a finite set of foundational concerns. Inspired by the role of atoms in chemistry, the proposed approach views cybersecurity concepts as compositions of more fundamental concerns rather than as independent abstractions. Hence, Atomic Security Concerns could be viewed as a common abstraction layer for the representation of cybersecurity concepts, independently of their domain, nature, or level of granularity. Building upon this perspective, the paper explores how Atomic Security Concerns may provide the vocabulary of a cybersecurity language and how cybersecurity concepts may be represented as concern sets supporting explicit relationships among concepts. The contribution of this work is intentionally conceptual: it introduces a framework and research hypothesis for investigating the foundations of a common language for cybersecurity knowledge representation, reasoning, and future formalization.

articles.title_zh: 原子安全关切:建立安全知识代表的基本语言
articles.content_zh: 网络安全治理、风险管理、合规和安全架构依赖许多概念,包括安全属性、领域、控制、风险、执行措施、能力和合规要求。 虽然这些概念被广泛使用,但它们往往通过各种抽象和词汇来体现,使它们之间的关系难以一致地表达,并留下许多相关推理依赖于专家的知识. 本文件介绍了安全关切和原子安全关切的概念,并探讨网络安全知识可通过一系列有限的基本关切得到体现这一假设。 受原子在化学中作用的启发,拟议方法将网络安全概念视为更根本关注的构成,而不是独立的抽象. 因此, 原子安全关切可被视为网络安全概念的一个共同抽象层,而不论其范围、性质或颗粒度。 以这一视角为基础,本文件探讨了原子安全关切如何提供网络安全语言的词汇,以及网络安全概念如何作为支持概念之间明确关系的关切问题得到体现。 这项工作的贡献有意是概念性的:它引入了一个框架和研究假设,用于调查网络安全知识表现、推理和未来形式化的共同语言的基础。

articles.title: SEMA-Auto: Sighted and Efficient Multi-Turn Attack with Autonomy
articles.content: Existing jailbreak attackers fall into two classes: static planners fix their single- or multi-turn adversarial plans in advance, remaining simple but losing sight of the victim's replies, wasting turns and limiting transferability; interactive generators read each victim reply to generate the next-turn attack but require in-loop evaluators for success signals or hints, incurring substantial costs and inflated performance. Bridging this gap, we propose SEMA-Auto, a sighted and efficient multi-turn attacker with autonomy, interacting with the victim model and terminating the session by itself upon success. To stabilize its behaviors and boost its capabilities, SEMA-Auto is trained in two stages. Synthetic bootstrap tuning installs the notion of attack targets and conforming decisions by fine-tuning the base model with bootstrapped trajectories. Decision-supervised reinforcement learning then optimizes two objectives jointly yet separately, reinforcing the attack with higher jailbreak reward while supervising the decision at each turn against an absolute target. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) attack success rates (ASR) across multiple datasets, victims, and judges, outperforming all static and interactive baselines, within almost the fewest turns, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency. For example, SEMA-Auto performs a $76.0\%$ ASR@1 within an average of $3.0$ turns against DeepSeek-V4-Flash on AdvBench, while the best static baseline is $54.8\%$ with fixed $7$ turns and the best interactive baseline is $43.8\%$ in $3.7$ turns. Against safety-hardened frontier models, GPT-oss-120B, GPT-5.4, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and GPT-6-Astra, our counter-trained attacker achieves an average $59.6\%$ ASR@1 on HarmBench, $13.8\%$ over prior SOTA. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/SEMA

articles.title_zh: SEMA-Auto:有意识和高效的多回合攻击
articles.content_zh: 现有的越狱攻击者分为两类:静态规划者提前确定单回合或多回合对抗计划,保持简单但忽略了被害者的答复,浪费了转弯,限制了可转移性;交互式发电机读取每个被害者的答复,以产生下一轮攻击,但需要现场评价员才能发出成功信号或提示,造成大量成本并夸大性能。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议SEMA-Auto,一个具有自主性的有远见和高效率的多回合攻击者,与受害者模式互动,一旦成功就结束会议。 为了稳定其行为并提升其能力,SEMA-Auto分两个阶段受训. 合成"靴子"调制安装了攻击目标的概念,并通过用"靴子"的轨迹来细化底模来适应决定. 由决策监督的强化学习然后将两个目标合并而单独地优化,以更高的越狱奖励来强化攻击,同时监督每个回合的决定与绝对目标相对应。 我们的方法实现了最新技术(SOTA),攻击了多个数据集、受害者和法官的成功率(ASR),在几乎最少的转弯范围内,超过了所有静态和互动基线,显示出效力和效率。 例如,SEMA-Auto在平均3.0美元范围内对Adv Bench的DeepSeek-V4-Flash执行76.0美元ASR@1,而最佳静态基线为54.8美元,固定为7美元;最佳互动基线为43.8美元(3.7美元)。 对抗安全坚固的前沿型号,GPT-oss-120B,GPT-5.4,克洛德-海库-4.5,以及GPT-6-Astra,我们的反训练攻击者在Harm Bench上平均获得59.6美元ASR@1分,比SOTA前作13.8分. 我们的代码见https://github.com/microsoft/SEMA。

articles.title: Can JEV Support Clinical Trial Criteria Assessment?
articles.content: Clinical trial prescreening requires distinguishing unmet conditions from insufficient evidence in patient records. Given patient records, criterion questions, and predefined answer options, we retrospectively compared JEV, a non-generative decision model returning native option probabilities, with schema-constrained Qwen Flash across 2,048 test patient-condition pairs from TrialGPT and question-answer datasets derived from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, all evaluated under strict Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policies to ensure clinical data privacy. Both models assessed conditions individually or in batches sharing the same patient context, with performance measured against reference labels. In batch mode, JEV and Qwen achieved similar macro-F1 scores on TrialGPT (0.652 vs. 0.660) and MIMIC-IV (0.807 vs. 0.814), whereas JEV substantially outperformed Qwen on MIMIC-III (0.768 vs. 0.534; $Δ$ = +0.234, 95% CI: 0.187-0.281). This advantage largely reflected higher recall for conditions labeled as having insufficient information (56.3% vs. 9.9%). Across all three datasets, JEV also had lower observed median job latency (1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90 s) and 53%-74% lower estimated cost per condition. These findings position JEV as an initial assessment component that provides criterion-level judgments and flags potential information gaps for review. JEV's observed errors in interpreting clinical evidence underscore the need to verify its outputs against patient records before they inform eligibility decisions.

articles.title_zh: JEV可以吗? 支持临床试验标准评估?
articles.content_zh: 临床试验预先筛选需要区分未满足的条件和病人记录中证据不足。 考虑到患者记录,标准问题,以及预先定义的答案选项,我们追溯性地比较了JEV,一种非再生性决定模型,返回本土选项概率,在TerricGPT的2,048个测试患者条件对和MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV的问答数据集中,通过严格零数据保留(ZDR)政策进行评估,以确保临床数据隐私. 这两种模型都单独或分批地评估了相同病人的情况,其性能以参考标签来衡量。 在批量模式下,JEV和Quen在TrialGPT(0.652 vs. 0.660)和MIMIC-IV(0.807 vs. 0.814)上取得了类似的宏-F1分数,而JEV在MIMIC-III(0.768 vs. 0.534;美元=+0.234,95% CI:0.187-0.281)上的成绩则大大超过Quen. 这一优势主要反映了被贴上信息不足标签的条件召回率较高(56.3%对9.9%)。 在所有三个数据集中,JEV的中位值值也较低(1.18-1.40对2.80-8.90 s),每个条件的估计费用为53%-74%。 这些结论将联合核查小组定位为初步评估组成部分,提供标准一级的判断,并标出潜在的信息差距供审查。 JEV在解释临床证据时观察到的错误突出表明,在病人记录告知合格决定之前,必须对照这些记录核实其产出。

articles.title: Quantitative Generalization Bounds for Multi-Layer Transformers: A Few Long Strings can Beat Many Short Ones
articles.content: Transformer-based language models exhibit an astonishing capacity to generalize to longer and more difficult problem instances than those seen in training. However, theoretical understanding of this phenomenon still lags behind. Unlike most machine learning models, the generalisation abilities of transformers inherently require considering two axes. On one hand, one must examine in-distribution statistical generalisation, which concerns the ability of a model to broaden a function from training samples to novel samples of the same distribution. On the other hand, given the sequential nature of language data, one must also consider length generalisation, which reflects whether a model trained on inputs of a given length can extrapolate to longer ones.These two notions have mostly been studied separately, leaving open how they interact. In this work, we give a joint treatment of both axes for fixed-precision transformers. We give generalisation guarantees in terms of the parameter sizes of the involved models, as well as the quantization space and the alphabet size that supply the sequences. Finally, we illustrate how the requirements in the sample count and training length trade off. In particular, we find that increasing training length can be exponentially more efficient than increasing the sample size. Experiments support predictions of the theory.

articles.title_zh: 定量泛化 多层 变形器 : 几个长弦可以击败许多短弦
articles.content_zh: 以变形器为基础的语言模式显示出惊人的能力,可以概括到比培训中看到的时间更长、更困难的问题。 然而,对这一现象的理论理解仍然滞后. 与大多数机器学习模型不同,变压器的通俗化能力本质上需要考虑两个轴. 一方面,必须审查分配统计概况,这涉及一个模型能否将功能从培训样本扩大到同一分布的新样本。 另一方面,鉴于语言数据的相继性质,人们还必须考虑长度通论,这反映了一个在一定长度输入上受过训练的模型是否能够推断出更长的长度. 这两个概念大多是分开研究的,留下了它们互动的方式. 在这项工作中,我们给固定精度变压器两轴进行联合处理. 我们从所涉模型的参数大小以及提供序列的量化空间和字母大小方面提供概括性保障。 最后,我们说明抽样统计的要求和培训时间如何相互交换。 特别是,我们发现,增加培训时间比增加样本数量要有效得多。 实验支持该理论的预测.

articles.title: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
articles.content:
For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost.
  This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries.
  Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.

articles.title_zh: 从自信心到统计 准确性:利用直接审计和LLM-Asssociated审计来扩大 " 环中人 " 评价
articles.content_zh:
对于大型语言模型(LLMs)和多模式大型语言模型(MLLMs)来说,模型上报的自信心往往被错校,然而对于高效的评价仍然可能有用. 同时,LLM-as-a-judge为直接人力审计提供了可扩展的替代方案,但其实际效益取决于校正质量和推论成本.
本文件根据备选抽样战略为两种评价路线制定统一的统计框架。 在直接审计时,采用信心分级抽样方法,从部分核实的产出中恢复人口准确性,而不需要校准信心。 有限抽样不确定性的特点,分析显示,高度不均衡的信任阶层如何影响审计效率和标签分配。 对于法官协助的评价,法官通过敏感度和假阳性率进行模拟,得出一个有校正不确定性的错误校正估计器. 然后通过人类标签和总成本效率界限来比较这两条路线。
关于MMLU-Pro和MMU-Pro的实验表明,错误的自信心仍然可以支持统计上有效的分层审计. 在高度不平衡的信心分配下,比例分配比平分层分配大大降低了估计误差。 就法官协助的评价而言,只有一小部分目标核查人配对能够满足理想化的人类标签效率条件,自动推论费用可以进一步限制潜在的节约。 这些调查结果澄清了在哪些统计和经济条件下信任指导审计和自动核查是有用的。

articles.title: MiRL: Error-Targeted Reinforcement Learning for Correcting Terminal Agent Misbehaviors
articles.content: Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.

articles.title_zh: MiRL:针对错误的用于纠正终端代理不良行为的强化学习
articles.content_zh: 以错误为目标的学习为改进模型提供了可辨别的方法:找出模型的具体弱点,训练模型来弥补这些弱点,并检查这些弱点是否被固定. 我们研究如何将针对错误的学习应用到终端代理上,它通过与命令外壳的相互作用来解决自然语言中指定的长视距任务. 现有的针对出错的方法是为单回合任务所设计的,现有的对剂故障的分析被用来评价和调试剂,而不是训练. 我们提出由不当行为驱动的RL(MIRL),它首先描述了寻找可概括的不当行为的政策错误:在许多环境中重复的各类错误步骤. MiRL随后用RL来训练政策,开始在这些不当行为发生的步骤上展开,并且只有在通过测试并避免了不当行为的情况下才会奖励推出. 在Quen3.5-4B上,有8起不当行为占了52.1%的错步. 在MIRL培训后,该政策重复了所测量的43%到57%的不见前缀平均较少的不当行为。 MiRL在Bench Lite终端(51.8%对47.4%)上超越了TMax-4B,并在Bench 2.1终端(21.3%对20.6%)上与其相匹配,同时使用其推出的35%. 这些结果表明,针对错误的学习可以应用于现实的,长视距的终端任务.

articles.title: Not One Belief: Answer Payloads, Persistence, and Dissociated Confidence Signals in Conversational Question Answering
articles.content: Conversational QA systems should fix errors when users push back and signal which answers to trust. We split each follow-up into its speech act (re-ask, agree, or challenge) and its payload (an answer string, correct or not), and measure four confidence signals on the same transcripts: verbalized confidence, length-normalized likelihood, a frozen hidden-state probe, and P(True). Answers change when the user supplies an answer string and almost never under the speech act alone: in every retained full-size cell, the correct answer converts at least four times as many wrong answers as re-asking or agreement. The four signals disagree. On Qwen2.5-7B the frozen probe rises with answer persistence rather than truth; this holds on held-out questions, with Llama-3-8B (cleaned answers) as support, but not on four other models. Among 81 Qwen2.5-7B errors that survive one re-ask, re-asking, a fresh chat, or abstain repair almost none, while a gold answer repairs 75-95%. In two preregistered replications, every repair rate without an answer string stays below 0.15; a larger post-hoc rerun excludes 0.15 except for the empty elicit. With BM25 TriviaQA evidence, sentences that contain the answer repair 67-76% of persistent errors versus at most 12% when they do not. An end-to-end contain-gate cuts harm on TriviaQA, but a deployable gate that does not know the gold answer repairs few errors.

articles.title_zh: 不是一个信仰:回答有效载荷、持久性和在对话中解开的信任信号
articles.content_zh: 对话式的QA系统在用户推后并发出响应信任的信号时,应当纠正出错. 我们把每起后续事件分为其语音行为(重新任务,同意,或质疑)及其有效载荷(一个回答字符串,正确与否),并在同一笔录上测量出四个信任信号:口语化的自信,长度正常化的可能性,一个被冻结的隐藏状态探测器,和P(True). 当用户提供一个答案字符串并且几乎从未在语音下单独行动时,答案会发生变化:在每个被保留的完整大小的单元格中,正确的答案会转换至少4倍于重新询问或协议的错误答案. 四相相相发相. 在Quen2.5-7B上,被冻结的探测器随着回答的持久性而不是真实性而上升;这与被搁置的问题有关,Llama-3-8B(被清理的答案)是支持的,但不是其他四个模型. 在81个Qwen2.5-7B错误中,一个重置,重置,一回新鲜聊天,或者弃权修复几乎无一回,而一回金答修复了75-95%. 在两次预先注册的复制中,每一次没有答案字符串的修复率都保持在0.15以下;一次较大的后重跑排除了0.15,除了空取. 与 BM25 特里维亚 QA 证据,包含答案的句子修复了67%至76%的持续错误,而在没有持续错误时最多修复了12%. 一个端到端的内装门会切除对TriviaQA的伤害,但是一个可部署的门不会知道金子的答案修复很少出错.

articles.title: Adapting LLM-SC to Living Sacred Heritage: Domain-Specific Extraction, Semantic Networks and Human Evaluation on Pashupatinath Temple Reviews
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) pipelines can turn visitor reviews into structured data, but generic schemes may miss rituals, sacred spaces, cultural restrictions and emotionally mixed experiences at living sacred heritage sites. We adapted the LLM-Social Computing (LLM-SC) framework to Pashupatinath Temple, Nepal, by specifying a 12-type entity taxonomy (four original LLM-SC types plus eight sacred-heritage types), four relation types and nine aspect-sentiment dimensions in a GPT-4o extraction prompt, which was applied to a fixed random sample of 2,500 English-language Tripadvisor reviews from a processed corpus of 3,939. The exports contain 11,286 entity, 6,232 aspect-sentiment and 5,590 relation records, covering 2,485, 2,487 and 2,433 reviews, respectively; the eight added sacred-heritage types account for 64.8% of entity records. Against an adjudicated two-annotator reference for 200 reviews, exact normalized surface-and-type matching gave provisional entity scores of 41.0% precision, 21.8% recall and 28.4% micro-F1. Aspect-presence F1 was 53.6% and end-to-end aspect-plus-polarity F1 was 42.6%. Human adjudication supported 153 of 194 first-listed relation candidates (one per review; 78.9%), a candidate-level rate that does not estimate relation recall or whole-graph precision. The contribution is a culturally grounded, domain-specific adaptation with component-wise human evaluation and explicit reproducibility and generalization limitations.

articles.title_zh: 使LLM-SC适应活生生的神圣遗产:域-特定采掘、语义网络和普舒帕蒂纳斯寺庙评论的人类评价
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)管道可以将访问者评论变成结构化的数据,但通用计划可能会错过活生生的神圣遗产地的仪式,神圣空间,文化限制和情感上混杂的经历. 我们将LLM-社会计算(LLM-SC)框架改编为尼泊尔的Pashupatinath Temple,具体做法是指定一个12种实体分类学(4种原始LLM-SC类型外加8种神圣遗产类型),4种关系类型和9个方面-sentiment维度在GPT-4o取出快件中被应用到一个固定随机样本中,从3,939的处理中抽取了2,500个英文Tripadvisor评论. 出口中包含11 286个实体、6 232个方面同意书和5 590个关系记录,分别涉及2 485个、2 487个和2 433个审查;另外8个神圣遗产类型占实体记录的64.8%。 与200次审查中裁定的两位注释者参照,完全正常的地表和类型比对给出了41.0%的精确度、21.8%的回溯率和28.4%的微F1. 视差-存在F1为53.6%,端到端相加-极分F1为42.6%。 人类裁决支持194名初次上市关系候选人中的153人(每期审查1人;78.9%),这一候选人级别的比例不估计关系召回或整图精确度。 这种贡献是一种基于文化的、针对特定领域的适应,其中包含基于组成部分的人类评估以及明确的再生产和概括限制。

articles.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
articles.content: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.

articles.title_zh: 评价深搜索 V4.1 Flash-1017 失控和有害操纵风险
articles.content_zh: 随着前沿语言模型的能力和自主性不断增强,独立的第三方评价对于描述其系统性安全风险至关重要。 虽然封闭源码的发布通常伴有全面的系统卡,但开放式模式在前沿风险方面的审查较少。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了对DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017的独立安全评价,最新版本的V4.1 从V4出发的闪光带新的建筑, 扩大的训练,和强大的代理能力。 根据欧盟的通用AI业务守则,我们评估了34个基准的模型,包括5个内部套房,涉及评价的完整性、失控和有害的操纵。 与AEF-1标准一致,我们比较了V4.1 Flash-1017和V4.1 Flash,更早的DeepSeek V4模型,以及领先的闭源系统(GPT-6 Astra,GPT-5.6 Sol,和双子座 3.8 Flash). 总计,V4.1 Flash-1017显示在V4生成器上安全性大幅提高,在几个维度上采用或匹配了领先的闭源基线,同时仍然表现出值得持续关注的显著行为. 根据我们的调查结果,我们强调三项关键意见和建议。 首先,由于安全性可以在小更新中发生转变甚至倒退,开发者应将安全评价纳入增量发布. 第二,由于仅靠最后回合的产出和结束状态检查无法可靠地发现控制丧失行为,部署需要从程序层面观察推理痕迹和行动日志。 第三,由于公共基准引起对评价的强烈认识并面临数据被污染的风险,制定私人基准对于可靠的前沿评价至关重要。

articles.title: Improving JEV Entailment Reranking with Span Readouts and Selective Adaptation
articles.content: JEV decision models pair a language model backbone with a lightweight scoring head to select among natural-language options. Direct selection compares candidate answers within one request, whereas entailment reranking evaluates each candidate in a separate natural language inference (NLI) request over fixed relation options. We examine whether the readout and adaptation choices used for direct selection remain effective for cross-request reranking. We combine a mean-span readout with selective backbone adaptation. Mean-span pooling replaces the option-ending pointer with an average of the contextualized states inside each NLI option, without adding head parameters. Selective adaptation retains low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters. On MC11, which averages accuracy over eleven reranking configurations from seven sources, selective adaptation improves NeoHorse-1-4B accuracy over the all-module baseline while cutting trainable parameters by more than half, and mean-span pooling yields further consistent gains at the same parameter count.

articles.title: Offline Language-Based Support System for Tactical Decision-Making in Air Combat Operations
articles.content: An offline language-based support tool is presented to assist pilot training and tactical decision-making in air combat operations. The system, named MATE (Mission Assistant for Training and Evaluation), applies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to answer natural language questions using content extracted from doctrinal and tactical manuals. Built entirely with open-source components, it performs text preprocessing, embedding generation, semantic search, and language generation locally, ensuring full offline functionality. The tool was evaluated by three Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots, who rated the answers produced with three open-weight language models (Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 14B, and Mistral NeMo 12B) to five tactical questions derived from a publicly available air combat manual. Average ratings ranged from 4.00 to 4.40 on a five-point scale, with Mistral NeMo 12B obtaining the highest score, and the pilots rated the response time of the tool as fully adequate compared to manual search. The relevance of the retrieved content was identified as the main point for improvement. Potential applications are discussed in onboard mission systems, flight simulators, and training environments.

articles.title_zh: 空战行动战术决策离线语文支助系统
articles.content_zh: 提供了一个基于语言的离线支助工具,以协助空中作战行动的试点培训和战术决策。 该系统名为MATE(特派团培训和评价助理),采用检索辅助生成(RAG)方法,利用从理论和战术手册中提取的内容回答自然语言问题。 它完全由开源组件所建,它执行文本预处理,嵌入生成,语义搜索,以及本地语言生成,确保全线下功能. 该工具被三名巴西空军战斗机飞行员评价,他们将使用三种开放量级语言模型(Llama 3.1 8B,Quen 2.5 14B,和Mistral NeMo 12B)生成的答案评为出自于公开的空战手册的五个战术问题. 平均收视率从4:00到4.40不等,分数为5分,Mistral NeMo 12B获得最高分数,与人工搜索相比,飞行员将工具的响应时间评为完全充分. 检索内容的相关性被确定为需要改进的要点。 潜在的应用在飞行任务系统、飞行模拟器和培训环境中讨论。

articles.title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
articles.content: Skills provide agents with reusable experience to guide future decisions without modifying the underlying model. However, coding trajectories are often entangled with task- and repository-specific contexts, making it challenging to distill procedural skills that generalize across diverse coding environments. To address this challenge, we present Hierarchical Skill Evolution (HSE), which progressively distills procedural knowledge from coding trajectories through hierarchical evidence aggregation. HSE first extracts task-level evidence from individual trajectories, then aggregates recurring evidence within the same repository to form repository-specific skill candidates, and finally consolidates consistent patterns across repositories into transferable skills across repositories. The evolution is driven by an external writer-evaluator loop that generates and assesses skills while keeping the underlying coding model frozen. The loop externally updates the writer and evaluator policies to improve subsequent skill generation and assessment. This hierarchy progressively filters task-specific details while preserving procedures that generalize across diverse coding environments. Successful trajectories yield reusable guidance for future tasks, while failed trajectories reveal recurring failure modes that guide avoidance and recovery. We evaluate HSE on SWE-bench Verified and DeepSWE, using GLM-5.2 across Pi and Claude Code harnesses and GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 with Pi. Across both benchmarks, 10 skills evolved solely from SWE-Gym improve coding performance across all evaluated settings, demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models, and agent harnesses. We further evolve the skill library from target-benchmark trajectories without verifier feedback, relying solely on the learned evaluator for candidate assessment and achieving additional gains through benchmark-tailored skills.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 编码代理的分级技能进化
articles.content_zh: 技能为代理人提供了可重复使用的经验来指导未来决策,而无需修改基本模式. 然而,编码轨迹往往与任务和寄存器的特定背景相缠绕,因此难以提炼出跨越不同编码环境的通用程序技能. 为了应对这一挑战,我们介绍了分级技能进化(HSE),它通过分级证据汇总逐步从编码轨迹中提炼出程序知识. HSE首先从单个轨迹中取出任务级证据,再将重复出现的证据汇总在同一存储库内,形成存储库特定技能的候选者,并最后将各存储库的一致模式整合为可跨存储库的可转移技能. 演化由外部的写作员-评价员循环所驱动,该循环生成和评估技能,同时使基础编码模型被冻结. 外部循环更新了作者和评价者的政策,以改善随后的技能生成和评估。 这种分级方式逐渐过滤特定任务的细节,同时保留在各种编码环境中通用的程序. 成功的轨迹为未来任务提供了可再用的指导,而失败的轨迹则揭示出反复出现的能指导避免和回收的故障模式. 我们在SWE-bench验证和DeepSWE上评价HSE,使用GLM-5.2跨Pi和Claude Code tapes以及GPT-5.5和用Pi的Opus 4.8。 在整个两个基准中,10个技能完全从SWE-Gym改进了所有评价环境中的编码性能,展示了跨基准、编码模型和代理工具的转移。 我们进一步发展技能库,使其从目标基准轨迹演变而来,没有核查反馈,完全依靠已学习的评审人员进行候选人评估,并通过适合基准的技能取得额外收益。

articles.title: Making Reasoning Visible: Configuration-Aware Diagnostic Modeling for Adaptive Scaffolding in Structured Reasoning Tasks
articles.content: Modeling the latent, multi-step reasoning processes of learners is a core challenge for adaptive tutoring systems, which often rely on simple right/wrong answers rather than understanding how students think. Instantiated here for grammatical reasoning, this study introduces a diagnostic framework that makes students' step-by-step problem-solving visible by analyzing their action sequences in an interactive learning game. The framework computes five interpretable strategy dimensions (e.g., systematic error correction, random guessing), estimates coordination demand from task structure and behavioral patterns, and classifies reasoning into four distinct states. Analyzing 36,234 interactions from 234 students working on 42 morphosyntactic exercises, we found that reasoning strategies vary primarily by context rather than stable traits (intraclass correlation = 0.14), and students show high persistence in unproductive states; specifically, 74.6% of failures driven by high coordination demand (rather than simple knowledge gaps) are followed by another failure without intervention. Our early warning model predicts validation success with strong accuracy (AUC = 0.826 using strategy patterns alone; 0.902 with additional sequential context) while avoiding circular reliance on current error counts. These findings demonstrate that making latent reasoning processes visible enables earlier, more targeted scaffolding that responds to how students are thinking rather than simply whether they succeed. While demonstrated in language learning, the framework provides a generalizable, interpretable architecture for diagnosing complex, structured reasoning in any domain.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 提出理由 可见:结构化理性任务中适应性脚手架的配置-智能诊断模型
articles.content_zh: 模拟学习者潜在的多步骤推理过程是适应性辅导系统的核心挑战,这些系统往往依赖简单的正确/错误的答案,而不是理解学生的思维方式. 这里为语法推理提供了佐证,本研究引入了一个诊断框架,通过在交互式学习游戏中分析学生的动作序列,使学生的分步解决问题变得明显. 框架计算出5个可解释的战略维度(如系统错误校正,随机猜测),从任务结构和行为模式中估算协调需求,将推理分为四个不同的状态. 分析来自从事42个形态学练习的234名学生的36 234次互动,我们发现推理策略主要因背景不同而不同,而非稳定性特征(内部关联=0.14),学生在非生产性状态下表现出高度持久性;具体来说,74.6%的失败是由高协调需求所驱动的(而不是简单的知识差距),随后是一次没有干预的失败. 我们的预警模型以很强的准确度预测验证成功(AUC=0.826仅使用策略模式;0.902附加相继上下文),同时避免循环依赖当前出错计数. 这些调查结果表明,使潜在推理过程明显可见,可以更早、更有针对性的脚手架,回应学生的思维方式,而不仅仅是他们是否成功。 虽然在语言学习中表现出来,但框架为诊断任何领域的复杂,有条理的推理提供了一个可概括,可解释的架构.

articles.title: Linear Probes Transfer from Base to Distilled Language Models despite Rotation
articles.content: Linear probes, classifiers that read a language model's internal activations, are widely used to detect harmful requests. They are cheap to train and run, and an auditor who has trained one would like to reuse it when the model is replaced by a successor rather than retrain it for every release. We test how well probes can be reused. For four base models (Qwen2.5-Math-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B) we train a probe on the base model with the XSTest prompt set and apply it, unchanged, to two successors of that base: the DeepSeek-R1 distilled reasoning model and the developer's instruction-tuned chat model. We find that the successors rotate the direction separating unsafe from safe prompts by 17$^\circ$ to 35$^\circ$, yet on XSTest the transferred probe's AUC changes by only $-0.011$ to $+0.027$, and on an independent OR-Bench evaluation, never used for training, by $-0.015$ to $+0.053$. On XSTest, whose safe prompts deliberately contain alarming words, the probes beat a classifier that sees only the prompt text by 0.15 to 0.20 AUC. On the OR-Bench prompts that margin shrinks to 0.03 to 0.20, and the probes flag 29\% to 42\% of prompts that sound harmful but are benign, so part of what they read is the appearance of harm rather than harm itself. A probe trained on a base model can thus be reused, in these families, after distillation and after instruction tuning; how much it reads beyond textual cues depends on the test set.

articles.title: Integrate the Reward, Don't Sample It: Window Likelihood for Interruptions and Backchannels in Full-Duplex Speech Models
articles.content: A full-duplex spoken dialogue model must yield when the user cuts in and hold when the user merely backchannels. Sequence-level RL with a timing reward (GRPO) is the usual recipe; we test its whole-rollout form on four open models and find two failures. A binary window reward gives zero advantage on exactly the windows that most need learning (a zero-gradient trap), and the one score per rollout is spread over listening-state decisions the reward is not written in terms of (credit leakage), so the model talks into silence or stops answering. Both come from sampling a reward that is a known function of a few binary control decisions. We propose \emph{window likelihood} (\WL): sample a continuation per window, but integrate in closed form over the stop decisions it visits and maximise the log-probability of acting correctly---a noisy-OR for yielding, a survival product for holding. On HumDial-FDBench, \WL\ gives the best yield/hold F1 on all six structurally different open models we post-train, exceeds Kyutai's released GRPO checkpoints (trained on different data), and adds no re-opening of the floor on any model.
