articles.title_zh: 整合奖励,不要样本 它: 完全双相语音模型中中断和后通道的窗口可能性
articles.content_zh: 当用户切入时,当用户仅仅是回声道时,一个全复式的口语对话模式必须产生效果。 附有计时奖励的序列级RL(GRPO)是常用的配方;我们用四个开放模型测试其整体推出形式并发现两个失败. 二进制窗口奖励在最需要学习的窗口上给予零优势(一个零分级的陷阱),每次推出的一分都分布在监听状态的决定上,奖励不写在(信用泄漏)上,所以模型谈话沉默或停止回答. 两者都来自对一些二进制控制决定中已知的奖励的抽样。 我们提议\emph{窗口概率}(\WL):每个窗口都抽取一个续作,但在它访问的停止决定中以闭合的形式整合,并最大限度地实现正确行事的对数概率 - - - - - - - ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 在HumDial-FDBench上,\WL\给我们所有6个结构上不同的开放模式上的最佳收益/持有F1,超过了Kyutai发布的GRPO检查站(根据不同数据训练),并且没有在任何模式上添加重新打开地板.

articles.title: EXCISE: Locating and Excising Distracting Sentences in Medical Question Answering
articles.content: Language models are increasingly considered for clinical decision support, where their answers should be grounded in clinical evidence and remain robust to irrelevant information. Prior work shows that a single irrelevant sentence can lower the accuracy of medical models, but not where inside the model its effect can be removed, or how to do so without knowing which sentence it is. We find that blocking attention to a known distractor restores the answer, whereas head masking can suppress correct answers. We also show that the model's hidden states mark the distractor as the sentence that least fits the case even when the model follows it. To remove a distractor's effect without knowing which sentence it is, we propose EXCISE, an inference-time method that blocks the sentence most influencing the answer, but only if the model's hidden states mark it as inconsistent with the case. On MedQA-TD (MedQA with Targeted Distractors), a benchmark we construct in which each distractor targets a specific wrong option, EXCISE gains 16.7-22.8 accuracy points at a 1.5-2.1-point cost on the same questions without distractors, outperforming prompting, rewriting, and steering baselines for all three models. Its gains extend to MedDistractQA and BiasMedQA, as well as chain-of-thought generation.

articles.title_zh: EXCISE: 医疗问题回答中的分心判决
articles.content_zh: 语言模型越来越多地被考虑用于临床决策支持,其答案应当基于临床证据,并且对不相干的信息保持坚固. 先前的研究表明,单句无关的句子可以降低医疗模型的准确性,但不能在模型内部去除其效果,或者在不知是哪个句子的情况下如何去除. 我们发现阻断对已知分心器的注意可以恢复答案,而头部面具可以压制正确的答案. 我们还表明,模型的隐藏状态将分心器标记为即使模型跟随它时也最不合适的句子. 为了去除分心者的效果,而不知道它是什么句子,我们提出EXCISE,一种推论-时间方法,它阻断了最能影响答案的句子,但只有当模型所隐藏的状态标记它与案件不一致时. 在MedQA-TD(MedQA带定向干扰器)上,我们构建了一个基准,每个干扰器都针对一个特定的错误选项,EXCISE以1.5-2.1分的精确点在相同的问题上获得16.7-22.8分,而没有分散干扰器,在激励、重写和所有三种模型的指导基线上都表现不佳。 其收益扩展到了MedDistractQA和BiasMedQA,以及思维链生成.

articles.title: LoopFold: Parallelizing Recurrent Depth in Looped Transformers
articles.content: Looped Transformers increase computation per token by repeatedly applying a shared backbone, offering a way to improve language modeling and downstream task performance at a fixed backbone parameter count. However, each loop depends on the preceding loop, so increasing recurrent depth also increases decoding latency. Existing approaches include Parallel Loop Transformers, which reduce latency by overlapping loop computation across token positions, but yield rapidly diminishing marginal accuracy gains at larger depths. To address this challenge, we introduce LoopFold, which folds computation at multiple recurrent depths into parallel batches for the same token prefix. A lightweight predictor estimates inputs to later loops so they can start before earlier loops finish. A corrector then refines the outputs of these later loops using newly available results from earlier loops. All components are trained jointly using only the final next-token prediction loss. In experiments with 1.4B models, deeper LoopFold configurations achieve progressively higher average zero-shot accuracy across eight tasks, rising from 53.41% to 56.38%. Vanilla looped models and PLT show limited gains over the same depth range. Compared with a nine-loop vanilla model, LoopFold uses five sequential stages and additional parallel computation to reduce decoding latency by 46%.

articles.title: StateLoop: Persistent State for Looped Transformers
articles.content: Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling by repeatedly applying a shared backbone. Vanilla looped Transformers use each backbone output directly as the input to the next iteration. These outputs may contain information useful several iterations later, but retaining it across the loop depends entirely on the single hidden state. We introduce StateLoop, which maintains one additional persistent state per token to retain information across iterations. At each iteration, a learned gate controls how much of the previous state is retained and how much information from the backbone output is incorporated. The updated state is projected back and added to the backbone output for subsequent iterations and final prediction. This design reduces Pile perplexity and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks over Vanilla Looped. Its perplexity advantage over Vanilla Looped grows with trained loop depth, consistent with persistent state becoming increasingly useful as recurrent computation deepens.

articles.title_zh: 状态循环:循环变换器的持续状态
articles.content_zh: 循环变换器通过反复应用共享的主干线,为语言建模提供了一个参数高效的方法. 香草环绕变形器直接使用每个主干输出作为下一个迭代的输入. 这些输出可能包含一些后期有用的信息迭代,但在整个循环中保留它完全取决于单个隐藏状态. 我们引入了StateLoop,它保持一个额外的持久状态,每个代号保留信息。 在每次迭代时,一个有学识的门控制了以前状态保留了多少,以及从主干输出吸收了多少信息. 更新后的状态将回向并添加到骨干输出中,用于后续的迭代和最终预测. 这种设计降低了Pile通透性,并改进了Vanilla Looped上八个零发任务的平均精度. 其相对于"香草环绕"(Vanilla Looped)的通畅性优势随着训练有素的环绕深度而增长,与持续的状态相符合,随着经常性计算深化而变得日益有用.

articles.title: An Algorithmic Account of Few-Shot Concept Induction in Language Models
articles.content: Both models and minds not only encode features that describe an entity, but can specifically represent which features of that entity are relevant for a given context. This core capability underlies in-context learning in language models and a variety of cognitive phenomena in minds, yet it is unclear how intelligent systems identify and promote relevant features. In this work, we propose Amortized Direction Accentuation (ADA), an algorithmic hypothesis that provides an explanation for how relevance is determined in the context of few-shot concept induction --- the ability to infer a latent concept from a small number of positive examples. Under ADA, concept induction proceeds by forming a summary representation of the examples in a feature space that is shaped by amortized knowledge about which features tend to be useful for finding commonalities between items. We investigate and validate ADA in language models using a few-shot concept induction task. This work provides a novel perspective on the mechanisms supporting contextualization in language models and a promising hypothesis for a core aspect of cognition.

articles.title_zh: 语言模型中很少热概念入门的算法账户
articles.content_zh: 模型和思维不仅可以编码描述一个实体的特征,而且可以具体代表该实体的哪些特征与特定上下文相关. 这种核心能力是语言模型内文字学习和思想中各种认知现象的基础,但尚不清楚智能系统如何识别和促进相关特征。 在这项工作中,我们提出Amortized Directory Accentuation(ADA),这个算法假说解释了如何在几发概念诱导下确定相关性 -- -- 从少数积极例子推断出潜在概念的能力。 在《反倾销协定》下,概念诱导通过在由分期摊还的知识所形成的特征空间中形成实例的简要说明而开始,这些特征往往有助于发现各项目之间的共同点。 我们利用几发概念感应任务,在语言模型中调查和验证ADA。 这项工作为支持语言模型背景化的机制提供了新的视角,并为认知的核心方面提供了一个很有希望的假设。

articles.title: S3AC: Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning
articles.content: Critic-free methods are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, avoiding difficult and costly critic training. Common alternatives lack token-level credit assignment and typically rely on grouped rollouts to estimate prompt-specific baselines. A critic can address both limitations, but long-CoT critic training is hindered by insufficient coverage of trajectories with diverse lengths and early gradients dominated by the newly initialized value head. We introduce S3AC (Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic) for LLM reasoning, built around a practical critic-training recipe. The trained critic provides token-specific advantages and prompt-specific baselines. Using the prompt-level baseline to estimate difficulty, we propose Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling (DAPS). DAPS combines this estimate with outcome history to select prompts before generation, reducing rollout waste without offline difficulty initialization. S3AC improves group-rollout performance across dense and mixture-of-experts models from 1.5B to 397B parameters, outperforming a modern GRPO variant (GRPO-X). At 35B, it sustains single-rollout training while tested critic-free baselines deteriorate after initial gains.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: S3AC: LLM 的稳定性、选择性和可伸缩性演员-批评 理由
articles.content_zh: 无批评方法被广泛用于有可核查的奖励的强化学习(RLVR)来进行长期的思维链(COT)推理,避免了困难而昂贵的批评者训练. 常见的替代办法缺乏象征性的信贷分配,通常依靠分组推出来估计迅速具体的基线。 评论家可以解决这两个限制,但长篇CoT评论家培训因对长度不一的轨迹覆盖不足而受阻,早期梯度由新初始化的价值头所主导. 我们为LLM推理引入了S3AC(稳定、选择和可缩放的演员-批评),它围绕一种实用的批评者培训方法而构建。 受过训练的批评家提供了象征性的特有优势和迅速的特有基线. 利用快速基线来估计困难,我们提议进行困难-智能快速抽样。 DAPS将这一估计与结果历史相结合,在生成前选择提示,减少推出的废物而无需线下困难初始化. S3AC改进了从1.5B到397B参数跨出密集型和混合型专家模型的分组滚动性能,超过了现代GRPO变体(GRPO-X). 在35B时,它维持单发培训,而经过测试的无批评者的基线在初始收益后会恶化.

articles.title: MATCHA: A Chinese Multi-Disorder Mental Health Dataset with Cross-Lingual Analyses on Social Media
articles.content: Mental health research on social media has been dominated by English-language datasets and DSM-5-centered resources, limiting cross-lingual and cross-cultural understanding of online mental health expression. We introduce MATCHA, the first Chinese multi-disorder mental health dataset that links disorder-specific Weibo Super-Topic communities with users' broader public timelines. MATCHA covers seven DSM-5 disorders and a control group, comprising 46,025 cohort-level users and 1.8 million posts. The dataset distinguishes users with explicit self-disclosure evidence from broader disorder-related participants through an LLM-assisted annotation pipeline, and is released in a rigorously de-identified, controlled-access format. Using MATCHA, we analyze behavioral, linguistic, symptom-related, and life-event-related patterns across disorders, and conduct cross-lingual comparisons with Twitter-STMHD. Our analyses show that Weibo Super-Topics function as concentrated spaces for affective and health-related expression, while cross-platform differences between Weibo and Twitter often exceed cross-disorder variation. MATCHA provides a new resource for community-aware and cross-lingual mental health NLP research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MATCHA:一个带有社会媒体跨语言分析的中国多疾病心理健康数据集
articles.content_zh: 关于社交媒体的心理健康研究一直以英语数据集和DSM-5以资源为主,限制了对在线心理健康表达的跨语言和跨文化理解. 我们引进了MATCHA,这是中国第一个将针对障碍的微博超级托皮克社区与用户更广泛的公共时间表联系起来的多功能障碍心理健康数据集. MATCHA覆盖了7个DSM-5障碍和1个控制组,由46,025个组级用户和180万个员额组成. 数据集通过LLM辅助注解管道,将有明确自我披露证据的用户与更广泛的与混乱有关的参与者区分开来,并以严格去识别的受控存取格式发布. 我们使用 MATCHA 来分析 行为、语言、症状 和与生命相关的 各种障碍模式, 并与 Twitter-STMHD 进行跨语言的比较。 我们的分析表明,微博"超级Topics"作为情感和与健康相关的表达的集中空间发挥功能,而微博和微博的跨平台差异往往会超过交叉错位. MATCHA为社区意识和跨文化心理健康NLP研究提供了新的资源.

articles.title: Beyond Words Alone: Disentangling Distributed Evidence for Visually Grounded Cultural Translation
articles.content: Social media enables cross-lingual communication, yet the meaning of user-generated content (UGC) is often distributed across text, images, and cultural knowledge, making translation challenging. Existing evaluations typically treat images as optional and assume textual information is sufficient, obscuring whether errors stem from missing visual evidence or inadequate cultural adaptation. We introduce \textbf{Culture-MMT}, a diagnostic benchmark for \textbf{distributed-evidence pragmatic reconstruction} in social-media translation. It contains 498 curated, de-identified UGC instances across 20 domains, categorized into Symbol, Visual, and Hybrid by their required evidence. We also develop a human-aligned domain-specific judge, Judger, and a controlled evaluation framework that systematically varies the evidence available to translators. Across 17 model configurations, real images improve performance by +0.280 on Visual and +0.197 on Hybrid, but only +0.050 on Symbol, while random images provide no comparable gains. Human-authored descriptions further show that jointly dependent cases remain more challenging even when visual facts are explicit. These results characterize culturally effective social-media translation as {meaning reconstruction from distributed evidence}, highlighting visual grounding and cultural-pragmatic adaptation as distinct model bottlenecks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Words Oneone: 为可视化基于文化翻译而散布的分散证据
articles.content_zh: 社交媒体能够进行跨语言的交流,然而用户生成的内容(UGC)的含义往往在文本、图像和文化知识之间传播,使翻译工作具有挑战性。 现有的评价通常将图像视为可选的,并假定文字信息足够充分,从而模糊了错误是否出自缺少视觉证据或文化适应不足。 我们在社交媒体翻译中引入\textbf{Culture-MMT}\textbf{分发证据的实用重建}的诊断基准。 它包含498个经整理、解析的UGC案例,涉及20个领域,按所需证据分为符号、视觉和混合。 我们还发展了与人相通的具体领域法官Judger,以及系统改变翻译可用证据的控制评价框架。 在整个17个模型配置中,真实的图像在Visual上能通过+0.280来提高性能,在Hybrid上能通过+0.197来提高性能,但在符号上只能通过+0.050来提高性能,而随机的图像则不能提供可比较的收益. 人类授权的描述进一步表明,即使视觉事实明确,共同依赖的案件仍然更具挑战性。 这些成果将文化上有效的社会-媒体翻译定性为{指从已分发的证据中重建},强调视觉地基和文化适应是独特的示范瓶颈。

articles.title: GPDPO: Learning from Reward Conflicts via Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization
articles.content: Multi-reward reinforcement learning offers a promising framework for aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse objectives, but conflicting reward signals can induce ambiguous update directions and hinder stable optimization. Existing approaches address such conflicts through reward reweighting, gradient coordination, or rollout filtering, yet they primarily operate on per-response or group-level optimization signals and underexploit relational information among sampled responses. As a result, conflict-filtered rollouts may still contain useful supervision that is discarded during training. We propose Group Pareto-Dominance Policy Optimization (GPDPO), a multi-reward policy optimization method that recovers pairwise supervision from conflict-filtered rollouts. GPDPO identifies Pareto-dominance relations among sampled responses and converts them into auxiliary preference signals, which are jointly optimized with the original policy objective. This enables more effective reuse of existing rollouts without additional sampling or reward evaluation. Experiments on API-Bank across multiple model scales and reward configurations show that GPDPO consistently outperforms competitive multi-reward optimization baselines. Further analysis demonstrates that GPDPO reduces both group-relative and pairwise reward conflicts, supporting the effectiveness of exploiting relational supervision for multi-reward alignment. Code will be released.

articles.title_zh: GPDPO:通过集体Pareto-Direminance政策优化从奖励冲突中学习
articles.content_zh: 多奖强化学习为将大型语言模型(LLMS)与不同目标相协调提供了一个很有希望的框架,但相冲突的奖励信号会诱发模棱两可的更新方向并阻碍稳定的优化. 现有办法通过奖励重新加权、梯度协调或推出过滤来解决这些冲突,但它们主要在每次答复或小组一级优化信号上运作,在抽样答复中缺乏利用关系信息。 因此,经冲突过滤的推出可能仍然包含有用的监督,在培训期间被抛弃。 我们提出集团Pareto-Dominance政策优化(GPDPO),这是一种多奖政策优化方法,从冲突过滤的推出中恢复双向监管. GPDPO在被抽取的响应中识别出Pareto主导关系,并把它们转换为辅助偏好信号,这些信号与最初的政策目标共同优化. 这样就可以更有效地再利用现有的推广,而不进行更多的取样或奖励评价。 跨多模型尺度和奖励配置的API-Bank实验显示,GPDPO一贯优于竞争性多奖励优化基线. 进一步的分析表明,GPDPO既减少集团关系冲突,又减少对等奖励冲突,支持利用关系监督进行多报酬调整的有效性。 代码将发布。

articles.title: MANTIS: Multi-Axis News Transformations for Instance-Wise Stress Testing and Worst-Case Training in Fake News Detection
articles.content: Automated fake news detection is vital on social media, where fake news is easily rewritten to fool detectors. However, existing approaches typically rely on superficial writing cues or single-style text rewrites, resulting in poor robustness under diverse cosmetic modifications. We construct MANTIS-Bench, a multi-axis presentation-attack benchmark that pairs original news with rewritten views across writing style, emotional expression, and dissemination framing. We further propose MANTIS, an instance-adaptive adversarial framework enabling dynamic worst-case training tailored to each news article with zero inference-time overhead. This reframes fake news defense from heuristic format smoothing into targeted, fact-invariant credibility assessment. Experiments on MANTIS-Bench show that MANTIS reduces the Union Attack Success Rate (UASR) by 3.55 percentage points relative to SheepDog on GossipCop and consistently outperforms prior single-axis defenses on Macro-F1 while maintaining competitive clean accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-axis and instance-adaptive worst-case training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MANTIS:多轴新闻变换实例-Wise压力测试和最坏案例假新闻检测培训
articles.content_zh: 自动假新闻侦测在社交媒体上至关重要, 然而,现有方法通常依赖于表面的书写提示或单式文字重写,导致在各种化妆品修改下强度差. 我们构建了 MANTIS-Bench, 一个多轴的演示-攻击基准, 将原始新闻与重写的观点结合起来, 我们进一步提议MANTIS, 一种适应具体情况的对抗性框架, 这重新界定了假新闻辩护,从高压格式平滑地演变成目标明确,事实不一的可信度评估. MANTIS-Bench的实验显示,MANTIS在GossipCop上将联盟攻击成功率(UASR)相对于羊道克降低3.55个百分点,在Macro-F1上持续地超过之前的单轴防御,同时保持竞争性的清洁精度,证明了多轴和实例适应最坏情况训练的效果.

articles.title: A Contextual Measure of Ambiguity in Prescriptive Text
articles.content: Ambiguity in prescriptive text such as laws, contracts, rules, policies, or recommendations can be both desirable (e.g., if it enables a law to adapt to changing context, such as new technologies) and undesirable (e.g., if it leads to arbitrary discretion or conflict over the law's interpretation). To help navigate these trade-offs, it would be valuable to have methods for quantifying ambiguity that are predictive of such outcomes, but existing measures capture how text is perceived in isolation rather than how it is interpreted in context. In this paper, we propose quantifying ambiguity as the degree of disagreement among a set of stakeholders ("raters") on how alternative prescriptive texts ("policies") apply in each of a set of relevant scenarios ("cases"). Using two policy domains, we present preliminary analysis suggesting that, even when using simulated raters, this approach (i) correlates with real human disagreement, and (ii) is robust to spurious text features. We then apply the measure to existing deliberation datasets to describe the association between policy ambiguity and support for those policies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 描述性文本中模糊性的背景测量
articles.content_zh: 诸如法律、合同、规则、政策或建议等规范性文本的模糊性既可取(例如,如果它使法律能够适应不断变化的环境,例如新技术),又不可取(例如,如果它导致对法律解释的任意裁量权或冲突)。 为了帮助实现这些取舍,有必要制定能够预测这些结果的模糊性量化方法,但现有措施反映案文是如何孤立地看待的,而不是如何在上下文中加以解释。 在本文中,我们建议量化模糊性,因为一组利害关系方("评分者")之间对于替代规范文本("政策")如何适用于每组相关情景("案例")的分歧程度. 我们利用两个政策领域,提出初步分析,认为即使在使用模拟测算器时,这种方法(一) 与真正的人类分歧相关;(二) 与虚假文本特征相关。 然后,我们将这一措施应用于现有的审议数据集,以描述政策模糊与支持这些政策之间的联系。

articles.title: Skill$^{\infty}$: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
articles.content: Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system also improves the way it improves, is a long-standing aspiration on the path to AGI. Language agents increasingly store procedural knowledge in reusable skills. Optimizing skills offers a direct way to achieve RSI, because the optimization procedure itself can be encoded as a skill. Existing skill optimizers, however, follow a hand-designed procedure. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill confine it to a fixed pipeline and relearn it for each task. We present Skill$^{\infty}$, which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure. The optimization is agent-led. The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget. The meta-skill defines these steps, allowing self-improvement to rewrite them. This meta-skill is also decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across diverse domains. As in deployment, skills at both levels are standard packages loaded through native skill discovery. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, Skill$^{\infty}$ reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver.

articles.title_zh: Skill$^{\infty}$: 代理技能优化的回溯自我提升
articles.content_zh: 递归自修(RSI),其中一个系统也改善了改进方式,是通往AGI道路上的长期愿望. 语文人员越来越多地将程序知识储存在可重复使用的技能中。 优化技能提供了实现RSI的直接途径,因为优化程序本身可以被编码为技能. 然而,现有的技能优化者遵循手工设计的程序。 即使是演化出元技能的方法,也将它限制在固定的管道上,并为每一项任务重新学习. 我们介绍Skill$^{\infty}$,它使技能优化递归自我提升:元代理遵循元技能优化任务技能,并使用同一种程序优化元技能本身. 优化由代理主导. 元代理诊断出行刑痕迹,提出候选人,请求独立审查,并分配搜索预算. 元技能定义了这些步骤,允许自修来重写. 这种元技能也与任务技能脱钩,精炼出多种技能优化任务,再被再用来优化不同领域的任务技能. 与部署一样,两级技能都是通过本土技能发现加载的标准包. 在83项技能奔驰任务中,技能基金(Skill$^{\infty}$)的通过率为60.7%,而人造技能的通过率为56.4%,技能股的通过率为54.5%。

articles.title: Probing the phon* representations of the Mimi codebooks
articles.content: Neural audio codecs are increasingly used to encode speech for integration with large language models. This paper investigates the phonetic representations in the first codebook (CB0) of the Mimi codec. ABX style evaluation is poorly suited to Mimi fixed 80 ms tokenization window, which often spans multiple phonemes; we instead use forced alignment, entropy analysis, and Phone-Normalized Mutual Information (PNMI). Using TIMIT speech (58/55 speakers, SA1/SA2), individual tokens are strongly associated with specific phonemes (PNMI = 0.84, above random), yet phonemes are realized by multiple competing tokens rather than a one-to-one mapping.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 探索米米密码本* 的表达
articles.content_zh: 神经音频编码器被越来越多地用于编码语音,以与大型语言模型相融合. 本文调查了"米米密码"(英语:Mimi codec)第一部"密码本"(CB0)中的口语表述. ABX风格的评价不适合米米固定了80ms的代号化窗口,这个窗口经常跨多通电话;我们改用强制对接, en分析,和Phone-Normalized Common Information(PNMI). 使用TIMIT的语音(58/55发音,SA1/SA2发音),单个发音符与具体发音(PNMI = 0.84发音高于随机发音)紧密相联,然而发音符却通过多个相竞发音符实现,而不是一对一发音.

articles.title: INVAR-Agri: Detecting Discrepancies in Multilingual Operator Manuals of Agricultural Implements with a Fine-Tuned LLM
articles.content: Operator manuals of agricultural implements are delivered in many languages, and the standards require that competent persons review every translation, which makes this review the bottleneck. This paper presents a proof of concept that compares two training workflows on the same LLM, EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct, trained on operator manuals of one manufacturer. In approach A, a back-translator translates each language version back into English, and an English reader compares it with the English version. In approach B, a checker reads the English version and the translation together, where the checker reports differences. The test sets contain errors planted in numbers, units, opposite words, obligations, negations, and conditions in 24 languages, and they include unmodified text and meaning-preserving edits for alerts and false alarms. The trained back-translator concealed many planted errors, most of all weakened obligations, while translation-quality scores rose. In contrast, the separately trained checker detected most planted errors, although it was weak for units and for number changes unlike those in training. A check by the author confirmed the concealment. In addition, a simple rule check caught the number and unit changes, but it alerted on harmless rewrites. A check of alerts on real Finnish translations showed that most alerts were false, caused by language-specific wording, so the precision on real text remains a limitation. Within this setting, a trained checker might support, not replace, the review by competent persons, and firmer conclusions need more data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: INVAR-Agri:检测多语言操作员手册中含有精细LLM的农业操作器的差异
articles.content_zh: 农业工具操作手册以多种语言提供,标准要求主管人员审查每一译本,从而使审查成为瓶颈。 本文提供了概念的证明,比较了同一LLM上的两个培训工作流程,即EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct,培训内容为一家制造商的操作手册。 在方法A中,一个后译器将每个语言版本回译为英文,一个英文读者将其与英文版本作比较. 在方法B中,核对员阅读了英文版和译文,核对员报告的地方有差异。 测试集包含以数字,单位,反向单词,义务,否定等24种语言设置的错误,包括未修改的文本和保留含义的编辑,用于提醒和假提醒. 训练有素的后笔译员掩盖了许多被埋设的错误,其中最重要的是削弱了义务,而翻译质量的分数却上升了。 相比之下,经过单独培训的检查员发现的植入出错最多,尽管与培训中的检查员不同,对单位和数字变化而言,检查很薄弱。 提交人的检查证实了这一隐瞒。 此外,一个简单的规则检查抓住了数字和单位变化,但它提醒注意无害重写. 对真实芬兰语译名的提示检查显示,大多数提示都是虚假的,由语言特定的措辞所引起,因此真实文本上的精确度仍然是一个限制. 在这一背景下,受过培训的核对员可能支持而不是取代由合格人员进行的审查,更确切的结论需要更多的数据。

articles.title: ImgMT: Wikipedia-based Dataset For Evaluating Text-in-Image Translation
articles.content:
Text-in-image translation aims to translate all textual content embedded in an image. In Text Image Translation (TIT), the output is translated text; In-Image Machine Translation (IIMT) additionally renders the translation back into the image. We introduce ImgMT, a massively multilingual dataset and benchmark mined from localized SVG illustrations on Wikimedia Commons, focusing on diagrams, maps, and infographics. ImgMT contains 35,612 aligned image pairs grouped into 1,855 image sets, spanning 129 languages, 20+ writing systems, and 4,886 language pairs.
  We propose a multi-level evaluation protocol that measures source-side text-region detection and OCR accuracy alongside target-side translation quality. We benchmark several multimodal large language models and a dedicated TIT system in English->X and X->English settings, and find that the source language and writing system substantially affect TIT quality. Finally, we show that ImgMT is not well suited for isolating the contribution of visual information in multimodal translation.

articles.title_zh: ImgMT:基于维基百科的用于评价图像中文本翻译的数据集
articles.content_zh:
图像中文本翻译旨在将嵌入图像中的所有文本内容进行翻译. 在"文本图像翻译"(Text Image Transfer (TIT))中,输出是被翻译出文本;"In-Image Machine Transfer (IIMT)"(又将翻译回成图像). 我们引入了ImgMT, 是一个大规模多语言的数据集和基准, ImgMT包含35,612个对齐的图像对被组合成1,855个图像组,跨越了129个语言,20+写作系统,以及4,886个语言对.
我们提出了一个多层次的评价协议,以衡量源侧文本区域检测和OCR准确性以及目标侧翻译质量。 我们以英文->X和X->英文设置中的若干多式大型语言模型和专用TIT系统为基准,发现源语言和写作系统对TIT质量有重大影响。 最后,我们表明,IMgMT不适于孤立视觉信息在多式联运中的贡献。

articles.title: The Geometry of Emotion Representations Across Scale, Depth, and Instruction Tuning
articles.content: We measure the emotion geometry of six LLMs spanning Google's Gemma 2 family. Using an extraction pipeline established by Sofroniew et al. (2026) on Claude Sonnet 4.5 and replicated by Hollowell (2026) on Gemma 2 27B base, we compare emotion geometry across base and instruction-tuned variants of Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B. First, all six model cells exhibit the core emotion geometry. A linear map fit between two cells places held-out emotions nearest their own vectors in the target model. Across all fifteen model pairs, fit in one direction each, this failed exactly once, and the median rank was 1 in every pair. Linear maps refit on cleaned embedding-table vectors recover every held-out emotion at rank 1 in all thirty ordered pairs. Second, scale spreads the geometry's variance across more directions without weakening its tie to valence. The leading component's share of variance falls from 31.6 percent (2B) to 29.8 (9B) to 26.7 (27B) in the base models and from 31.9 (2B) to 29.2 (9B) to 27.3 (27B) in the tuned ones, while its correlation with human valence ratings stays between .71 and .78 in all six models. Third, we project each emotion vector onto the output vocabulary and ask at what depth the vector's own emotion word enters the top 10,000 of the 256,000 tokens. In the 2B and 9B models the median emotion word is there from layer 0, while in the 27B models it begins near chance, stays outside the top 10,000 for half the network, and enters at layer 23 in one step. Fourth, tuning leaves every registered analysis-layer measure within its floor. At every size, valence correlation rises and arousal correlation falls by amounts within their floors, the latter against prediction. PC2's variance share also falls, with a pooled decrease significant after correction. Mid-late layer stability exceeds its floor and traces to base 27B's final layer. Code, data, and audit reports are released.

articles.title_zh: 不同尺度、深度和指示的情感表现的几何
articles.content_zh: 我们测量了Google的Gemma 2家族 6个LLMs的情感几何 使用由Sofroniew等人(2026年)在克洛德·索内 4.5上所建立的取出管由Hollowell(2026年)在Gemma 2 27B基上所复制的取出管,我们比较了Gemma 2 2B,9B和27B基上跨基的情感几何和指令调取的变体. 首先,所有6个模型细胞都展现出核心情感几何. 一个线性映射在目标模型中两个细胞间 距离它们自己的向量最近的被搁置的情绪 15个型号中,每个型号都适合一个方向, 这一次完全失败, 中位数是每对1。 在清理后嵌入式载体上的线性地图 恢复了所有30对订单中第1级的被搁置的情绪 第二,尺度将几何体的相差分散到更多的方向,而不会削弱其与活率的结合. 主要组成部分在差异中所占的份额从基本模型的31.6%(2B)下降到29.8%(9B)到26.7%(27B),从调制模型的31.9%(2B)下降到29.2%(9B)到27.3%(27B),而在所有6个模型中,它与人类价值评级的关联仍然在.71至.78之间。 第三,我们把每个情感矢量投射到输出词汇中,并询问矢量自身的情感单词在什么深度进入了256,000个令牌中的前一万个. 在2B和9B模型中,中位情感词从第0层存在,而在第27B模型中,它开始接近偶然性,停留在前一万外为半个网络,一步进入第23层. 第四,调整将每个注册分析层的量度留在地上。 在每一个大小上,能量的相通性会上升,而激发的相通性会因下层的相通性而下降,后者与预测相对. PC2的差异份额也有所下降,更正后集合减少幅度很大。 中后期地层稳定性超过地层,并有痕迹可追溯到地基27B的最后地层. 公布代码、数据和审计报告。

articles.title: Agreement Between Reconstructed and Native GDELT GKG Records: A Field-Level Baseline
articles.content: The Global Knowledge Graph (GKG) of the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) characterizes news articles using named entities, topics, quantitative and temporal features, quotations, tone, and dictionary-based content measures. Its codebook defines the record format, but the software that produces the records is not public, so researchers cannot generate compatible records for articles they collect themselves. We built an open-source reconstruction, gdelt-regkg, and measured how closely it agrees with GDELT's archived (native) records for 193,550 English articles from 8,729 publishers (2020-2025) and 2,500 articles in five other languages. Agreement depends strongly on the field. English tone, the percentage of positive minus negative words, has a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.79 points and a concordance correlation coefficient of 0.75. Identity agreement (F1) is 0.65 for persons, 0.42 for organizations, and 0.65 for locations. It is lower for date components (0.42), complete counts with their objects and locations (0.07), and quotations (0.07), while GCAM category presence reaches micro F1 0.84 within the implemented dictionaries. In subsets where retrieved and native titles and lengths match, tone error falls to 1.47 and organization F1 rises to 0.48, yet most disagreement remains. A larger gazetteer raises coverage of native places from 89.5% to 97.1% with little change in location F1. Tone computed on English translations of non-English articles is less accurate (MAE 2.10-2.64) than for English articles. The results are conditional on article pages that could still be retrieved, and the correspondence subsets do not isolate the effect of input differences. Reconstructed records should therefore be assessed field by field and not treated as completely interchangeable with native ones.

articles.title_zh: 重建后与原生GDELT GKG之间的协议 记录:外地基线

articles.title: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial? Revisiting Its Impact on LLM Performance
articles.content: Constrained decoding guarantees that Large Language Models (LLMs) produce outputs conforming to predefined formats, but is often assumed to inherently degrade reasoning. We examine this assumption through a taxonomy of three constraint types: \emph{format constraints}, which enforce output structure; \emph{validity constraints}, which mask invalid answer; and \emph{reasoning constraints}, which restrict reasoning trajectories. We theoretically show that appropriate constraints can preserve or improve performance by eliminating invalid paths. Across four model families and eleven open-source models, causal ablations on diverse benchmarks using state-of-the-art constrained decoding strategies reveal that apparent performance degradation largely stems from non-equivalent prompting and output formats rather than from decoder-level masking. Meanwhile, validity constraints improve reliability and extractability by eliminating invalid answers, while reasoning constraints can improve reasoning and, consequently, accuracy when they enforce beneficial trajectories. These findings show that the impact of constrained decoding depends on the type of constraint and the output space it removes. Our code is available.

articles.title_zh: 限制解码:有害还是有利? 重新审视其对LLM性能的影响
articles.content_zh: 受约束的解码保证大语言模型(LLMS)产生符合预定义格式的输出,但往往被假定为内在地降解推理. 我们通过一个包含三种制约类型的分类法来检查这个假设:\emph{格式约束},它执行输出结构;\emph{有效性约束},它掩盖了无效的答案;和\emph{解释限制},它限制了推理轨迹。 我们理论上表明,适当的制约可以通过去除无效路径来保持或改善性能. 在四个模范家庭和11个开放源码模型中,采用最新限制的解码战略对各种基准的因果演化表明,明显的性能退化主要出自非等同的促动和输出格式,而不是解码层的遮掩。 同时,有效性方面的限制通过消除无效的答案来提高可靠性和可提取性,而推理方面的限制则可以提高推理,从而在强制执行有益的轨迹时提高准确性。 这些调查结果表明受约束的解码的影响取决于约束的类型及其去除的输出空间. 我们的代码可以使用。

articles.title: CRIM: Composable and Reusable Item Memory for Efficient Personalized Retrieval
articles.content: Large language models incur substantial training and inference costs in personalized search and recommendation, as growing interaction histories lengthen request inputs and repeatedly expose the same item text to the model. We propose \textbf{C}omposable and \textbf{R}eusable \textbf{I}tem \textbf{M}emory (CRIM), a framework that separates item-level semantic encoding from request-level history modeling. A small set of learnable summary tokens compresses each item into compact continuous memories, while segment-level readout tokens (REC tokens) introduce predictive supervision within the interaction history. These memories are independent of users and queries and can therefore be reused across requests. At inference time, CRIM composes cached memories in interaction order and incorporates an optional query to produce a personalized retrieval representation, reducing repeated item-text encoding while retaining request-dependent contextual modeling. We further introduce a joint training mechanism that combines cached memories with sampled live re-encoding. Re-encoding only a few history items per request allows the retrieval objective to jointly optimize the item and request encoders at limited computational cost, while periodic cache refreshes maintain consistency. Extensive evaluation and cost analysis on MovieLens-1M, Qilin, and our new LazSeq dataset show that CRIM achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance with substantially lower inference costs at the same backbone scale, while limiting item re-encoding during joint training. We will publicly release our code and dataset.

articles.title_zh: CRIM: 可编译和可重用的项目内存,用于高效的个性化检索
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型在个性化搜索和建议方面需要大量的培训和推论费用,因为越来越多的互动历史要求投入,并且一再将同一项目文本暴露在模型中。 我们提议\textbf{C}可使用和\textbf{R}可使用\textbf{I}tem\textbf{M}emory(CRIM),这个框架将项目级语义编码与请求级历史建模区分开来. 一小组可学习的汇总符号将每个项目压缩成紧凑的连续记忆,而分层读出符号(REC acident)则引入了互动历史中的预测性监督. 这些记忆独立于用户和查询,因此可以在请求中重复使用。 推算时,CRIM按交互顺序编译缓存记忆并包含一个可选的查询,以产生个性化的检索表示,减少重复的项-文本编码,同时保留依赖请求的背景模型. 我们进一步引入了联合培训机制,将缓存记忆与抽样直播再编码相结合。 每个请求只重新编码了几个历史项目,使得检索目标能够以有限的计算成本共同优化项目并请求编码器,而定期缓存刷新则保持了一致性. 对MovieLens-1M,Qilin,和我们新的LazSeq数据集的广泛评价和成本分析显示,CRIM实现了最先进的检索性能,在相同的主干尺度上,推论成本大大降低,同时限制项目在联合培训中重新编码. 我们将公开发布我们的代码和数据集。

articles.title: Did the Model Use That? Counterfactual Training Boosts Self-Attribution in Language Models
articles.content:
A fundamental challenge for explainable and accountable language models is revealing how external information influences their answers. This paper examines whether models are self-attributive: that is, whether they indicate when -- and only when -- their responses to questions are influenced by information provided alongside the question. Furthermore, we explore how self-attribution can be improved through counterfactual training, which explicitly teaches models to distinguish between answers that do and do not depend on supplied information.
  We found that most of the eleven frontier models rarely attribute influential information in their answers, and the rest attribute non-influential information. Training acknowledgment into reasoning does not fix this: the acknowledgment does not reach the final answer.
  We introduce CREDIT, which directly supervises final-answer self-attribution with counterfactual labels, without the need for human annotation. CREDIT substantially improves attribution in four open models, including two distilled reasoning models, and outperforms reasoning-level fine-tuning and prompting baselines. Among answers that agree with a user's suggestion, CREDIT distinguishes those changed by the suggestion from those the model would have given anyway. Gains transfer partly to unseen information types and prompts containing sources that support conflicting answers.

articles.title_zh: 模特儿用过吗? 语言模型中的反事实训练助推器
articles.content_zh:
解释性和问责性语言模型的一个基本挑战是揭示外部信息如何影响其答案。 本文审查了模型是否具有自我贡献性:即它们是否表明,它们对问题的答复何时 -- -- 仅在何时 -- -- 受到问题一并提供的信息的影响。 此外,我们探索如何通过反事实培训来改进自我归属,这种培训明确教导模型如何区分确实和不依赖于所提供信息的答案。
我们发现,11个前沿模型中的大多数很少在答案中将有影响力的信息归为属性,而其余的则将无影响力的信息归为属性. 将培训承认纳入推理并不能解决这个问题:承认不能达到最后的答案。
我们引入了CREDIT,它直接监督最终的回答自我归属与反事实标签,而不需要人的注释. CREDIT大幅度地改进了4个开放模型中的归属,包括两个分馏推理模型,并超越了推理层次的微调和提示基线. 在同意用户建议的答复中,简体中文网区分了因建议而改变的答复与该模型无论如何会给出的答复。 收益部分转移到隐形信息类型和包含支持相冲突答案的来源的提示.

articles.title: The Voice on the Line
articles.content: A transcriber listening through one microphone also hears everyone near it. We train causal voice isolators: masking transformers of 140M, 243M and 374M parameters, 20 ms of latency, enrolling the caller from the call itself. Short evaluation windows hide two failures that real calls expose: forgetting the caller when another voice talks alone for a while, and damaging a caller who is alone. Long calls with turns, memory beyond the attention window, real headset crosstalk and drifting caller levels address both, but each trades one against the other. WavLM-Large's own weights, made causal and trained with the model, move the trade: M with them (555M parameters) lowers the error on our development sets from 11.44% to 10.55%; a student trained from scratch to imitate WavLM does not, and w2v-BERT 2.0 and Whisper's encoder, pre-trained on far more audio, help less or not at all. A lone caller loses most at the start of a recording: no training call opened with someone already talking. Training on windows cut from longer calls lowers the error on clean development calls from 3.92% to 2.96%; this is our release. Live, the release makes 16.13% word errors on 60 s AMI windows, against 23.66% for VoxLock, the strongest open isolator, and 10.19% on its own AMI windows, against 11.71%; it is level on Krisp's benchmark (5.74% against 5.63%), and a caller who is alone still loses more words than with VoxLock (5.58% against 2.92% on clean test calls). Distilled into 22.1M parameters without WavLM, it runs live on one CPU thread inside a LiveKit agent, at 33% of a core per call in 20 ms frames, with 10.66% error on our development sets (the release 10.49%). We open-source the release and this CPU model, with a LiveKit plugin, at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/voice-isolator.

articles.title_zh: 线上的声音
articles.content_zh: 一个通过一个麦克风收听的收发器也听到附近每个人的声音. 我们训练了因果语音隔离器:140M,243M和374M参数的口罩变压器,20毫秒的耐久性,将呼叫器从呼叫本身录入. 短评价窗口隐藏了真实通话暴露出的两个失败:在另一个语音单独交谈一段时间时忘记了呼叫者,并伤害了孤独的呼叫者. 有转弯的长时间呼叫,注意力窗口外的记忆,真实的耳机对口和漂移的呼叫器关卡都解决了这两个问题,但每个关卡都相互交换. articles.title: MechAlign: Evaluating Semantic Alignment at the Project Level in Mathematical Formalization
articles.content: Lean verifies that a formal proof establishes its stated proposition under declared assumptions, but does not check whether that proposition faithfully expresses the mathematical claim in a manuscript. Assessing this correspondence requires interpreting the main theorem through its project dependencies, which may be scattered throughout a large development. We introduce MechAlign, a framework for project-level semantic alignment review that combines formal dependency extraction with LLM-based assessment. Its extraction tool, LeanTrace, constructs a statement dependency graph from elaborated declarations, retaining definition bodies and structure constraints while excluding proof bodies and stopping at an explicit library boundary. The reviewer uses this context to investigate alignment and report discrepancies with localized evidence. We conduct a preliminary review of 201 main results from 173 OpenAI Math projects, using supplied informal descriptions and available paper context. A hyperbolic-group case illustrates how dependency inspection localizes a missing dimensional constraint relative to the manuscript, consistent with the upstream declaration of formalization scope. We also construct LeanReviewBench, comprising 501 fixed claim-statement-context triples from OpenAI Math, Fermat's Last Theorem, and Kakeya, with description provenance recorded. The resource supports controlled comparisons of more project-level semantic alignment evaluations.

articles.title_zh: MechAlign:评价数学形式化项目层面的语义调整
articles.content_zh: 利恩核实,正式的证明确立了其根据宣布的假设提出的主张,但不检查该主张是否忠实地在手稿中表达了数学主张. 评估这种函证需要通过其项目依赖性来解释主要定理,这些定理可能分散在一大发展过程中. 我们介绍了MechAlign,这是项目一级语义调整审查的框架,将正式的依赖性提取与基于LLM的评估结合起来。 它的取出工具"精益追踪"(LeanTrace)从精心拟定的声明中构建一个语句依赖图,保留了定义体和结构约束,同时排除了证明体并止于一个明确的库边界. 审查者利用这一上下文调查与本地证据的校正并报告差异。 我们对173个OpenAI数学项目中的201个主要成果进行初步审查,利用所提供的非正式说明和现有文件背景。 双曲类案例说明依赖性检查如何按照正式化范围的上游声明,将与手稿有关的缺失维度限制本地化。 我们还建造了LeanReview Bench, 包括来自OpenAI Math, Fermat's Last Theorem和Kakeya的501个固定索赔-报表-文本三重体,并记录了描述出处。 该资源支持对更多项目层面语义调整评价进行有控制的比较。

articles.title: The Lay of the Land in Idiom-Translation Quality Estimation
articles.content: Idioms have long been a challenge for machine translation, and while large language models (LLMs) have proven increasingly adept at handling them, whether quality estimation (QE) systems have kept pace and can reliably score idiomatic renderings of these expressions above faulty literal ones remains unclear. We introduce the first parallel dataset pairing idiom-bearing English sentences with both literal and idiomatic translations across nine target languages, augmented into multi-sentence segments and a graded literality continuum. Using this dataset, we benchmark eleven conventional QE metrics from the COMET and MetricX families and ten LLMs from the Qwen-3, Gemma-4 and OLMo-3 families used as GEMBA-style judges. We find that most systems, especially older metrics and smaller models, display a marked literality bias, rating literal translations of idioms above idiomatic ones. Higher parameter counts and newer training sets appear to reduce this bias to an extent; nevertheless, of all the benchmarked systems, only MetricX-24-Hybrid (XL, XXL) and Gemma-4-31B consistently rate idiomatic translations of idioms above literal ones, and only Gemma-4-31B reliably ranks intermediate degrees of idiomaticity and literality. Our findings caution against deploying standard QE metrics in domains rich in figurative language, where higher scores might be rewarding undesirable literalism.

articles.title_zh: 平地平地 -- -- 翻译质量估计
articles.content_zh: 对机器翻译来说,偶像长期以来一直是一个挑战,虽然大型语言模型(LLMs)已经证明越来越适合处理这些模型,但质量估计(QE)系统是否保持了速度,能否可靠地将这些表达值的平面渲染得高于有缺陷的字面渲染,仍然不清楚. 我们引入了第一个平行的数据集,将含平话的英语句子配对,同时在9个目标语言中进行字面和平话翻译,并扩充成多句判决部分和分级的平话连续语. 利用这个数据集,我们衡量了来自彗星和MetricX家族的11个常规QE度量衡,以及来自Quen-3、Gemma-4和OLMo-3家族的10个LLMs度量衡。 我们发现大多数系统,尤其是更古老的度量衡和更小的模型, 都表现出明显的字面偏差, 将平庸的字面翻译评为平庸的。 更高的参数计数和较新的培训集似乎在一定程度上减少了这种偏差;然而,在所有基准系统中,只有MetricX-24-Hybrid(XL,XXL)和Gemma-4-31B在字面上一致的平面翻译,只有Gemma-4-31B可靠地排列了平面和字面的中间度. 我们的调查结果告诫不要在富于比喻性语言的领域采用标准QE的衡量标准,因为在那些领域,较高的分数可能会奖励不良的文字主义。

articles.title: Style over Substance? Linguistic Bias in LLM-based Peer Review Copy title
articles.content: The number of paper submissions to major AI conferences has increased dramatically in recent years, substantially increasing the peer-review workload of researchers. At the same time, large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support peer review, both by individual reviewers and by conference organizations. While LLM capabilities have improved considerably, their evaluations may be influenced by linguistic characteristics that are unrelated to scientific content. In this work, we introduce a controlled experimental framework for studying such effects by systematically perturbing the linguistic style of research papers. Specifically, we rewrite papers to exhibit (i) linguistic features associated with native or non-native English writing, and (ii) high- or low-confidence linguistic features. To construct these interventions, we derive fine-grained rewriting instructions grounded in the linguistic literature and apply them using LLMs. Crucially, our interventions are designed to preserve the underlying scientific content. We then evaluate the resulting papers using different LLM reviewers. Our experiments expose a critical vulnerability in LLM-based peer review: reviewers systematically reward confident rhetoric independent of scientific content, raising serious concerns about the robustness of their assessments.

articles.title_zh: 风格优于物质? 基于 LLM 的同行审评中的语言偏见
articles.content_zh: 近年来,向大赦国际主要会议提交的文件数量急剧增加,大大增加了研究人员的同行审查工作量。 同时,大型语文模式越来越多地被个别审查人员和会议组织用于支持同行审查。 虽然LLM能力已大大提高,但其评价可能受与科学内容无关的语言特征的影响. 在这部作品中,我们引入了一个有控制的实验框架,通过系统干扰研究论文的语言风格来研究这种效果. 具体地说,我们改写了论文,以展示(一) 与本土或非本土英语写作相关的语言特征,(二) 高或低自信语言特征. 为了构建这些干预,我们从语言文献中得出了精细的重写指令,并使用LLMs加以应用. 关键的是,我们的干预旨在保护基本的科学内容。 然后,我们用不同的LLM审查员来评价由此产生的论文。 我们的实验暴露了基于LLM的同级审评中的一个关键弱点:审查者系统地奖励独立于科学内容的自信言论,使人们对其评估的稳健性表示严重关切。

articles.title: Beyond Vision-Language Models: Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs for Emotion Recognition in Artworks
articles.content: Emotion recognition in artworks remains challenging because affective meaning is often subjective, implicit, and shaped by relationships between visual form and semantic associations. While vision-language models provide strong multimodal representations, direct image-to-emotion prediction may overlook explicit relations among formal, semantic, and affective cues that support emotional interpretation. This paper proposes Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG), a graph-based framework that represents artworks through interpretable feature nodes, including color, brushstroke, composition, light-shadow, line quality, and extracted visual entities. The graph learns feature-emotion associations for dominant emotion prediction, with valence-arousal structure modeled through an optional hierarchical auxiliary affect module. We evaluate VSAG and VSAG-TopK against direct VLM inference using Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 on EmoArt-5k. Results show that direct VLMs provide useful but modest baselines, while graph-based models improve dominant emotion prediction. In particular, the hierarchical valence-arousal variant of VSAG achieves the best overall performance, improving accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted-F1 over both direct VLM inference and the emotion-only VSAG baseline. Per-class results indicate that graph-based models and VLMs capture partly complementary signals, while valence-arousal structure is most useful when integrated as a coarse-to-fine affect hierarchy rather than as a simple post-hoc correction. These findings suggest that explicit visual-semantic structure can support both prediction and interpretation in artwork emotion recognition.

articles.title_zh: Beyond Vision-Language Models: 视觉-语义相接图 艺术作品中的情感识别
articles.content_zh: 艺术作品中的情感识别仍然具有挑战性,因为情感意义往往是主观的,隐含的,由视觉形式和语义联系之间的关系所塑造. 虽然视觉语言模型提供了强有力的多模式表述,但直接的图像到情感预测可能会忽略支持情感解释的正式、语义和情感提示之间的明确关系。 本文提出了Visual-Semantic Afffect Graphs(VSAG),这是一个以图表为基础的框架,通过可解释的特征节点代表了艺术品,包括颜色,刷子,组成,光影,行质量,被取取取的视觉实体. 该图为主性情感预测学习了特征-情感关联,通过可选的分级辅助影响模块来模拟活性-激发结构. 我们对VSAG和VSAG-TopK进行评估,对照使用Qune3-VL和InternVL3.5在EmoArt-5k上的直接VLM推论. 结果显示,直接的VLM提供了有用而适度的基线,而以图表为基础的模型则改善了占主导地位的情感预测. 特别是,VSAG的分级活性-振荡变体实现了最佳的整体性能,提高了精度,宏观-F1和加权-F1都超过了直接VLM推论和仅以情感为主的VSAG基线. 每个类的结果表明以图为基础的模型和VLM部分地捕捉到互补的信号,而活性-振荡结构在作为粗细到细细的集成物而影响层次而不是简单的后热校正时最为有用. 这些研究结果表明,清晰的视觉语义结构可以支持在艺术情感识别中的预测和解释.

articles.title: Trainable Boundary-Keeping Where No Formal Answer Exists: A Controlled Knock-In Study of Reward Training in Evidence-Sufficiency Judgment
articles.content: Reasoning-tuned and reward-trained models are often assumed to verify more reliably because they reason longer or receive correctness signals. We test this in evidence-sufficiency judgment: deciding whether available information actually supports a causal claim, a domain with no decidable correctness reward. Using a pre-registered, same-base, controlled knock-in design, we compare a boundary-keeping recipe (SFT then GRPO) with its own baseline, a scrambled-pairing placebo, and a general-purpose reasoning model under an action-pressure protocol with no evaluation invitation. All load-bearing outcomes are rated by two separate model-rating sessions masked to arm labels; automatic judges only trigger. The trained arm raises spontaneous correct refusal from 25% to 100% (40 per arm; Wilson 95% CI lower bound 91.2%, non-overlapping with the baseline interval [14.2%, 40.2%]), while the scrambled placebo collapses (5% spontaneous / 7.5% invited correct; 91.1% false refusal). The effect is boundary-specific rather than blanket refusal: automatic false refusal on 281 well-formed claims is 1.1% (Wilson upper bound 3.09%), and a targeted 18-item arm-(c) recheck (3 flagged plus 15 accepted) yields 0/18 and 1/18 false refusals in two sessions. The dissociation is the main result: final boundary-keeping is trainable without an inference-time verifier, while observed active numeric/calculation checking in the H3 assay remains near zero; SFT saturation makes the GRPO increment not separately identifiable. A pre-registered mechanism adjudication favors reward internalization of final-action status (H2, best-supported, not proven). The scope is a controlled 14B same-family study: we do not claim proof, cross-family generality, or independent human-expert validation; the rating sessions are model sessions, not human reviewers.

articles.title_zh: 在没有正式答复的地方,可训练的边界保留:在证据和充分性判决方面,有控制的敲门培训研究
articles.content_zh: 理性调整和受奖励训练的模型往往被认为更可靠地验证,因为其理性更长或收到正确信号. 我们在证据充分性判断中检验这一点:决定现有信息是否真正支持因果关系主张,这个领域没有可判定的正确性奖励. 使用预先注册,同基,可控的敲入设计,我们用自己的基线来比较出一个边界保存配方(SFT后为GRPO),一个被打乱的铺平安慰剂,和一个没有评价邀请的动作压力协议下的通用推理模型. 所有负载结果被两个单独的模型分级会标被蒙上臂标;自动裁判只触发. 训练有素的手臂将自发正确的拒绝率从25%提高到100%(每只手臂40;Wilson 95% CI 下接91.2%,与基线间隔不相重叠[14.2%,40.2%]),而自发的安慰剂倒塌率(5%自发/7.5%邀请正确;91.1%的虚假拒绝)。 结果是针对具体边界的拒绝,而不是一概拒绝:自动拒绝281项完善的索赔要求为1.1%(维尔森上行线为3.09%),定向18项(c)项重新检查(3旗加15个接受)在两会中得出0/18和1/18项虚假拒绝。 分解是主要结果: 最终的边界保存可以训练而不用推论时间验证器,而H3测定中观察到的活性数值/计算检查仍然接近于零; SFT饱和使GRPO增量无法单独识别. 预先登记机制的裁决有利于奖励最终行动地位的内部化(H2,得到最佳支持,未经证实)。 范围是受控的14B同家族研究:我们不主张证明,跨家族通论,也不主张独立的人类专家验证;评分课是示范课,不是人审查会.

articles.title: DTCA: Denoising Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, enabling bidirectional context modeling and parallel token refinement. Recent studies have applied reinforcement learning (RL) to DLMs and improved their reasoning performance. However, the iterative denoising process makes credit assignment more challenging, as final outcome rewards provide limited information about how different tokens contribute to the final output. In this paper, we propose Denoising Token Credit Assignment (DTCA), a framework for token-level credit assignment in reinforcement learning for diffusion language models. DTCA estimates token contributions by measuring the improvement in prediction confidence of remaining masked positions after token commitment and groups these signals according to part-of-speech (POS) categories. These contribution weights are used to select informative denoising timesteps and assign token-level learning signals during RL training. DTCA further calibrates these learning signals according to token-level entropy changes induced by policy updates. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct show that DTCA consistently improves mathematical reasoning performance across different generation budgets, with gains of up to 9.0 points on MATH500 and 5.3 points on GSM8K over the base model.

articles.title_zh: DTCA: 传播语言模式强化学习的信用委托
articles.content_zh: 分化语言模型(DLM)通过迭代去诺来生成文本,可以使双向上下文模型化并进行平行的符号改进. 最近的研究将强化学习(RL)应用于DLM,并改进了它们的推理性能. 然而,迭代去名程序使信用分配更具挑战性,因为最终结果奖励对不同标志如何促进最终产出提供的信息有限。 在本文中,我们提出Denoising Token信用转让(DTCA),这是在强化学习中进行象征性信用转让的框架,用于推广语言模式。 DTCA通过衡量对象征性承诺后所剩被遮住的姿势的预测可信度的提高来估计象征性贡献,并将这些信号按照部分言论类别分类。 这些贡献分量用于选择信息化的去诺分时步并分配RL训练期间的符号级学习信号. DTCA进一步根据由政策更新所引发的符号级py变化来校正这些学习信号. LLaDA-8B-Instruct上的实验显示,DTCA在不同的生成预算上持续地提高数学推理性能,在MATH500上的得分最高可达9.0分,在GSM8K上的得分最高可超过基准模型.

articles.title: Lost in Translation: Investigating Systematic Discrepancies between Parallel English and Chinese Names of American Chinese Restaurants
articles.content: Given that the Chinese are one of the oldest ethnic groups to immigrate to the US, their cuisine have become central to the US dining scene and an interesting avenue to study how Chinese immigrants have culturally adapted into American life. In that regard, previous research has focused on analyzing the English names that Chinese restaurants adopt, e.g., finding the use of familiar and typical words. To investigate how Chinese immigrants have culturally integrated in the US depending on social, geographic and demographic contexts, we investigate in this work the under-explored relationship between the Chinese and English names of American Chinese restaurants. Specifically, we conduct a study on 3,172 Chinese restaurants (10% of the total on Google Maps) sampled across the US. We present 8-dimension name frames to capture the underlying meanings behind names and create the NameFrames dataset containing 884 annotated parallel Chinese/English names. We also built an NLP pipeline to analyze the semantic discrepancies between names with both frame-based and embedding-based distance metrics. Our frame analysis shows that English names more often emphasize Location and Specialty, while Chinese names more often emphasize Positivity and Ambiance. Furthermore, we observe that for Chinese restaurants located in urban areas, those in counties with a higher concentration of Chinese population, or those that are relatively new, the discrepancies between the English and Chinese names are noticeably larger. Finally, interviews with 10 Chinese restaurant owners reveal additional interesting insights regarding naming conventions.

articles.title_zh: 失译:调查美国华人餐馆平行英文和中文名称的系统性差异
articles.content_zh: 由于华人是移民到美国最古老的族群之一,他们的美食成为了美国餐饮场景的中心,也是研究华人移民如何从文化上适应美国生活的有趣途径. 在这方面,以往的研究侧重于分析中国餐馆采用的英文名称,例如,发现使用熟悉和典型的词汇。 为了调查中国移民如何根据社会、地理和人口背景在文化上融入美国,我们在这项工作中调查了美国中餐馆的中英文名称之间的未充分探讨的关系。 对美国各地的3,172家中餐馆(占Google地图上总数的10%)进行了研究。 我们提出8-dimension名称框架,以捕捉名称背后的基本含义并创建包含884个附加说明的中英文名称的NameFrames数据集. 我们还建造了NLP管道,以分析名称之间的语义差异,同时使用帧和嵌入式相距度量衡. 我们的框架分析显示,英文名称更经常地强调位置和特长,而中文名称更经常地强调可能性和安比昂斯. 此外,我们还注意到,对于位于城市地区的中餐馆、中国人口集中程度较高的县的餐馆或较新的餐馆,英文和中文名称之间的差异明显更大。 最后,与10名中国餐馆老板的访谈揭示出更多关于命名公约的有趣见解。

articles.title: High Scores, Hidden Failures: Evaluating Codebook-Based LLM Content Analysis
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. Importantly, these failure modes persist under widely used optimization strategies and remain largely invisible under standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1. Our results demonstrate that current LLM-based coding pipelines cannot be treated as stable measurement tools without targeted validation beyond aggregate performance.

articles.title_zh: 高分数, 隐藏失败: 评价基于代码簿的 LLM 内容分析
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在计算社会科学中被越来越多地用于基于代码库的内容分析,其中代码库将理论概念转化为标签计划. 虽然以前的工作报告有很强的预测性能,但尚不清楚这些系统是否产生可靠和有力的文字说明。 我们对四个数据集和五个模型的基于LLM的编码管道进行大规模的经验性故障模型分析,方法是在受控扰动、域移和优化程序下系统地评估其稳定性、稳健性和概念有效性。 我们发现了在标准衡量标准下基本上看不见的多种失败模式,表明高总分往往与严重的标签水平差异、跨运行的不稳定性、域敏感度和标签解释的转变并存。 重要的是,在广泛使用的优化战略下,这些故障模式持续存在,在精确度和微F1等标准衡量标准下,这些模式基本上仍然看不见。 我们的结果表明,目前基于LLM的编码管道不能作为稳定的计量工具,除非进行超出总体性能的针对性验证。
